comments: This is a gorgeous appartment. Paula & Sergio are super friendly and welcoming and all their little pamphlets and maps of the area were very helpful. We would definitely look in to staying here again if we were to return to Porto. It was a home away from home. Thanks for a great stay!

Paula's flat is really beautiful; it has loads of space and is full of great artwork. It's in a great location, close to transport and shops and within easy walking distance of the old town.
Paula and her husband are extremely welcoming hosts and make you feel at home straight away.
Highly recommended.
Paula was very nice, she explained us how to get around and even gave us a personalized map. The apartment is super clean and very beautiful and elegant. We had an amazing time there!

We have had a wonderfull week in this apartment. It was very clean. We had a warm welcome by Paula, who explained us everything we needed to know.. Sergio showed us eveything we wanted to know at a ,by himself made, map of the apartment and surroundings in Porto. The three level-apartment is beautiful decorated with colourful paintings. We felt very at home there. The view from the large sunterrace over Porto was marvellous. We would return to this apartment again with a next visit to Porto. Thank you, Sergio, for bringing our luggage with your car to Trindade, when we left for the airport.

Thank you so much Paula for a fabulous stay!!!! The location of the apartment was perfect for us to walk from to explore Porto and we loved popping back for a little relax each day before heading back out to explore more. The apartment was very tidy and there was everything we needed for a fantastic stay. We had an amazing time at the apartment and loved Porto! Thanks again Paula!

This is a lovely flat, and the pictures capture it accurately.  We had a fantastic time. The map with the personal recommendations was amazing. There is lots of room in the flat, and when the weather is great, it would be amazing to take advantage of the lovely terrace.  The disadvantage for me was the distance from the centre.  Although you start to reach the shopping area within a 12 minute walk, the bars and restaurants are about 25 minutes  away, and the flat is at the top of a hill.  (Which is quite a distance when it's pouring down with rain...) Although Uber taxis are very cheap in Porto, so it made no difference to our stay.
Very comfortable and spacious with great sitting areas. Close to the main shopping strip and also to public transport. Paula was a great host
Locality of apartment is very good, only 10 minutes away from shops and restaurant, road noise is noticeable but not an issue for us

What a great time we had in Porto. The appartment of Tomas is absolute a great choiche for a stay in Porto. It is as nice as on the pictures, it is very well decorated, clean, a lot of space en right in the middle of the historic centre. Tomas is a very friendly host who helped us with maps and other information for a great sty in Porto. And yes, you have to climbe quite a few stairs to reach the appartment, but isn't that a great help to stay slim after eating al the delicious pastery that you can eat every where?

My family and I loved our stay! The apartment is well
furnished and right where it needs to be to see all the sights of Porto. In the one day we were there we walked out our front door and everything was a few minutes away. The only thing we were left wanting for was a slightly better view and an elevator.

A very lovely appartment right in the heart of Porto. Everything you need to see is in walking distance. The appartment is beautiful and looks exactly as shown on the pictures. Great restaurants and bars nearby. We really enjoyed it! :)

Pedro is a great host. Once you reserve a room in his cool apartment, he send you a lot of tips for you enjoy Porto. He is friendly and open minded. His place is very well located and very clean. I spent a great time!

Pedro is friendly, very helpful. Seems like he knows everything about Porto :) He even prepared me a list of events, which were happening in the city during my stay.
Room is really artsy. I especially liked a common balcony, where you can sit and enjoy the sun in the late afternoon.
All the main attractions are a short walk down the mountain, very convenient.
If I'll ever come to Porto again, I'll definitely choose this place again.
Pedro is a great host, the house has everything you need, close to the city centre and just a few steps away from the metro. I really reccommend it, we had a great time there! Thanks:)

Pedro was really great about communicating with the guests and always checking-in with us to see if anything was needed. He provides you with a map the first day you stay as a guest with all the key locations to see in Porto, he even goes a bit further to recommend locations where to eat and shop.
The location of the home is a quick metro ride to the historic center of Porto. Overall, awesome experience with a great host. I would book this place without a doubt if I were to visit Porto again. Thanks Pedro!

Wonderful place with soul, restored furniture is amazing, roof terrace is superb and location is quiet and green. We enjoyed morning walks in the forest nearby. Kitchen is big and we’ll equipped. Many bathrooms, comfortable beds.

Julieta is the best!!! I am so lucky to be able to stay in her house when I visited Porto, it totally makes the whole experience different and wonderful! Her house is very cute, clean and comfortable, and she is just lovely and caring, we had 2 great dinner together chatting and sharing stories, I will definitely go back just to visit her, and the city of course ha, if you ever visit Porto, this is the place you should stay!

Andre and his sister Ana are great hosts - they provided very clear instructions during the check-in as well as quite useful recommendations for our one week in Porto.
There is a lot of space in this apartment and all necessary appliances.
The location is great - in particular, for those driving a car as it is quite close to the city and provides short routes to highways connecting to other attractions in the region.

Without a doubt the best airbnb I stayed in, in Portugal. Julieta provided a lovely light airy bedroom with private bathroom, a great breakfast. On top of all that Julieta was a great source of information re. Porto, parking, walking, places to go etc. Also, when Julieta knew that I was heading south to Evora she gave me lots of information on that area. All in all a brilliant hostess. I cannot recommend highly enough.

Wenn we arrived Julieta made us a cup of coffee and told us the places we should visit. Futher she explaned wich routes we could take. During the week she stayed in contact with us ans send us whatsap messeges with touristic tips.
Julieta gives you the feeling to feel at home.

The apartment is large and spacious for 4 people, it’s a little far from Porto which suited us fine, there is a promenade to walk into Porto once you get to the river.
The owners Sister picked us up from the Bus station which was most welcome and also allowed us to check out late as we had a late flight.

This place is amazing! Perfect location, beautiful view and a lovely cozy room. We had a lovely warm welcome from our host Filipa, including port and cookies on arrival. We looked at a bunch of places and this was by far the best option. We would definitely stay there again!!
The location was fantastic. Great view from window and the owner's wine bar downstairs was a real bonus. Very helpful and accommodating.

Filipa's place was great. It has great view as just like in photo. Location was also great that right in front of the river. If you looking for the place with nice river view, this place would be the one for your trip.

Amazing place to stay! Literally, couldn’t be a better location, with a great view of the river. The space is in the middle of SO many great things - walk out the door and you’re surrounded by some of the best spots inporto. The space itself was spacious and cute. Filipa & Moises were the best :)  Super friendly, & very helpful!
Unbeatable views and perfect location. Hosts were so accommodating and we felt like at home. Would stay here again if visiting Porto. Highly recommend!!

Filipa’s Airbnb was wonderful! It was a beautiful space with a great view. The location was central to lots of restaurants and activities in Porto, and an easy walk to Gaia as well. Would strongly recommend staying here!
This location is unmatched!! The views, access to water, and access to attractions is spot on. Perfect location in the coolest building.

Joana was a very friendly and knowledgable host. She allowed early check-in which was kind. Nice flat with spacious living room and a cosy kitchen. Nice terrace. 8-10 min walk from metro and even quicker from bus. Would recommend!

Great location, great apartment, great hosts! The room is bright and airy and well appointed. Bed was comfortable, kitchen had everything we needed and the shower was large based on my experiences in Europe. The location is ideal as you are very close to great restaurants and bars, but the street itself is quiet.

The apartment was very comfortable and clean!

Great location and very warm welcome.
Totally recomended!
Could not fault this apartment. Our stay was wonderful. Super spacious and clean. Thank you for a great stay- highly recommend!
Great location. Central, close to metro and supermarkets. Modern and stylish, well kept appartment. Would definitely recommend
Marco’s place was in what felt like a quieter place in Porto,  but everything is walkable! Easy to get around to stores, the churches, and train stations. Was a good stay!

Nice place in Porto, lots of restaurants and sites to visit around the apartment. The train station is close by. Spacious, clean and sunny. A little noisy on the street but it's a lively neighborhood. I recommend it.
This place is so gorgeous! Perfect location near bars, restaurants and Porto sights, really accomodating hosts. Thank you!

The location of this flat is perfect, very central and easy to get to from the train station (which was a very easy train ride to/from the airport).  The flat is clean and adorable, and the bed comfortable. Do be aware that the street noise can be a bit loud late on the weekend but was less noisy during the week. All in all we would absolutely stay here again in the future. Marco was very communicative and friendly which is always nice!

We enjoyed our stay here. Apartment is nice and clean with a nice bathroom. It is located in the city center close to the main sights, but also in a street with a lot of bars (can be quite loud at night). Check in was as easy as the communication. We can definitely recommend staying here.

When I come back to Porto, I won’t consider any other options for accommodations. This was the most perfect location and space for me and my husband. There were lots of eating options, it’s easy to get to and there are a few great bars nearby. I was so grateful they had the option to allow us to check in a bit early as well. I can’t say enough positive things about this space. I also loved the Alice in Brewland and Bao Beers right downstairs

I took 1 week, and another week and then I extended to 1 month.
Just an awesome place (Matosinhos) to stay in and around Porto, morely if you like outdoor life and surfing. Beach in on 5min biking. The tramline is on 5min walking. A bike to the city center of Porto, 30 min, along the sea and the river. And above all, you're staying in an very nice place, renovated farm and lots of space in the garden and around. Loving dogs is a pro :-) But they're so cute!

We had a very nice stay at your apartment. It's very well situated in the middle of the most beautiful part of the (old) city of Porto. It's well equipped and very clean. Thanks for your tips, we enjoyed Porto! Marc and Kitty

Perfect! A most hospitable welcome from Luis, who immediately provided extensive information for enjoying the pleasures of the neighborhood, the city, and the surrounding area (and a complimentary port); a spacious, beautifully and comfortably furnished apartment, with modern kitchen, that provided a quiet haven to return to after days of exploring; an excellent location in walking distance of most of Porto's interesting sights, good restaurants, river front. Extra nice touches in fresh French rolls delivered each morning and the provision of butter, jams, coffee and several other snacks, excellent wifi, and for those who need it, TV reception. And friendly, helpful staff! Yes, perfect!

Excellent stay. From the check-in until the check-out everything was perfect at Eugenias + Luis place. They provided very helpful information to discover Porto and the apartment itself felt like-home, very comfortable and spacious.

Eugenia and Luis' place was absolutely perfect!! I cannot express how charming the place is and how comfortable and convenient the location is to nearly everything you want to see and do in Porto. The directions from the train station were fantastic and a great help! We were greeted by Eugenia who made sure to be there by our arrival time (even though we booked last minute and arrived in the evening). We were given great tips for what to do and see around the city and this helped us plan our time in Porto. We arrived on a Sunday and by the time we got ready for dinner many places had closed, but, Eugenia called some restaurants and got us reservations at a great little place down the street. I can't explain how much we felt at home from the minute we entered the place. Highly recommended and we'll definitely stay here again when we return to Porto!!
Wonderful renovated apartments in the middle of historic Porto. Walking distance to the best spots in town. The hosts are amazing and very helpful.
We had a great stay for an extended weekend at this extraordinary place. Eugenia was a great host, welcoming us with many tips and providing a small breakfast every morning!

Good location. Cool "vintage" look to things.
Some of the furniture could be renewed-fans, matress, tv

This apartment was lovely! I stayed for 18 days, had Porto home base and did some day trips as well as one overnight from there. Great location, super nice and stylish apartment, clean, pleasant, had everything needed. Hosts were very helpful and communicative but also gave much privacy. Porto is a hilly city, and the apartment is also a walk up, so you'll get some climbing exercise in Porto! The windows are double paned and really do an excellent job keeping the lively street noise down - I slept well every night on the comfy bad. Would absolutely stay here again. 5 stars.

Extremely convenient location near Sao Bento station, where you can travel to many other places, including day trips. Close to the water and other areas (e.g. restaurants). Check in and out were very easy and communication was extremely fast. Sound proof windows were very effective. Great facilities. Tons of space. Would highly recommend.

This apartment is great! We loved the location. You will be within short walking distance of many great restaurants and cafes, along with shops and sights to see.
Check in is easy, and communication leading up to our stay was great, too.
The apartment is clean, with a bunch of natural light. The kitchen is set up nicely and has an electric kettle along with a coffee maker. We appreciated how easy it was to be comfortable here.

Eugenia and Luis's place was absolutely a great find! perfect location near train station, restaurants, river and all things to do in walking distance. We were welcomed to their home personally and when we entered into our apt. it was beautiful. What a great place to celebrate our 20th anniversary together.
would highly recommend to anyone, don't even hesitate! Thank you for your kindness and all your recommendations. Michelle

We are so lucky to have booked this apartment! The staff were so helpful when we arrived, orienting us to the city and providing excellent recommendations for visits and restaurants. The apartment itself is absolutely gorgeous, full of character and very comfortable as well as spotlessly clean. Thanks for the port wine on our arrival and the useful bits and pieces in the kitchen cupboard. This apartment is perfectly located in the old town, just a short walk from the riverside and also very near the Sao Bento station and Metro - a perfect base to explore Porto. We'd love to come again some time!

We were greeted with much enthusiasm by Eugenia, who provided us with a brief history of the area, as well as maps and recommendations for restaurants, bakeries, shopping, etc. The apartment was recently renovated and very clean. It is in a great location, within walking distance to many historical sites and the waterfront. Eugenia was easy reachable by email for any questions we had. Thanks for a great stay!

Fantastic apartment in an ideal location with friendly and helpful hosts.  Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay and great value too.  Loved Oporto too, wish we'd had longer than the 3 nights we were there.  Go!

The flat was great - spacious, comfortable and in a great location in the centre of Porto.  It is close to the river and fantastic bars and restaurants.  Highly recommended.  Luis was also very helpful and provided a list of local bars, restaurants and attractions to visit.

We loved our stay in Porto, it felt like we were neighbors, rather than visitors. Luis and Eugenia left us fresh bread and pastries every morning, and Luis took the time to point out local sights, landmarks, and favorite restaurants to help us get started. That makes a huge difference in how you feel about a place.

Place was absolutely perfect - great location.  Wonderful hospitality- Port on arrival, and great fresh bread and pastries for breakfast. They provided maps and tips on the city which were really helpful. Faultless all round.

Personable and hospitable hosts. Eugenia and Luis are proud of their place, and of the town of Porto, and it shows in their communication, the information they provide throughout the course of the visit, the upkeep of the place and the quality of the experience they create.
Great family-friendly appartment in the heart of downtown.  Easy walks to the Ribeira, Sé, Dom Luis I bridge, and Clerigos Church.  Would stay here again!

Really nice house with all stuff you need to stay with your whole family. You got a private parking lot in front of the building on the property. The Beach is 700 m from the house and reachable by feet. Angelo & Antónia welcomed us heartily and showed us every detail of the house, it was a pleasure.

The location is very good, a small walk to the centre, bridge and Metro station. The house is located in a quiet street, in site the house is very big. Also for a family. The garden is nice. The few is magnificent. We enjoyed Porto and the house made it perfect.
We recieved a very warm welcome, our host showed us around and we where happy to be able to leave our things in the flat while cleaning.

A beautiful 16 century abode with amazing views of the duro and bridge. Your own private garden with a 15 min walk to the main center. Beds very comfortable and great shower. We loved this special place
It was easy too acces. The car can be parked closely. Visting Oporto from here is great. Everything was easy too find and on walking distance.

Fantastic place that’s perfectly located to explore this city, or simply just sit in the garden and gaze at its beauty. The apartment is old, yes, but has lots of charm and all the functionality one needs - for the few hours one isn’t strolling around Porto and it’s surroundings.

This place is gorgeous! I highly recommend. The location is perfect. It is right in the middle of everything and is very easy to walk anywhere in the city center that you will want. The view is breathtaking. The space itself is even nicer in person.
The space is a bit hard to find, but the host offers detailed pictures and directions that helped a lot.
We rented a car, and were worried about how we would park, but since it is a bit removed from the main street you can park up on the street near the cathedral. It is actually in a space that seems like it wouldn't be allowed, but was totally fine.
The host was very responsive and flexible. We were given a map and some great recommendations.
Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Old world charm and amazing location and views made our stay in Porto unique, relaxing, convenient and comfortable. We could have stayed for a month and still found ways to enjoy! Felt like a local and soaked up the Porto vibes. Our host graciously allowed for early arrival and baggage storage for our late departure; provided excellent and detailed instructions which made for a smooth checkin and check out. Highly recommend for those wanting a classic Porto experience!

This stay was a top for us! The patio was an amazing place to relax and unwind in the morning and evenings. The place was quite spacious, beds were very comfortable, and overall just a wonderful location!!
A great location to explore Porto! You can't beat the view and patio area. Check-in was very smooth, and our host had great recommendations. Thank you!

Amazing place right in the center of Porto with the most spectacular views and old city charm. Almost makes you not want to leave and explore the city. Beautiful patio with trees growing and a great look at the river, bridge, and port houses across the way.

Beautiful location - the views from the yard are exactly as pictured with every bedroom having a stunning view of the bridge and river. The area is close to many main attractions and makes it easy to navigate Porto.
Note that the walls are a bit thin so at times, you can hear people in other apartments - this didn't bother us, but can be good to know!

Beautiful place with lots of character and amazing views!
It was a bit hard to locate with Uber.

Fernando was a welcoming and gracious host. Our first impression was very good as he had an irish flag flying next to the portuguese flag at the front of the house when we arrived. This was a nice touch. He was very helpful to us throughout our stay. The property exceeded our expectations (first time Airbnb users) and was as listed. We are a family of 6 and managed without a car pretty well, Fernando's house is a 5-10 min walk to shops and beach, about 25 min walk to Mindelo metro station. The metro is direct into Porto (about 30 min) and you can get to the airport with one line change. We found Mindelo town quite spread out but local shops and takeaway were good and Restaurante Rubens Dunas was very good with big portions.

Carla's apartment was excellent!!! It was very clean and comfortable, in such a beautiful and characteristic street in the middle of the historical centre of Oporto. Carla welcomed us very kindly and she adviced us lots of places to visit and experience to do in the city, and she also adviced us a little typical restaurant that was very cheap and had such great food! Thank you Carla we really enjoyned it, and we hope to come back soon :)

Willy & Cristina

A pleasant accomodation, very close to all the major sights of Porto. Well-equipped and comfortable apartament. The whole "procedures" part was smooth. On the whole, it's definitely a place to recommend if you plan to stay in Porto!

Lovely refurbished apartment in the old town of Porto.
Right in the middle of everywhere, but still quiet and relaxing.

Very helpful and friendly host - thanks Carla :-)

Simply perfect. Very welcoming host and easy check-in. Super helpful and willing to explain everything we want to know about the city, really making this trip into one which cannot be forgotten.
The apartment is all one could ask for: clean, tidy, pretty, spacious and comfortable. Also it is situated in a great neighborhood, close to everything and very lively. If you are coming to Porto do not hesitate, stay here!!

This apartment was in the historic city center of Porto, a great location with shops and restaurants within easy walking distance.  It was very clean and tidy, and had all the amenities we needed.  We stayed out late every night, and felt safe walking home.  We look forward to visiting again soon...

We had a wonderful time at Marco's unit! The apartment was perfect to settle into for a couple days, and the perfect location - accessible to great food and exploration spots while still having a neighborhood vibe and calmness. We also received excellent suggestions for dinner and sites to visit; we felt very welcomed and would absolutely stay here again.
A lovely appartment, perfectly situated right in the heart of Porto. Marco was kind and welcoming from the start. Highly rated!

We are very satisfied about Marco's appartment . In spite of not meeting him and his wife, we enjoyed very much our last week-end in Porto .
This home is very well located. Everything is close concerning visits, restaurants.
Otherwise, we particularly liked the charm , the quietness and the cleanliness of this well-equipped location.
We do recommand this Airbnb home which has a good value for money.
Thank you to Marco and Carla about everything
.... and maybe see you soon for an other time
Valérie et Philippe
Great place in the middle of Porto. Our check-in was particularly easy with our host greeting us with keys and advice for our stay.

This is a great place to stay with a fabulous host. You can walk to many cool places in the areas, like the food hall, the botanical gardens and planetarium. The metro is nearby so you can get around easily and Chris is a cool guy who is more than helpful with sharing knowledge about what to do.

The apartment is spacious, clean, well equipped and in a very handy location.
Carla was a great host and a pleasure to deal with.
The place was perfectly clean, and the location is very convenient. Only negative point is that it was quite noisy. But overall we really enjoyed our stay!
The place was in a great location. It was super close to the river, main attractions, and lots of restaurants. Marco was very friendly and responsive.

Amazing host, very responsive. The place was clean when we arrived. Location was great too, walkable to the main area of the city centre but far enough that it is quiet so easy to sleep.
Well worth it and would recommend every time.

We had a great time in Porto and the apartment  was just the perfect way to enjoy it in a relaxing and luxurious way. We did not meet Carla herself but Sónia helped us with the key so that was perfect too. I would highly recommend this apartment for a visit in beautiful Porto!

Very cool apartment, absolutely loved it! Carla was very responsive too. The only thing that was difficult was the keys getting into the building and gate, but luckily there was a very nice security guard to help ☺️
It is a great and comfortable apartman with very good location, where the owner is really helpful and flexible.

Simple and basic accomodation. The flat is not so cosy but it still fulfils the purpose. João was answering really fast. Luckily we were in Porto at weekend so the parking was for free. Parking could be a little problematic during the week.

We spent a great long weekend in Helena's apartment. The apartment was clean and looked exactly the same as it was in the photos, the mattress is really comfortable and you have everything you need to cook. When we got to the apartment location, Helena's husband met us there and explained us everything we might need related to the apartment and to the neighborhood, he gave us some pieces of advice about what to visit, where to eat and so on. If I came back to Oporto I’d definitely stay in Helena’s place.

Helena's place is in a great area away from the touristy places with a nice neighborhood feeling.   It is close to the bus station within easy walking distance of most of the sites.  The view of the park is very nice and peaceful.  Oh, Casa Guedes is just a few doors away!

Helena was lovely as well as her apartment.  It is exactly how it's shown on Airbnb.  After a long day of trekking up and down porto, it was nice to come back to a comforting and cozy apt. It is also in a prime location as its close proximity to the city center and the main train station which allowed easy access to transportation.

Helena's and Artur's apartment is very comfortable. Although it's little bit smaller than we had expected but we could comfortably accommodate ourselves. We were 5, including two kids. The apartment would be ideal for a couple or family with one child.

We received warm welcome from Artur as soon as we arrived. He provided us with a good guidance including the recommended taxi service with an English speaking driver.

The apartment is ideally located in the city center with big supermarket and lots of local restaurants nearby. Cafe Majestic and Rua Santa Catarina (the main shopping area) is within 5 minutes walking distance. In fact, all major tourist destinations are in walking distance.

The apartment is cozy and clean with a well-equipped kitchen.

We highly recommend this apartment to those who want to have a comfortable stay in Porto.

We had a perfect stay in this apartment! The apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfortable, confortable bed and pillows, great lounge. The kitchen is modern and clean. There are restaurants and supermarkets all around it, and a great bakery just downstairs from the apartment.
You can easily walk to everywhere in Porto and will get to the tower in max 20 minutes.
The check in and the hosts are very professional and efficient.
Highly recommended!
The apartment is in a great central location for exploring Porto and easy to get to from the train station and airport. Loved the bakery next door for morning coffee and treats!
The apartment is well located to explore the city. Everything you need is there. Thank you for the stay.
Great place, we enjoyed our short stay. Apartment had everything that we needed. Host was very friendly and communicated great. Very central location, everything is close by. Definitely recommend.

Isabel was a great host and her home is lovely, clean and comfortable! I had a great stay and I warmly want to thank Isabel for her hospitality :-)  The apartment is very well located in the heart of Vila do Conde, 10-15 min walk to metro and beach!
Isabel is a great host. Nice house, clean room with individual bathroom. I can fully recommend staying at Isabel's.

Nice welcome, Cristela gave us some good advice about the city and some adresses to go. The appartment was clean and exactly like the pictures discribed. A surplus was the hammock on the balcony, which was ideal to drink some wine before dinner :) breakfast was included and the bacon and eggs we asked for tased really good.
We really liked our stay there and were not ready to leave so soon, thanks!

Amazing flat! Just as it is in the pictures: big, spacious, cool and cozy. Plus is comfortable and central . Joao is nice and he gave us good advices
Super !

Absolutely loved our stay - very responsive, Maja met us early so we could drop our bags off and explore the city, and the place itself is great. The craft beer bar next door is awesome too, great place to hang out and added a lot to the experience. Would love to stay again!
Nicely renovated apartment in the heart of Porto. You can reach nearly anything by foot and the host offered some nice tipps to eat and do

Mord’s place is great - not just because of its location and design, but also because it is simply well hosted. Isabelle was a quick and responsive communicator from the beginning, met us at the flat to make sure we got in and settled, and was quick to respond anytime we needed anything.
It’s true that there is a bar out back - but if you’re a night owl, you won’t have too much to worry about.
Highly recommend!
A big plus for us was that the flat has a terrace. The appartment was clean and had everything we needed. It is located in the centre with everything on walking distance.

Hugo's flat is in a superb location in Porto. It has the great combination of being in a lovely old building but renovated in a modern and well thought out way. There are some lovely design touches - him and his wife have great taste. Hugo was there waiting for us when we arrived with a smile, and a welcoming glass of port was much appreciated as well!
This place comes highly recommended. Our only regret is that we didn't book it for longer.
Apartment is just great and perfectly located. Very nicely decorated and clean. We enjoyed our stay and can only recommend toc toc studio !!!

My husband and I had a really enjoyable stay at Hugo's lovely and cozy apartment.  The location was very ideal and within walking access to all the major sites in Porto.  The waterfront was only a 10 minute stroll as was the commercial center of Porto.  The apartment is tastefully decorated and exceptionally clean and fully stocked with coffee, tea, extra towels, pillows and blankets.  There's everything we needed for a comfortable weekend stay and the nice, firm bed was a bonus. Location was quiet and peaceful at night as well.  Although we didn't meet Hugo personally but his friend met with us to hand over the keys and she was very friendly and prompt.  All in all, we had a very good experience at a reasonable cost.  We were very happy all around and would definitely stay again if we're ever in Porto again.

Hugo was a gem! Great, thorough recommendations for the area, and beyond. Super nice, helpful, communicative guy. The location of this charming little apartment couldn't be better. It was gorgeous, clean, comfortable and well-equipped. You can tell a lot of love went into putting the place together. We had a wonderful time.

We had such an amazing time at Toc Toc studio. Hugo promptly met us outside the building and gave us a very thorough and friendly tour. Everything about the studio was perfect. Everything we needed was there, big amazing windows, and central location. Hugo had complimentary port waiting for us which was wonderful. Hugo had fantastic suggestions for enjoying Porto. We definitely recommend Toc Toc Studio. Thanks Hugo!
Very nice days  in Porto. The appartment was in a perfect situation to visit and have fiesta. Thanks Hugo for the advices.

Hugo gave us a very useful tour of the apartment when we arrived and was very welcoming. The apartment is very nicely decorated and well equipped. The location was perfect for us, just next to the city centre and an easy walk to everything. Thanks for a lovely stay. Would definitely recommend.
The apartment is great,wonderful location in center.Hugo is a great host.We have had a lovely few days in Porto.

We had a fantastic stay in hugo's apartment! He was a wonderful host and greeted us warmly with a map of the best sights and restaurants in Porto.  The flat is just as beautiful as it looks in the photos, with everything you need and in a superb location. Thanks Hugo!

This was a perfect place to stay. The house is fully equipped with whatever you may need, is spotlessly clean, super close to everything Porto has to offer, and Hugo was extremely communicative and a real professional host.
Highly recommended if staying in Porto!

Hugo is a great host. He will give you tips and show you around. Very helpfull.
We have enjoyed our stay at toc toc studio.
The location is top, the appartment modern andnice to stay.
We have got a nice Port from Hugo.
The kitchen and bathroom have all you will need.
Great restaurants are nearby and you can walk everywhete.

Yes, the place is great, accurate, clean and in a phenomenal location. Would stay here again.
What I need to emphasize though is how wonderful of a host Hugo is. I’ve been to many Airbnb’s through the years and Hugo went above and beyond any host I’ve previously encountered. From communication to his personalized recommendation map (what a touch!), my trip was completely enhanced because of Hugo.
Hugo and Paula were amazing hosts - helped us get in and out, gave us local tips, and were super accommodating. The apartment is super nice and in an amazing location.

Hugo was a delightful host, with great tips to share about Porto. Toctoc studio is perfect for a short stay in Porto, very well situated (near the photographic museum, the miradouro and  a great tapas joint all worth a visit). Bright place, very comfortable bed and a welcome complimentary carafe of port. Highly recommended.

Porto is a beautiful, walkable city, and Hugo’s place sits on a lovely quiet street just 2 minutes from shops and restaurants. There is a park, a gelato shop, a wine bar, and a cozy restaurant just at the doorstep. Hugo was amazingly gracious and took the time to tell me all his recommendations for the city—I went to all and was not disappointed once! highly recommend

Hugo is a spectacular host! The space is perfectly located in the city, close to markets, restaurants, shops, etc...  Our flight arrived late and Hugo was so kind to wait until 1:00am to meet us at the airbnb. Gave us wonderful recommendations and even port wine as a welcome drink. He arranged a taxi driver to pick us up from the airport- Tiago, which also provided us with a great service. Will stay here my next time in Porto!

Toc toc studio is everything you need for a porto getaway. The location is great. The interior is tastefully decorated and had everything you might need. Last but not least, the host Hugo is super nice and makes you feel at home. Also he shares a lot of good tips to see, do and eat. We will definitely return!
Hugo went above and beyond to make sure we could have had the best possible time in Porto. The place was immaculate and comfortable. I wish every host was as great as Hugo.

The Toc Toc studio was the perfect spot for our getaway to Porto. The location was perfect and made hitting all that Porto has to see easy in just 3 days. Hugo was a great host and his suggestions were spot on!

A beautiful apartment right in the heart of Porto! Lots of places to eat within a 10 minute walk and all of it is outside the touristy area. Also an easy Uber to and from the train station. Easy to walk or take an Uber to the Port Cellar district across the river.
We loved staying in Hugo’s place! Perfect location and very comfortable apartment. Hugo was very communicative and we had no issues at all. Highly recommend!
Hugo was an excellent host and we loved our stay at his place in Porto! Super convenient location and the studio had everything we needed.

Hugo provided clear instructions on how to check-in and how to use the AC/heating system. He also provided some port wine for us to try! The space had everything we needed and everything was within walking distance. The only thing to note is that he warned us of a recent water leak in the ceiling, right about the shower. Luckily, it seemed like the leaking had stopped by the time of our stay but there was some visible water damage and a bit of a smell. It wasn't really ideal but I understand that it was out of Hugo's control. Over all, we were pretty happy with our stay and Hugo's communication!

The apartment is just wonderful! I totally recommend it and it will be definitely my choice for the next trip to Porto. It’s everything you need and more. Very nice and cozy, with lots of cool details. The location is perfect - very close to all the main attractions and to Ribeira. Near the beautiful park. Hugo is the great host, very responsive and attentive. The communication was smooth and friendly (additional thanks for the welcome gift - a bottle of port wine :)
I enjoyed my stay so much! It was my first time in Porto and the apartment was a part of unforgettable experience. I really recommend to stay here!
Very good journey, the apartment is really nice and very well situated. Hug and his friend are very friendly.

Hugo’s place was very easy to find and he provided helpful instructions on how to get to it. It was located in a great neighbourhood and located within close proximity to various restaurants and monuments. The apartment was fairly well maintained and not too loud at night which was great! We would recommend!

Nice touch bottle of wine and cheese and ham on arrival. Very comfortable well furnished apartment in excellent central location. Nice sunsets on the balcony. Be careful construction across the street but quiet at the weekend while we were there.
Nice location near the river and only a short distance from the edge of town. Can get a little chilly in the wintertime, but a great place for exploring the town of Porto.

If you are looking for a central place, this is the right spot. Close to everything , transportation, restaurant, shopping and more. Juliana is a lovely person, very helpful and dedicated to her guests.

We had a great stay here with our family of 5. It's quite near to the metro, and there's a little market next door. Juliana was a great host, with quick communication. She even helped us track down our daughter's lost camera!
Great location, close to all the main attractions. Amenities were superb. Size was very large for European standards. We had a great stay and would come again!

Very beatiful appartment... very well situated and very well
equipped. 5/5. We recommand you it.

Very nice location. Close from city center, station, and the market.
We would definitely visit again.
We really loved our stay in Porto, greatly because of the experience we had at our stay. Joao was really helpful in the check in process. Thanks for having us!
We had a great stay, the terrace is nice and private and very comfortable with two bedrooms and two bathrooms

This is an amazing location for peace, quiet, beautiful views and great hiking trails. There is everything you need created with great hospitality in mind. We loved the delicious complimentary jam and port as well. We’ll surely be back to this beautiful area.
Mario was great, checked to see that we are all ok and we have all we need.

Thank you Mario! We had a great time in your place and only wished that we could have stayed longer!
We loved the space and your app! We will definitely come back to Porto!
Amy
We enjoy our stay at Mario’s! It was located in a great area with easy access to the Metro. It was walking distance to a lot of places that we wanted to see and do.
This is the first time that I used the airbnb, and it was a wonderful experience! They are really good host!!! My friend and me had a wonderful weekend in Porto!!!
Perfect host and accommodation.  Great location. We were only there for one night but would have liked to stay longer.

Perfect for a central location to Porto City. Apartment is clean and exactly as it is in the pictures, a little smaller than expected but perfectly comfortable. Tea is included, but if arriving late its best to order a welcome pack. As we arrived late with hangry children and too late for takeaway delivery this was at 11:30...not good after a long day traveling.
Fantastic, stylish and comfortable flat in a great central location. Has all mod cons. We would definitely return. Christina was really friendly and helpful. A real gem in Porto!
Very nice apartment, not far from the water. You can do anything by walk or by bike. We very much enjoyed our stay!
very charmed and central apartment. the host is symphathic and helped me / us with sightseeing points of the city. everything was totally fine ;)

What a beautiful and perfect place to discover Porto! Right in the middle of the art districts all you need to see is around. Eduardo was an amazing host! Very understanding and flexible. I will come back to his apartment! Namaste

Host is amazing! Very helpful.  We got towed and couldn't have gotten the car back without him.  He even drove us to pick up the apartment.  Apartment is very nice, clean, good location and there are so many treats left for you to make you feel welcome!  Such a good stop, wish we could have stayed longer!

Such a great apartment! It is pretty close to the centre of Porto and Eduardo was very helpful to locate everything on our map. The apartment is superclean and very nicely decorated! Towels, toiletpaper, sheets, ... everything is provided.
Incredible location and spot. The apartment is huge and very nicely situated. I was beyond impressed with the accommodations and value.

I loved my stay at Helena and Eduardo’s apartment, very clean and spacious and has everything you need! Good location, only a short walk from the main centre.
Only downside was the people upstairs were quite noisy late at night but there’s nothing that can really be done about that.
Perfect location and lovely host.  I have stayed here before several years ago and would certainly do so again if coming to Porto.

This is a truly amazing apartment right on the seaside, with fantastic views of the sunset. We had an absolutely amazing time. The apartment is modern, clean and with all the amenities you need. Parking is easy just in front of the building.
A nice apartment! Extra cozy with a good fire place which made it nice even in rainy season.

We searched for a long time before we founded the house, we did not know where we had to get off the bus and wich way we had to follow.
When we arrived everything was very good, Bernardo's mother, Suzanna, let us into the surf house and it looked exactly like the pictures.
The house is very cosy! If you like to surf or kitesurf this is the ideal place. You get to the beach by walinking 5min. If you want to lay down at the beach, it can get very cold because there is a lot of wind.
Next to the house there is a busstop where you can take the bus to the centre of Porto, +-40 min.
Lovely house, nice stay, thanks a lot Suzanna!

We really loved the little villa. It is close to the beach and the center of Porto is easily accessible.
We haven't seen Bernardo but he responded great to all our questions before our stay. Again thank you Suzanne, for being a wonderful host!!

Thank you Suzana and Bernardo for making our stay in Vila Nova de Gaia WONDERFUL!!!!!!!! Everything that I read on the reviews was exactly as described and more!! Suzana helped us with tips about  Porto , supermarkets and restaurants .She also provided us with things that we forgot to bring... The house was spotless,  a walking distance to the beach and easy access to public transportation. I HIGHLY recommend this place!!!!!

Very nice little apartment, cozy and super lovely hosts. We could choose to have twin or double beds. Everything was clean. Location is good, few min walk from the beach with a good path for running or walking. Porto easy to reach by car, uber or A longer walk and boat. It‘s been a pleasure staying with Suzana and Bernardo. Also the surf lesson with Bernardo was very very nice.

A great place to stay with wonderful hosts. added bonuses were that we got to have a brilliant paddle-boarding induction on the river and to enjoy the company of  the 2 friendly dogs. We thoroughly recommend this place.
I highly recommend this place. It is in a perfect location, and the flat is really clean and well kept.
Great location, great house. I didn't find it tiny. Only problem: it can easily get hot in the house especially when you cook

We with my mom and sister had a great time in Abel`s apartment. Its modern, bright and very comfortable, equipped with all necessities. Location is just perfect - in a walking distance of everything, including train station. One more important thing - apt equipped with general heating, which is really important cuz its cold in the night)

Hosts were very helpful suggesting some restaurants and other places. If I come to Porto again Id defenetly want to stay in this beautiful central apartment. And of course i reccomend my friends this place!

Perfect stay in the heart of Porto. Just a few walking minutes to the night life centre and the river. Abel was a kind host who had nice recommendations that helped a lot. The apartment is as fancy as in the pictures and has everything you need to recover from long days and nights in Porto.
Arne

I had a wonderful introduction to Porto (and Airbnb) thanks to Rose and Abel. Rose was a wonderful hostess. Her warm welcome and thoughtful guidance helped me to make the most of my stay in Porto. Abel's apartment was even nicer than the pictures and the location could not have been better.

This stylish, centrally located base was perfect. It was so clean and well-appointed that I felt completely at home. I am already planning my next trip to Porto which of course will be scheduled around the availability of Abel's flat!

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Was perfect for our group of 3 guys but could have had room for one or two more people overall. Rose and Abel really lovely hosts and very helpful during our stay
The apartment is really beatutiful and is located in a very beautiful square, close to all interesting places in Porto. It was clean and had everything you need (shets, towels...)

I waited a 5 days to write this review as I like to give a chance to people to explain why things are the way it is. But I didn't receive any response so far!
Anyhow, I was disappointed with the place because the heat was not working and it was a cold night. After sleeping with my coat on, I was looking for a nice shower in the morning but the water was soooo hot with no way of regulate it!!! My friend tried as well with no luck. I can't explain any better than this. I got sick actually from being cold that night. Otherwise, the location is perfect and the apartment pleasant. The bathroom can definitely use some TLC. I hope they fix those couple issues and communicate better with people in the future as it is a great place overall. :-((
We had a lovely stay at this flat. Location was perfect and the space was very clean. It can be a bit loud at night (I think on the weekends), but we weren't bothered. Highly recommend.

We had an amazing trip in Porto and were extremely satisfied with the appartment of Olga and her husband! The appartment is really spacious and clean, has all the comfort we needed and is the best equiped accomodation we have ever had in this price range! To be honest, the appartment is better than the photos that are provided on AirBnB. Next June we are returning to Porto, and depending on the amount of friends we are coming with, we will certainly return to this appartment! The location couldn't be better, the terrasse is wonderful to enjoy a great vinho verde (sorry Olga for the glass deposit we have left... :-)).
Olga and her husband were extremely kind and always available for questions or information and were very flexible in terms of checkin and checkout. Thanks for the nice pastel de nata at our arrival! All the best.

Olga and Paulo are very welcoming and helpful persons, have gave us a lot of useful recommendations about spending the time at Porto. Their  stylish decorated, very neat and good equipped appartement  is located in the very heart of Porto only 20 min away from the main square on foot and 30 min from the other side of the river. There may be some problem for eldery people with the spiral stairs in the appartement, as it is realy steep. But it worked for us. We can highly recommended the romantic apartement.

We had an amazing stay thanks to Paulo and Olga, lovely couple friendly and warm! Everything about the apartment is perfect, good location (walkable distance from everything), clean and well equipped. They made our stay at Porto just like home helping us with everything needed. Absolutely recommended!

Olga and Paulo were welcoming and helpful giving us little present, sending e-mails with hints and tips for public transport, lists of restaurants, bars and advising what to see. They are really friendly and nice people.
Tha apartement is amazing with great location. It was clean, tidy, equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The flat is for short walk from metro station, surrounded by little restaurants and tourist attractions are in the neighbourhood.
The place was very clean and just like I expected from the pictures. What I valued most was friendliness and quick answers to any questions.
Wonderful house in Porto city centre. Host is excellent and other thing in that house is excellent too.
The place was central and not noisy even if the flat is on the main street.  Joao was very kind with us and he share many infos very helpful for us.  Ask him about his famous restaurant !

Great experience! The host was very helpful and the house was amazing. The neighbourhood is really nice, and close to the center. I'll be saving this one for future visits to Porto. Would recommend to friends and family!

We enjoyed our stay - there was street parking right out the front , room to move around in the apartment and even a nice view from the bedroom. It was exactly what we were looking for and would recommend.
Alexandre and Sonia were very friendly and we enjoyed our stay! It was very clean and beautiful. Any problems that arose were quickly resolved by them, recommend anyone to stay there 🫰

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Fernando's place. Stunning place in an excellent location, a very friendly host and the actual look and feel even better than the pictures. With some extras such as a washing machine that add to the benefits of his place.
And the welcoming with some beers, wine, snacks and fruit was such a nice touch. I can highly recommend this for a great stay in Porto.
Many thanks Fernando!

Rita is a great host!
The place is great..great location . You can walk everywhere. Near all the main attractions, restaurants and all transportations: taxi, train and bus. Small grocery store near by and even a gym!
Thé place was super clean , very modern perfect for a couple . The apartment is on the third floor with no elevator…. But who cares…lol
I would go back for sure!!
Thank you Rita for letting us stay in your lovely apartment.
We loved staying in Porto! The apartment is beautiful and extremely well located. Everything was super clean, and there was a metro 5 minutes away. We recommend! Thank you so much, Ana.

Amazing location, me & my girlfriend like going out late night, the area is safe full of life during the day and night (enough noise for people who like nightlife), downstairs cafe for quick and fast breakfast. We enjoy hot temperatures during August, the fan provided was enough for me & my girlfriend.

Mateus made us feel very welcome and was kind enough to wait for us at the apartment when we got delayed. The apartment is very nice. It is located on the second floor. There was coffee, tea and water available. The apartment was clean and spacious. The bathroom a little small but this did not bother us.  The apartment is wel located with plenty off shops and restaurants nearby. Although on a shopping street inside the apartment it is quiet. Communication with Mateus was easy! We would recommend it!

We felt right at home from home.
Great access to public transit, markets, and stores.
It is a charming apartmen!

Perfect place for two! Great location, just outside the louder main city center and 10 min walk from a beautiful park and the cool local art gallery area - everything is very walkable (max 15 mins to the bridge). We enjoyed the little grocery on the street. The host was very responsive and helpful

This place was fantastic and super functional for our Porto experience. Mateus and the hosts were very attentive and proactive with their suggestions and assistance. The apartment is in a great location which is close to restaurants, bars, major sights, parks and public transport. It was clean and had all the ammenities you need + there’s a inexpensive laundromat nearby if you need.  Definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Porto.

Pedro's place was great! Big, clean and with amazing tarrace. We found everything we needed. It's just 10 minutes by walk to the river side and a few minutes to metro station.
Pedro is very helpful and kind person. He visited us to check if everything is alright and if we need anything.
We spent a fantastic time in his apartment and for sure back there next time.

Porto is so shockingly beautiful, but you need a guy like Pedro to understand it is not just the natural beauty, it's also the people and the atmosphere that make it so amazing. Pedro is everything you would need from a host -  friendly, positive, and has deep knowledge about everything in Porto. Thanks to him we saw the best of the city (on foot) in just 24h, and we even had time for a great seafood diner in a local restaurant. All the rooms including the bathroom and the kitchen are very spacious so you don't feel squeezed. It is nicely furnished and very clean too ... and then you get the view - right at your doorstep you have a view of the river, the old town, the bridges. It's not just a place to stay, it is a miradouro! If you don't know that word - just go to Porto, and see Pedro, we will surely return some day!

Pedro's appartment is exquisitely well located on the south bank of the city. The walk from there to the river offers a spectacular view on the old city, the river, the boats, the impressive Dom Luis bridge, and you find yourself in a few minutes in one of the prime touristic areas of the city, filled with merchant's souvenirs stands, cafés and restaurants.
The appartment is welcoming, roomy, comfortable and well equipped. Communication with Pedro was pleasant, indications were clear, access to the appartment utterly easy.
Only downside, the touristic area isn't quite so car-friendly (traffic can be busy during day-time and parking lots full, with backed-up lines), and the expected parking lot nearby was under construction and unavailable. Just be aware and organize consequently.
Other than that, I highly recommend staying there, the location is fantastic.
Fantastic spot in a perfect location, very responsive host and we followed his itenery and toured Porto and it was perfect. Would come again.
Very central, many things are reachable by foot and clean apartment. Pedro is one of the friendliest hosts we had!

Pedro's place was a great place to stay for our 4 day visit. Quiet area for sleeping, but easily walkable and close to all Porto has to see.
There is a carpark down the hill near the bridge where you can leave your car and come and go as often as you want for reasonable cost (we drove to the North for a day excursion one day, also very beautiful).
The home was clean and plenty of space for us.
Pedro was very responsive and made some great suggestions.
One thing to keep in mind is that there are three flights of stairs down to the apartment from the road.
Thanks again Pedro, I will definitely stay again if I come back to Porto.
Pedro was quick and easy to deal with.. place was clean and easy to find. Close to everything.. bars, resultant t’s clubs.. it’s a walk.. but the city is on a hill so I lu can expect any different

Basic clean apartment in a great location -- lots of good eats on the same block and a short walk away!. Rafael was great with communication and check in was super smooth. We stayed for a short time 1 night before our flight out. Not noisy at all. I liked the black out shutters as well!
Very well located, clean and charming. Very quiet, well isolated, even with this noisy street.

A great studio near the city center. The place is clean  and tidy. sometimes you can hear people on the building as the walls are not very sound proofing, but not enough to wake you. The hosts were great and very quick to set up the place as we booked with short notice. It was overall a great stay for a city break.

We stayed three nights in Porto and the apartment was terrific. It was in a perfect location, was clean and bright, stylish, and very well stocked with all we could need. I would recommend this apartment (and probably all the apartments in the building) wholeheartedly. It was lovely to come back to after a day of seeing Porto. Anne was very helpful, especially in her recommendation of the amazing restaurant FLOW.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment and in Porto - it's a great location. The apartment itself is really comfortable and spacious, good for friends. The hosts were really helpful and reliable, offering to take us for coffee when we arrived. I'd highly recommend staying here for sure.

we had a lovely stay the apartment was very nice big and clean every thing we needed in it, the host were very helpful and easy to contact.
it was a little hard to find, location fab right in the centre of town and only a few minutes from the station. if we come back to porto again we will defiantly book this one
The apartment is very spacious and in a perfect locations for a quick visit to an amazing city. Strongly recommend it to anyone going to Porto.

The flat is fantastic and absolutely exceeds your expectations. The location could not be betterif you asked, right next to livraria Lello with a fantastic gelateria next door also. Fantastic flat in an absolutely wonderful city, could not reccomend more.
Good location, comfortable space.  The bar and street noise is as per previous reviews so you must be prepared for that. It was a good choice for us.

Spacious apartment in the hustling and bustling neighborhood of Porto. If you are ok with staying above a bar (that can get a bit noisy), the location cannot be more perfect. We had no problem exploring Porto on foot and had an amazing stay at this apartment.
Perfectly situated in the city centre but still quiet inside.  Nicely laid out apartment with tons of space. We loved the place and would highly recommend to anyone. Thanks for a great stay!

A lovely place with great facilities. Very comfortable and great hosts. We especially enjoyed the swimming pool. Sadly we didn't have room in our car for Cookie the dog so he will be there to greet you.

We had a very nice stay in Jose house. The house was perfect for us, with the very nice garden, swimming pool and all playing facilities. Every morning we were surprised by fresh sandwiches. Also the presence of your dog Cookie was a nice surprise for us and the children
The location of the house is also beautiful, in nature, but close to Arouca, perfect for hiking in the Arouca geopark mountains or a short trip to visit the beautiful city of Porto.
Jose, his wife and sons were alway very helpfull to us, they even send us clothes that we forgot when leaving.
See you a next time!
Andy, Heidi, Kobe, Bo and Anaïs
Belgium

Communication with the hosts was very good, nice location and pleasant apartment. However, the house is made of wood so you could literally hear every step from the people upstairs. But overall is was a decent place and we enjoyed our time there.

The place ticks every box! It’s very near to all the important places that you want to visit; all within walking distance. Apart from that, the flat is equipped for the entire duration of your stay. Highly recommended 🤩
Great location on a quieter street but still nearby all. Everything was easy and very clean! Rute was friendly, accessible and flexible. Would stay again :)

Lovely place! Close to the train station and downtown. The apartment was really nice and clean, but the walls are thin so you can hear your neighbours pretty well;) other than that it’s a pretty good deal!

I could not recommend this airbnb more! When you dream of moving to a city and having a studio apartment - this is what you dream of! The terrace is incredible, the views at sunset are to die for and it is the perfect place to relax with a glass of wine or have your morning coffee. The inside is decorated so beautifully and I genuinely did not want to leave! Marcia was so kind to not only leave us breakfast but also some little cakes to get us through the long walks of the day!
Location is perfect! It is close enough to the tourist hub (15 minutes walk maybe?) but also in an amazing spot of its own with cool bars and restaurants!
I would recommend this airbnb to any of my friends and family! We can't thank you enough!

Marcia is very very communicative and nice. She replied to our questions instantly and she gave all the useful information. The house is situated in a very strategic place and easily accesible to the city center. The house is very clean and well equipped. The balcony is absolutely a luxury. Highly recommend without any hesitation :)
This place is the best. The rooftop is wonderful and the kitchen is stocked with plenty of food and beverages.

Beautiful and well located flat, exactly like in the pictures. Check in was very easy and Marcia was always contactable in case we needed anything. She also provided us with excellent tips about where to eat in the area.
Really nice place, good communication with super friendly Marcia who fix any problem or question super quickly, a small coffee machine could be nice :)

We had a lovely stay in your apartment - thank you !!
The contact with Marcia was easy and quick, everything was clean and the apartment is really cute. I can really recommend it 👍🏻

Marcia was an amazing host!
Replying to any questions we had or any enquiries we had!
The apartment itself was amazing, very clean and in the perfect location!
Would highly recommend if travelling to Porto!
Thanks again for everything!

The flat is indeed at a perfect location. It's striking that you can find some local shops and restaurants on the same street, making the area very trendy.
There's a large terrace, which unfortunately we didn't get to enjoy because of the weather, so maybe consider spring onwards to visit Porto.
Otherwise, Marcia communicates everything efficiently and even allowed us to have a late check out. Highly recommended without a single doubt

Great place very well situated downtown with a very nice terrace.
Host very kind and helpfull.

If you are looking for somewhere to stay, look no further! This is the place to be in Porto. Walking distance to everything, public transport nearby, and with great hosts who make every second of your stay comfortable. The apartment is clean and beautiful- if I was moving to Porto I would move into this Airbnb! Thank you Patricia and Rui!
The host was very friendly and warm. Welcomed us at the time we set, and gave us tips for activities in and around   Porto. The bnb itself was very clean.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Porto. We thought it looked better in real life than in the photographs, especially the outside terrace which is fantastic and a perfect place to relax! We arrived on the day of the power cut in Portugal and Patricia and Rui were great during this situation, being very accommodating about the timing of our arrival and made us feel a lot calmer about everything. The apartment is in an amazing location, close to lots of shops, bars, cafes, restaurants and within walking distance to all of the main sights in Porto. We would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend it.

Catarina's apartment was the perfect choice for us as it has great location and was spacious enough for four adults. The apartment was comfortable, clean and well-equipped and not least had a great view. Catarina's father, Antonio was super helpful and he could speak just enough English so he could explain us everything and shown us around a bit. I could only recommend to stay at Catarina's place :)

The check-in experience was one of the best we ever had: Antonio was waiting for us at the airport and drove us straight to the apartment while giving all kinds of tips for our stay (being a local to Porto).
The apartment itself was very spacious and could easily fit our family of four (we have one toddler and one baby), including two modern bathrooms. There are two elevators which came in handy to bring everything up. There were also some thoughtful amenities, like a trolley to go to the supermarket.
The apartment is also well connected to the city: it is within 1 minute of a metro stop, there is a taxi rank right behind the little chapel uphill, and also some main bus lines within easy walking distance.
Overall we would recommend anyone to stay here!

Highly recommend! The apartment was clean, very spacious and had an amazing balcony. Antonio picked us up from the airport and dropped us off as well. He gave us plenty of local restaurants to try and overall he gave our stay a nice personal touch.

We had an extraordinary time in Porto.
The flat is central with everything next to it.
We recommended this place and Manuela is very kind.
Thanks again !!!
Emily and romain

Location is great. Very central.
We stayed for 3 nights. Family of 5.
With the public park near the apartment, we didnt used the car.
Great restaurants near by .
Apartment was well kept and modern.
Excellent location! It’s on a busy street but the windows were really good at keeping out the noise. Very comfortable apartment

We have arrived early in the morning and Manuela did her best to accomodate us earlier. The apartment is clean, has equiped kitchen, laundry. the location is excellent - walking distance to Ribeira. Many restaurants and a small grocery are around, and an underground parking is around the corner. Manuela provides very helpful info about local attractions, "out of bitten path" restaurants , and Marta, her associate, is around during the daytime to provide help and assistance. We enjoyed our stay, thank you.
Our stay at the apartment was fantastic! The location is unrivalled, and the hosts were very welcoming and communicative. Would definitely recommend.

Hands down the best hospitality we have ever received. Isabel is so wonderful. She met us for late check in, she spent some time with us showing us around Porto and giving us recommendations on what to do and eat which all were great. The apartment was sparkling clean, very spacious for our week stay and fast WiFi which is very important for us since we work virtually and need a reliable internet. Porto is a beautiful city but Isabel and her apartment made it even more memorable for us.  Oh and it’s in a great location. We walked everywhere.

Isabel was a super friendly host! :) She was really kind and always there when we needed something. We spent a wonderful trip at her apartment! It’s away from the touristic center (very quiet), but close enough to do everything by walking. The appartment had everything we needed and was super clean! The bathroom is freshly renovated with a nice shower too. We also loved all the cats from the neighbourhood! The grocery store is also very close (pingo doce). Would reserved there again for sure! This is the kind of experience that make you appreciate Airbnb! :)

We had a great time staying in Sofia's spacious beautiful apartment for five nights. It provides everything we need and more. Plus the sea views from inside and two bolcnies are fantastic. Communication with Sofia was great too. A wonderful vacation for us... Highly recommend!

We loved the place. Great for working remotly !
Is really close by to restaurants and to city centrum.

beautiful apartment with terrace and views. walkable to all areas. excellent space for 5 people, 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.  standing fans in each room were great since it was warm at night even in October. alexandra was amazing, helpful with map and lists of everythingto do. wonderful time, will be back!
home very nice, clean and in the center of porto. sonia is very nice and gave us good advices for our visit.
We enjoyed our stay at Sonia’s place. She provided lots of useful information on restaurants and activities. The pool was a bonus and the outdoor space lovely for being together.
Beautifully equiped, very well located but a bit noisy accommodation. A bit more and proactive communication by the hosts would have been appreciated.
Very cosy and perfect located apartment. I had to do a late night check in but that was no problem. This Airbnb is definitely recommendable.

If we could give 100 stars we would have! Sónia‘s place was beautiful, and had all of the modern amenities. As a super host I am very particular when it comes to traveling abroad, but I have absolutely nothing to recommend to Sónia. Everything she had there was perfect, from the toaster oven to the coffee pot to the book with instructions, everything! We loved it so much. We are returning again at the end of our trip to Portugal.
We had a great stay in Porto. The house is really nice and well situated. We received a very warm welcome and a lot of support by Diogo - a true „Superhost“. thanks again!

Joana and Diogo’s space was incredibly charming and unique! My friends and I had such a lovely time in Porto at their apartment. The rooms were perfect and everything in town was easy to get to. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a beautiful stay in Porto!
A wonderful stylish property in a really cool part of Porto. Diogo was a great host and too care of things very well. Recommended highly.

I’m hesitant to leave a public review because I want this place all for myself. The apartment is clean, serene, tastefully and austerely designed. The kitchen and bathroom are perhaps the most beautiful I’ve ever used. Easily walkable to the central part of the city but I hardly made it there because the neighborhood has all you could want. A quiet reprieve from the bustling city. Pedro was a great host, and I’ll be lucky to return again.
Pedro is a wonderful Host. His flat is amazing. Nearby are many restaurants and places to enjoy Porto. We loved our stay at Pedro's place!!!

The apartment is beautiful, such lovely spaces and architecture. The location is perfect, with lots of shops and restaurants around as well as being walkable to the city centre. We loved our stay here and the host was very friendly and helpful with recommendations

Best host ever. She peaked me up at the airport in her car for free and without me requesting it. The place is just as described. Big, with all you may need, privacy etc. It's 5 min by car to the airport or 20 by feet.
She gave me breakfast, suggestion and so on. I totally recommend it.

I arrived in Porto in the night and my host picked me up at the airport(for free). She was very accessible and easy to communicate with. Flat was very clean and there was a orange tree in the garden. I could smell the orange and it helped me to sleep well :) she also provided small breakfast. I definitely want to be back for another vacation!
This was a fabulous place to stay, very clean, convenient quiet and relaxed. A great base to explore the city of Porto.
Large clean apartments near the airport (25 minutes walk) and Metro (10 minutes walk). Breakfast  included. Célia is a wonderful host, so friendly. Highly recommend this place!
Celia was more than generous by picking me up from the airport, and of very kind nature.
so kind and thoughtful. had breakfast already set out for me and showed me the route to the airport late at night so i could there the next morning. overall perfect host!

It was so amazing to spend one day there!!!!!
I will never forget Celine and her big heart 🥺
She pick me up from the airport for free and allow to stay much more than I expected
Love and recommendation!

Very comfortable bad +
Orange tree in garden +
Terase +
Cold ground and not strong heating (the end of November) -

It was great!:) easy to reach the train that brings you to the center. Enough space to unbuild the bike and put it to the box. Very convenient from the distance to the airport. Thanks for hosting me!:)
Exceptionally friendly host and communication. Perfect for short stays (we are a family of 5 and came late in the evening and left again the next day).

João was a friendly and flexible host. Just when we arrived he had a map of Porto ready and showed us the main spots but also his favorite restaurants which are no tourist traps (we tried some if them and all served really delicious food). The flat is located perfectly just to get to know Porto by bike. And just next to the entrance of the flat was a bicycle shop where you could rent bikes.

Comfortable, nicely renovated apartment, perfectly located to discover the UNESCO protected old quarter of Porto. The host was extremely pleasant and helpful, and offered great suggestions to discover Porto (obrigado Joao!).

Accommodation to avoid when traveling with children.
Poorly equipped in the bathroom and in the kitchen.
Completely without any furnitures to hold things,
there isn’t a coat rack
or a shelf in which to place a little beauty-case.
It's nice to look at,
but very impractical with children.

Recommend to opt for heating during winter times as it can get quite cold at night. Otherwise, very central location, walking distance to most part of the city. 5 minute walk to a good breakfast place on flower street, 15 to the harbour side for some fantastic seafood.

Fantastic spot in the heart of Porto! Perfect walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go to in Porto. João was super helpful and attentive - sending great recommendations and advice. Would definitely come back to stay here again - perfect for 3/4 people - especially for two couples! Very spacious.
The place looks like the pictures. It's really nice and central, the balcony is great for breakfast in the Sun (even in January..!). It was very quiet and the bed is super comfortable.
The house was very clean and big enough for the three of us. The host was very friendly and the communication went smooth.

The apartment was beautiful, exactly as described.  There are several restaurants nearby and small grocery stores.  The apartment is on the ground floor so no need to carry luggage up the stairs.  We took an Uber from the airport and it cost around 15 Euros.  Porto is very hilly so wear comfortable walking shoes for going up and down the hills.  We had a great time and would recommend this apartment to anyone coming to Porto.

I don’t normally leave reviews, as it is just not my thing. But they provided such outstanding service when a family member left their mobile phone behind. We were two-thirds the way to Lisbon when we noticed. Within hours of calling them, they shipped the phone to Lisbon.
You can feel comfortable booking this place. It is as described. Great well stocked kitchen. Great bedrooms and bathrooms. The living room set up could be improved upon but that is very minor.
Go to Porto, drink wine, and enjoy this place.

Luis was a wonderful host and his apartment was beautiful - just as it looked in the photos! The apartment was cozy and had all the essentials and plenty of kitchen ware to prepare a meal at the flat. We loved the balcony which was caught the morning and afternoon sun! Perfect for breakfast or an afternoon snack! Both the bedroom and the lounge had beautiful views, and the bed was super comfortable!
Luis was a fabulous host - very responsive and gave great recommendations for cafes and restaurants. The flat was a great location - in the arts district and near to bars! We walked everywhere from his flat. Thank you, Luis, for a fantastic stay. We loved Porto!
We are glad that we have decided for your apartement. we have already looked at a lot. very central location.

Luís’ place was ideal for travellers coming to Porto for the first time.
The space is great. Very clean, nice amenities and a good balcony to sit on.
Luís met us when we arrived and gave us a rundown on Porto and an absolute trove of information of best of everything in Porto.
It meant our 3 days in were packed with quality activities and great food and wine.

We loved staying in Luis’s apartment in Porto. It was comfortable, thoughtfully decorated and close to the centre, perfect for sightseeing, and rambling about the beautiful streets of Porto.
