Luis welcomed us personally and shared lots of useful information for dining, shopping, culture and sightseeing. We found lovely places for breakfast nearby, and a gorgeous local wine bar around the corner. The only slight issue we had was the noise from a neighbouring building where renovation work was taking place, drilling and hammering started from approx 8am each day and was very loud. But apart from that we couldn’t fault any aspect of the apartment and would definitely like to return!

Me and my partner absolutely loved staying here! Luis was fab and offered so many recommendations that made our trip lovely! Luis was incredibly friendly and made us feel at home! Place was decorated lovely and had everything we needed! Bed was super comfy☺️

Luis is super nice.
The place isn’t right in the center of Porto but in a cool district, easy to walk to, and quiet.
We did everything by foot.
Thank for the warm welcome

Special neighborhood with small but adequate grocery nearby, art galleries, restaurants & walk-only street at the end.  Very quiet at night.  New bath & brief kitchen, host answered all our many questions.
Very experienced and efficient host. Apartment was just as advertised. Very clean and tidy. Nice and calm neighbourhood.
Highly recommended. Luís' apartment is elegant and in a chic, centrally located neighborhood. He is kind and accommodating.

My experience with Tina was absolutely amazing. I loved spending time with her and the location of her apartment has the  best view! She was so helpful and gracious, I will never forget my time in Porto thanks to her!! Definitely one of the most genuine and caring people I have met!
Tina was very welcoming and  communication was very responsive and helpful. The accommodation had a mini market and bus stops right outside and was an easy walk to the sea and river.

Alana & Jimmies apartment is in a fantastic location,  within waking distance to pretty much everything.  Alex and Paulo are amazing 'hosts' who gave us the most useful information and welcome.  The apartment has all you need and is very comfortable,  bed and great shower.  Whilst the view from the top terrace is fantastic, it is a bit overgrown. We had a wonderful break in a fabulous city,  so much to see, lovely food and very welcoming people.

The flat is great ! The location of the flat is perfect. The hosts were amazing and made us feel at home. We had a great time and we ll definitely come back to this place next time we come to Porto. Thank you guys !

This place was very spacious, comfortable, and easy to make our home for 11 days. The host Alaina and the nearby wine shop owner Alex were extremely helpful with our travel questions and our lost luggage issue. Alaina suggested several great ideas to visit, and Alex arranged a day-long tour that was a highlight of our time in Porto.

We had a lovely time staying in Porto. Paulo met us at his shop under the apartment and welcomed us warmly with a nice glass of wine. We sat and chatted for 15 minutes and he showed us into our space. He was responsive throughout our stay and offered recommendations for sights and restaurants. The apartment was in a perfect location within a few minutes walk of several great restaurants, bars, and attractions. We would come back here in a heartbeat. The outdoor space was a very nice spot to have breakfast. We highly recommend.
Clean, spacious apartment. Less than five minutes to Flores street. Located in a quiet square. Hosts were easy to communicate with.
The host had clear and good communication. He also checks in with you if you need anything. That is very kind!

This place is a gem in Porto! Its near great fado places and lovely restaurants! Down a steep staircase escada de novo is the Ribeira district !! Turn left and you can walk to the famous rue da flores ! Liveraria lello, Cletigos tower almost everywhere is walkable as long as you can handle the steep hills of porto 😋 Lovely home ! Book it if you’re coming to Porto!! 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🥳

We enjoyed this Cátia and Tiago’s place very much. It is super convenient to train, metro, and tour buses. You can walk to tourist attractions, the river and more. The place was quiet, clean and well equipped. The pastel de nata and port was an extra treat. Communication was great. Definitely recommend.

This condo is very big and beautiful! 1 1/2 baths and lovely seating area. The location could not be more perfect for walking to everything! Miguel met us and was warm and welcoming! He left us wine, water, juice and biscuits. Coffeeshop on the corner and Pedestrian only shopping and dining a few blocks away. Very happy to have stayed here!
Miguel was very communicative and accommodating. In addition the space was well equipped and pleasant. Fantastic stay. I recommend.
The place is great with an amazing view, perfect for couples oven families with kids, ours loved to climb the stairs! We love the central location as well, as you can walk anywhere!

It was a lovely flat, very clean and great location for walking into Porto.  It’s at the top so you need good legs but was nice to be higher up. There is a great park nearby with incredible view of the city. Concierge team we’re very professional and helpful.

A wonderful flat just in the center of Porto. Very spacy, with great view on the Douro! The kitchen is fully equipt. The apartment is  very clean. And it was pleasure to communicate with the host. You should be awared that there is no lift . Dear Joao, thank you for our great staying in Porto!

Such a special stay and location! This was our first Portugal stay on our honeymoon trip and it was so beautiful! Thank you for the delicious bottle of wine, it was the perfect thing to sip as we looked out the window over the Douro River at sunset. Absolutely wonderful! Many thanks!

The apartment indeed is beautiful and modern. It has the very basics but for a couple of days is ok. The views are nice but if you’re expecting to have the view of the river, this is not the place.
Overall the attic is very lovely however it could use a renovation or cleaning of furniture as the couch and chair with cloth were sticky and disgusting to sit in. I work from home so it is important for me to be in the house.
The towels could use a little care too as they were small and sticky.
In regard to the location, it is a beautiful neighborhood and very central. There are a lot of hills that you have to go up and down however the whole city is like this.

Amazing view of the river made this stay very special. Perfect location with so many restaurants and tourist attractions in easy walking distance. Also the proximity to San Benton train station makes traveling in and out of the city so easy. The place is simple, very elegant, and clean with all the amenities you need.

Loved the place so much, great location and more space than the pictures even show. We never had to walk more than 20 minutes to get where we wanted in Porto. Good wifi, good kitchen, washing machine was great to have.

The apartment is in a great location in Porto - near the train station & Ponte Luis bridge. Close to most things you will want to do in Porto. The apartment is clean with everything you need for your stay.
Lisa is an excellent host and meets you upon arrival to show you everything you need to know about the apartment. She also provides great recommendations. I highly recommend this place.

Lisa is a proactive, responsive host who has an Airbnb very close to many landmarks of Porto, and good places to eat like Padeirinha Doce (breakfast) and Restaurante Marroco (veggie couscous lunch special). For these reasons alone, I recommend her place.
Lisa’s place is a budget conscious place, which is something I expected from day 1. So I am not sure why people previously complained in here about it. Read the ad!
Anyway, I enjoyed staying at Lisa’s place with its quirks and all that. 5/5.

Good location to explore Porto in a calm area of the city. Spatious for 2 couples and a single or for parents with kids. Even though it was very hot in Porto when we visited, the apartment was cool (and fans were foreseen). Check in was smooth, communication went well through text message. Very good value for money, would recommend!
As accurate as the photos. Nice, clean space in a renovated building. Convenient access to lots of great restaurants and bars and as a base for exploring Porto.
Diogo was super helpful when I checked in and walked me through much of what Porto had to offer. The place was a clean and cozy place to call home for the 3 days I was there.

It's a great place with a beautiful view. When we arrived Maria welcomed us and showed us around. The house has plenty of privacy and parking space. It consists of two floors + an extra place where there is a BBQ and pizza oven. On the top floor it has the bedroom and bathroom with a nice balcony. On the ground floor it has the kitchen/living room and a terrace. We used the wood burner for heating, but there is also air conditioning on both floors.  We had a very nice time there and can certainly recommend.

This was a great place to stay! I was a bit concerned about my ability to find the place but Paula’s directions couldn’t have been better.
The dining pavilion off the courtyard is a great feature and having a washing machine came in handy. The kitchen has everything you need for preparing at home meals.
I’d recommend this place and would be a repeat visitor for sure!
It was a beautiful getaway for us, waking up with the roosters, walks up the hills, lots of space, immaculate. 15 mins into town.

Our stay at Miguel's place was just perfect. The apartment itself was beautiful and located so close to everything we wanted to see. It was just about a 10 minute walk down to Luis I Bridge & the Douro River with all the shops and restaurants nearby. The apartment was extremely spacious and very clean. Miguel was very responsive when it came to any questions that we had and was so helpful recommending parking locations for our rental car. The apartment also had an amazing view of the Douro right from the living room window! I would definitely stay at Miguel's place again and recommend it to any friends visiting Porto as well. Thanks Miguel!
Wonderful place, very clean, near the city center (and 30 seconds walk to the tram station), plus Miguel was a wonderful host and answered everything we needed. Super, really!

We really enjoyed Miguel’s. It was comfortable and very clean. While we initially thought the location might be inconvenient, we were actually very happy to be in a quit neighborhood away from the very touristy areas. The park down the street was lovely and the views were beautiful.
Great place! Very clean and a nice location. Easy to find and to self check in. We were happy with our stay.
Great place with a view,  short ride to the city center, responsive host. Felt at home.

Beautiful property which has everything in it . Very well situated and easy to get around . Our host was great to give us many tips on where to visit and things typical to do in Porto .
We had a great holiday in Miguel’s and Claudia’s home 🏠
😊
We had a great stay at Eduardo's apartment. It was comfortable and central enough to the rest of the city. Thank you!
Beautifully furnished place that is convenient yet quiet. Eduardo is friendly and responsive, and check in/out was very smooth
Eduardo’s place was excellent. Check in was easy and instructions to find the place were excellent.  Great location right near the river and close to many things. Definitely recommend!

Mari is amazing host. We arrived much late then the check-in time. However, Maria met us with very warm welcome. She showed us her house, gave a small guide about places to eat and shop around. She also helped us with underground tickets. Plus, she gave us a complimentary bottle of nice wine.
The place itself is a very nice and clean flat with 2 bedrooms. The balcony window oversee the ocean. Stunning view. Plenty of channels on TV, good speedy internet.
There are many places around to eat, one of them is just around the corner, where you can stuff yourself with enormous amounts of seafood.
Will definitely stay again at this place my next visit.

Pedro was very responsive and gave us a full and detailed talk through of the local area. It was great to know all of the local information and tips, really made our trip amazing! The location is great as you are only a ten minute walk from most places. Really recommend.

The appartment was amazing, super super bright and everything was super clean.  I would love to have a place like that in Paris ! the only bad point would be the comfort of the sofa and the bed that makes A LOT of noise . Except from that it was perfect !
Antonio is a great host, the appartement is located in a perfect place, well-equiped and very clean. Very easy check in and out.

Very good experience!
We would like one more mirror and a little more soap. But thats details! Everything was nice. We enjoyed our stay!

Antonio was very friendly and responsive to messages. Antonio’s place was great and exactly as described on the listing. He provided helpful instructions in advance of our arrival for check in and was flexible with the check in time due to our flight arriving earlier in the day. The apartment was in a good location, walkable to most things including the old town down at the bridge. Would definitely recommend staying here :)

CL Ildefonso was a nice apartment, clean and uncluttered. We were a couple, but it would be a bit crowded for four adults.
The location was good, near restaurants and a quiet street when the windows were closed. A few more chairs in the living area would be helpful, as well as improved lighting in the bathroom.
Great ace. Close to the centre and nice restaurants. Street noise is there but not at al irritating. Very nice place to stay.

My sister and I had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is cosy and the location is perfect. The place was clean and the bed is nice. Elisio (Vitor’s host) was very friendly and had some nice recommendations.
We had a lovely stay - the apartment was in a great location with a gorgeous balcony. We would definitely stay again!

Perfect location to travel Porto! It's located really close to the city center so it's perfect for tourism :) It looked exactly like the photos and was really clean! Ellios was very responsive as well. Would highly recommend to anyone!

I stayed at Sven’s place for 2 weeks. I always felt safe and comfortable. The photos are accurate and exactly as shown. The apartment was also larger than I expected. Sitting on the balcony with a glass of wine is the perfect place to catch the sunset!

Jorge is an amazing host , and his place is perfectly clean . He gave us a beautiful unexpected surprise and we are greatful for his response to our needs everytime needed .
Thank you so much .
We have had a great time at marios apartment. Very well equipped, new and comfortable. You won't regret staying there for a nice time in Porto.

Great place, very clean and a lot of space. I haven’t met Mario but he helped me with everything I needed via text messages and replied super fast. A bit noisy at nights from the street outside the window and other people but nonetheless I had a great time!
Alex was the perfect host! Everything was organized from my arrival untill i had to leave. Definitely coming back!
Mario and Alex are great guests! Very helpful and protective. The apartment is so celan and beautiful! We had a great time there ❤️

We lived our stay at Porto. The property is in the middle of everything, great for someone that wants a central location , walking to supermarket as well as the main attractions. We did need to close our windows at night as the apartment overlooks the bars.

Perfectly located apartment, a short walk from the metro that takes you into the main tourist attractions and if you walk only about 30min to the river. We loved being in this more local area with a great square and fountain and lovely bakeries. Vivian left lovely touches in the apartment and we appreciated her notes and information places throughout. The bed was comfortable and we loved letting fresh air in from the huge patio. We would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks Vivian!

Everything was perfect : location, communication with hosts (thanks Daniela!), the apartment itself (cleanliness, tidiness, size, bed, equipments (kitchen etc), flexibility with the keys. I would definitely recommend it

As others have said the location of the apartment is perfect to explore Porto. You can reach most sights by foot and if you need public transportation there are metro and bus stops nearby as well.
We found the flat to be very clean and felt very comfortable. For two people there‘s plenty of space. One thing to maybe consider is that it is an old building with wooden floors which means you can hear the neighbors above you walking around - although this did not bother us at all.
Communication with the hosts before and during our stay was good and the self check in was easy.
a very nice large one bedroom two bath flat with an epic view from the patio. The central location was also great, so easy to walk to all sites and restaurants

We had a lovely stay with Eva and Dani. The place was clean and tidy, with excellent views over the city incl. the famous bridge! Communication was great, and allowed us to slightly overrun out checkout time without much hassle. Shame about the weather!
Would heartily recommend.
Beautiful apartment in a fabulous location. Very quiet despite its central location, extremely well furbished, with great views and a cute balcony terrace. Couldn't have been better!

The view at Merc’s is sweeping and stunning. The place itself is also quite large versus other places I have stayed in Europe. The kitchen is wonderful and I wish I could have had the time to cook a meal in it. The pull out sofa bed wasn’t the most comfortable to sleep on, but I ended up using one of the large, thick blankets in the closet as a base layer, which helped a lot. They are renovating the building directly in front of the balcony. Other than scaffolds and construction mess, we didn’t have noise issues—but we also stayed on the weekend. The shower has good water pressure, but you’re limited on time when it comes to it staying hot for your shower. Major perk for having a washer and drying rack for clothes! All the amenities were great. Overall, a wonderful place to stay. I would recommend to friends and family.

We absolutely loved this place. The amazing view and balcony, spacious living room, washer and dryer rack, comfortable bed, super clean bathroom and linens- it was all just perfect! Also loved the location. It’s right next to a beautiful viewpoint of the city. 7 min walk to Harry Potter bookstore, 10 min walk to Sao Bento and the heart of Porto. Super convenient yet on a nice quiet street. Hosts were very communicative, helpful, and friendly. Absolute perfection! Dying to come back one day.
Merc's place is smack bang in the center of porto, and it's a lovely wee place. recently renovated and clean with a beaut view over the city. take your sweetie pie here, easy
Thank you for everything, Eva, I had a wonderful stay at your apartment! The view was incredible. Perfect spot to discover Porto ☺️

The apartment was immaculate, modern, quiet and extremely comfortable. It was walking distant to everything we wanted to see and do. I highly recommend the Merc place and will book with them again when I return to Porto.

Great location and amazing view from the balcony.
Open space layout, well designed.
Only minus here is that the wooden floor is squeaking. Other than that it was terrific.

Absolutely beautiful apartment. The view off of the balcony is amazing! I didn't have time to prepare meals, but the cabinets were fully stocked with all the necessary tools and utensils if I'd wanted to. A couple of minor hitches during my stay, but they mostly consisted of me not figuring out how to operate something, and getting a super-speedy explanation back from the host.
Wonderful location very near the Vitória Miradouro. Great communication throughout our stay. Washer was very useful and two bathrooms was a major win! Would stay here again!

Super apartment! The location is great on the river. We were very comfortable and the place was very clean. They accommodated for a late check in but for a 20 euro charge. Would highly recommended! Was great having the AC to stay cool while we slept

We had a wonderful time in Marcia and Teresa's beautiful apartment - it's beautifully renovated, sparkling clean and cozy. It's right where you want to be - but be prepared to walk some hills to get anywhere in Porto (which is btw true for pretty much any location). Also, ideally don't bring a car, as it's hard to find parking. But thanks to wonderful Gaby, who also equipped us with helpful advice, we found a spot :) thanks again, guys!
This place was great! We enjoyed our stay here. Gabriela provided us with some great tips to explore Porto!

a very nice place.
clean, near the center, friendly, quiet and everything is available.
You hear the church from 8 am till 8 pm but you get used to it.
we will come back.
Very nice experience in a historical setting. Carla was very helpful and responsible in helping us check in!
The place was really beautiful and located in a great spot with lots around that was walkable. Carla was really responsive, timely and helpful with recommendations. Thanks so much Carla!

I LOVE this apartment! I spent my 60th birthday here - a solo trip to Portugal and Spain. Romantic Ribeira was a perfect place to begin my adventure. Carla even delivered a birthday cake and balloons for a celebration! She arranged airport transportation for me and was accommodating with regards to check in and check out. The apartment is gorgeous and clean and comfortable. The market below has everything you need. The view of the church and river are excellent!
Great and very cool apartment in the city center of Oporto. The host was very friendly and gave us a lot of tips and recomendations.

As other reviews mentioned, there’s a funky smell throughout the place…And we found it a little bit cold in the apartment. But honestly I don’t know if that can be avoided in a historical home like this one - The charm outweighs the negatives. There are heaters in each room but they can’t really keep upbeat the high ceilings. We would stay here again, just maybe bring warmer clothes next time.

Very nice house in a quite neighborhood. Everything was very clean and the pool was larger than expected. Even the lawn was being mowed when we where absent. The  only Problem was the check in and check out. Since the Madame assisting Valter only speaked portugese. But nevertheless we figured a way out to communicate.

Beautiful, modern apartment, located in the heart of Porto. All facilities easily accessible and within walking distance. The apartment was clean, well maintained and equipped wth everything you need for your stay. The team were on hand to answer all enquiries efficiently and quickly. In addition, they provided some very useful tips on sights and places to visit.
The location is central, walking distance to many good restaurants, cafes and attractions. The apartment is clean, ORM Team is very responsive. Check-in is smooth and very positive.
Awesome stay! Clean and in the best part of nightlife! Walking distance to everything. Can be noisy at night, but it’s worth it for great nightlife, would stay again !

The space has everything a tourist needs and the location is close enough to and far enough away from the madding crowd.
I heartily recommend the place!

The apartment is located on the first floor of a traditional building. It is stylish, comfortable and very clean. Well appointed with all necessary kitchen utensils etc. Fresh, crisp bed linen and fluffy towels provided. Really good, powerful shower which is easy to control for the temperature. Perfect for a couple.  Checked in by Claudia who was friendly, helpful and informative. The location is superb, just a 10 mins walk from the Metro which runs direct from the airport. It suited us perfectly as everything was within walking distance, ie main sights, tours, great shops and eateries. We even walked over to Gaia on the other side of the river.  Bring good walking shoes! Loved our stay here and would recommend.

Highly recommend! A great place to stay a few nights. Carlos was there to check us in and show us round the apartment. He gave us lots of great tips for Porto. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed! It was in a great location very close to everything but in a quiet location. Would stay here again!

Carlos’s place was the ideal base for exploring Porto: everything within walking distance but also very close to the metro. Place was immaculate, stylish and comfortable. Felt right at home - Carlos made sure I had everything I needed. Highly recommended.
Lovely hosts, house and very handy location for where I needed to be. Allowed me to keep my bag there after I checked out and very helpful overall.

Carlos's place is a true gem in the heart of Porto, perfectly located within walking distance of everything. Upon our arrival, Carlos thoroughly explained all the details about his place and highlighted the city's key attractions on a paper map, offering fantastic recommendations for authentic Portuguese cuisine. His communication was exceptional. Don’t wait too long—book this place before someone else does!

Apartment was beautiful and exactly as described! Great location and very walkable to the city and metro. Carlos was very responsive and helpful in sharing places to see and things to do. Would love to be back in the future!

Without any doubt its the best place for staying
Carmo care for the guest with the love
There are a lot of extra things, even a bathroom dressing down
Highly recommended to stayin 🥰

I highly recommend Carmo’s place! It’s located next to the metro station and some big shopping malls. It takes only 15 minutes to get to either the old town or the airport. On my arrival Carmo provided me with abundant information about what to see and do in Porto. Thank you Carmo for hosting me! I really appreciate it.
Convenient location close to the metro. Carmo was very kind with her tips of the area and accommodating for check in/check out. Would recommend!
Very clean bedroom and bathroom. Shower was nice, bed was nice, balcony was nice. Host was very responsive. No AC but fan was provided. Ideal location as well.
can not  recommend every aspect enough. Try the apartment and Oporto and you won't be disappointed

This is an ideal location for exploring and is also quiet.
There’s lots of parking opportunities around the area at the weekend.
We are used to bedding being available in the apartment for the 2nd bed. Be sure to mention it in advance, if you plan to use it.

Yves and Ana are wonderful hosts. Very caring and helpful. The flat is
only 30 mins on foot from the old quarter - straight ahead all the way -
and has everything one could possibly need. It was a real pleasure
staying there and I hope to come back in year or two.

Large clean one bedroom apartment with lots of natural light! On a quiet street with free parking if you are travelling with car. It was a bit far from downtown Porto/waterfront to walk, we arranged other methods of transportation. The hosts communication was timely and he was flexible (2-4 hours) of our arrival time. Cute and moderate sized courtyard to enjoy some wine. Large bathroom. Comfortable bed with large closet. Would recommend.

Yves and Ana are wonderful hosts and location is really good if you want to explore Porto. The apartment is close to the metro (direct line to airport), it is away from noisy streets yet it is still quite close to the main sights and old town, so you don't need to use public transportation in order to get to the central Porto from apartment. We also got some suggestions of what to see and where to eat. I highly recommend this place if you are looking for a nice place to stay close to the old town.
Great location near the metro and within walking distance of the centre. The appartment was quiet , clean and plenty of space in a nice old building. The communication as also good.

This was a lovely apartment, very central and very accessible to get to from the airport using the metro. Arrived late at night and the host Nico was there to meet us. Recommend to anyone staying in Porto.

This is the perfect place to enjoy comfortable accommodations while be close to the best parts of Porto. The private garden is a rare and fun detail of the space. We enjoyed drinks out there under the stars. The space itself is very clean and well organized. Everything is updated and modern. Our host also gave us some great tips on food and local sights. Highly recommend!!

Very well located flat. Really annoying dog next door which barks all day, but that's not the fault of the host!
Our toilet broke on the first day, and wouldn't flush. It took a few days to fix - but in fairness, this was because it was the weekend and everywhere was shut. I can't fault the host for their quick replies and the effort they went to.

This is a very nice place to spend a few days exploring Porto from
It’s close to the subway , supermarket , bars, restaurants, 30 stroll gets you to the waterfront
The unit is modern ,clean and well equipped.
The host was easy to contact met us on arrival and spent a few minutes outlining suggestions for sightseeing. They responded quickly when the electricity went out .

We had a fantastic stay in this lovely apartment. The location is great, really close to the main metro from the airport and lots of amazing restaurants but still super quiet at night. Wouldn’t hesitate to come back!
Susana is a wonderful and welcoming host. Her place is in a central location to all that Porto has to offer as well as public transportation. I would highly recommend staying here.

This apartment was amazing. Central, stylish and comfortable. Andreia and João were perfect guests, stocking the fridge with water, providing fruit, teas etc. It felt like being at home. They were also very helpful in terms of giving us city tips and being available if we had any questions. Great experience.

Joao and Andreia were exceptionally friendly and helpful hosts.
Their Porto apartment is beautiful and in a fantastic location within an easy walk to explore the beautiful city of Porto. When we arrived we were welcomed with fruit, juice, water, coffee, cooking basics and of course some port wine.
This really felt like a home away from home...thank you.

This property is beautifully appointed and very comfortable. João and Andreia are gracious in their welcome, in providing great advice on Porto and so helpful during the stay. The location is a comfortable walk to lots of Porto’s main attractions. A great find. As an added bonus there is a good cafe a few doors down toward the river. Fantastic coffee and great fresh, simple food. Look out for Bird of Passage. Thank you João & Andreia for all your kindness.

João and Andreia are the BEST hosts. They welcomed us like we were their friends in their stylish apartment with fresh fruits, porto wine, tea, fruit juice and fresh water bottles!
This appartement is way better than a suite in a luxury hotel:) Great location near all the amenities including shops, restaurants, city bus tour, bakery,... Perfect!

A most lovely place, terrific location, wonderful amenities and hosts however, the kitchen has ants that will find anything left on the counter and the bathrooms had an awful sewer smell with sewer flies. They clearly know they have a sewer problem as the strong smell of deodorizer tried to cover it when we checked in. Until the host resolve the issues, it could be free but I wouldn't stay there. I'm sure they will as they have a terrific business as they have multiple units.
A beautiful place...that needs urgent issues addressed.

My husband and two of our friends spent 3 nights at João & Andreia's flat and couldn't have asked for a nicer place. The hosts' friend (I think her name was Rita - she was wonderful!) was waiting outside when we arrived and explained in great detail all of the nearby attractions. There was also a bottle of port waiting in the kitchen and well-stocked drawer of coffee, teas, and little snacks. I would definitely stay here again and recommend this place to anyone.

I doubt that there is a better located and appointed 2 bedroom unit in Porto. All services are within a few moments walk of the unit. The water front is 5 minutes walk away. Buses two minutes and Sao Bento maybe 10 minutes walk. The apartment is clean, clean and artfully appointed. Joao and Andreia are extremely and professional hosts. One of the best Airbnbs we have stayed in.

Our stay in Porto was great and this is really thanks to that Airbnb appartement. We traveled with a 16 months old baby and god knows it can be sometimes very hard.
The place was clean, well decorated, quiet, fully equipped (baby chair and bed). There was also a welcome gift: a bottle of Porto, fresh fruits and bottles of water.
It’s close to the historical city center and there are 2 supermarkets at 5mn walking.

This was the perfect Airbnb for a weekend in Porto, I would highly recommend it. The apartment was well located and super comfy, with air con for hot nights! We spent most of our time outside the apartment exploring but it seemed well set up for cooking and staying in. The terraces are amazing for sitting with a drink too, and the welcome bottle of port was extremely welcome. Thanks for a great stay!

This is a fantastic AirBnB property in a great location with great hosts. Property looks as good in person as it does in the pictures. It is clean and comfortable and has everything one can need. The AC worked well and the hot water was strong and plentiful.
The hosts went out of their way to help us at check-in and check-out and to make our stay comfortable. They offered nice gifts upon arrival and gave great recommendations on things to do, places to eat, and sights to be seen.
A+ experience that I recommend to everyone.

Joao & Andreia’s place is beautifully decorated and very comfortable. It is in a great location downtown. We were able to walk to all the sights we were interested in visiting. There are lots of restaurants nearby. Joao and Andreia very kindly let us drop off our bags and check in a bit early.
I would highly recommend staying at Joao and Andreia’s place when you are visiting Portugal.
The unit was clean and neat. Check-in was easy and the unit was well located. We had everything we needed.

João and Andreia’s apartment was perfect for a short stay. It is located in an area where there is plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from. We were greeted by Graca who was lovely and gave us plenty of recommendations on what to do and where to go in Porto. The apartment was very clean and there were a few extras which were greatly appreciated. Definitely recommend this apartment

This Airbnb was beautiful, it was very spacious and the garden terrace was ideal. I couldn’t mark it higher than 4 stars due to the lack of aircon. There were 4 people staying in an attic room with a tiny window and it got unbearably hot, it was difficult to sleep.

Teresa and Jorge were great hosts, very accommodating and sharing so much helpful recommendations and tips about Porto. We are happy to have stayed at her place that Anna their housekeeper cleaned so well for us. Thank you again Teresa and Jorge
I can’t say enough about how helpful Teresa was. Her recommendations were spot on and made our stay very enjoyable.
Beautiful apartment with a stunning view.  Great amenities, comfortable bed.  We loved our brief stay here.  The location was excellent.
I really loved the view at Patio25 and the host was responsive and helpful for my last minute booking. It is an easy walk across the bridge to Porto and all of the restaurants/sights to see.
You will very much appreciate the location of the apartment in a safe and quiet building in the centre of the city.  The apartment is clean and modern. You will be close to everything.  Enjoy it all.
Great location to explore Porto.  The apartment had everything we needed and the parking space was really useful. Daniel was very helpful - we had a great stay
Daniel and Nuno are excellent hosts - very attentive and thoughtful! The apartement is nice, clean and has a great location. I would recommend it 100%!
The place was extremely nice! Kitchen had everything you need. Comfortable pillows and bed. The host was amazing and spent some time giving us tips about Porto.
Daniel’s place was great - very clean, great communication, and close to everything the city has to offer! Would recommend this place to anyone:)

We were in Porto just 2 days, but thanks to ORM and their hosts we were able to enjoy the city to the fullest.
The apartment was super clean, well located and nicely decorated. The communication with ORM was fast & easy.
We got many nice tips from ORM for sightseeing, restaurants and bars. I would highly recommend Zenith Brunch & Cocktails for the best breakfast/lunch, Tapa Rua for tapas + live music and to eat a francesinha at Cervejaria Brasao Aliados.
Great apartment. They were very helpful with the check in process when we realized we were going to arrive 2 hours late, they made the right arrangements and in order to let us in.

Where to start! What an amazing first experience with Air BnB :D . The apartment was even better than what we were expecting. Such a beautiful space with a lovely outside area. The location is exactly where you want to be as everything so close. The staff were fantastic - Especially Filipa who always went above and beyond ensuring we had a great trip. I would highly recommend booking the boat trip with ORM it was such great value for money and even included a port tasting ! Will definitely be coming back soon :)

A modern air conditioned apartment, very comfortable, modern furnishings, quality bed linen, beautiful bathroom. A large terrace with a table and deck chairs, very safe and private. Restaurants nearby, 10 minutes walk to river side, station and main shopping areas. Marcia  and  Andre were waiting at the apartment when we arrived, they both speak excellent English, (we speak no Portuguese.)
Very lovely apartment with good bus connections. We would stay there again.  Spotlessly clean , and many thoughtful touches to make a person feel at home.

We spent great 10 days in Porto
The host Was very helpful and nice
The communication Was perfect !
the place has a good location ,close to the shops and bus station
I highly recommend :)
Would highly recommend Susanas apartment. Very clean and the location was perfect, plenty of places to eat and drink wine nearby.

Susana is incredible and goes above and beyond to make sure you have an amazing trip! She is also so responsive. I accidentally locked myself out one day and she literally answered me immediately and got me right back in. Everything is so clean and comfortable.
Susana’s place was perfect and close to everything. Liked having a balcony. Bed was very comfortable and Susana was very helpful and available when we had a question. Would stay here again.
Can't say enough about how wonderful this place was!! Its a perfect location and the host Susana was amazing! She went well above to make my stay special!! Thank you for everything!

We enjoyed a really wonderful and special stay in Porto. This apartment is perfect for a big Porto experience. We loved the special touches and the quiet location despite being right in the heart of town. 100% recommend!
Lovely apartment, easily walkable and nice restraunts near by. In a lively area but had no problem with noise.

Great place to stay in Porto! Though it is located near the top of a street going uphill + a flight of stairs makes bringing luggage up a little tricky, everything else about this place is wonderful. It's surrounded by many great restaurants, and the area feels lively and safe. You don't hear much of the outside once you're inside, and everything was clean and tidy. Best part was the private patio! After a long day out, it was nice to have a place where you can lounge or have a meal outdoors. Susana was really responsive to all of our questions and needs, and we really appreciated her letting us self check-in earlier than stated. The sofa bed was actually quite comfortable too! We really enjoyed our stay here.
Incredible flat! The private roof terrace has the best view in all of Porto and the flat is amazing. Great value and location - a true hidden gem!
Apartment’s best spot was definitely the terrace with amazing views of Porto! Host was communicative and straightforward

We stayed at Telmo’s apartment in Porto and were very happy with all aspects. The apartment is very clean in a well appointed location opposite a shopping centre and the Bolhão market. The apartment is very stylish, with a balcony at the back and laundry facilities which was very useful after our weeks on the road. Telmo’s suggestion for our Douro Valley tour was exceptional and well worth the day trip.
Thank you for your hospitality, Telmo!
Good value for money and nice neighborhood. But we found a lot of hair on the toilet seat and in the bath tub. Could be cleaned better.
Good place close to downtown and very close to the Metro (once you figure it out). Took some time to get response from Adriano, but once he responded all was good. Great guy, very helpful.

The apartment is just as described. We had a couple of things that went wrong. However, Marta was very responsive and made sure the problem was fixed.
Would stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay. The location of the apartment was close enough to the centre to allow us to walk in, and far enough out to be quiet. The streets nearby had good cafes and restaurants, which proved very helpful. The apartment was a decent size, with air con in all the rooms, and the instructions for entry were clear and worked well.

Very nice location and very kind host.
Check-In was easy going and fullfilled all out expectations.
Thanks alot Telmo!
Best regards Alex

Ana Sofia was a great host! Amazingly responsive, caring, friendly, and went out of her way to make us feel welcome. We appreciated how flexible she was with the check in/out process. Would highly recommend!

Manuel welcomed us with hopitality. He informed us a lot of useful information around the place. His list of good restaurants were helpful. The place was modern styled and newly renovated. We had a good time in Porto.

We had a wonderful stay in Ines's apartment, which is very pleasant and conveniently located. Thanks to her father for providing us with a flexible and warm welcome. I highly recommend this accommodation.

My wife and I stayed here for one week over the new year holiday. Everything was absolutely perfect - excellent location and close to many attractions, quiet, super clean, modern, and comfortable, with beautiful views from the two small balconies. Ines' father, Manuel, was so kind, friendly, helpful and communicative before and during our stay. When we first arrived at the apartment, he met us there to give an orientation of the apartment's features. He also provided informative manuals on Porto's attractions, activities and local restaurants. We would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend! Thank you, Manuel!

Location was perfect, cool shops, cafés and restaurants on the door step. There's a newly opened café on the corner where you can get beautiful lunches, cakes and pancakes for breakfast (also very friendly). The apartment it's self is very nicely presented and has all that you need. We were in Porto with 2 teenage kids. It's a great city for pottering around, taking in the beauty and chilling in cafés /bars. Also found it to be not quite as touristy as other European cities. We weren't so lucky with the restaurants - food patchy so prob worth researching or noting where is popular and being willing to wait for a seat.

Inês and Manuel were fantastic hosts! The apartment was great and had everything we needed. It was far enough out of the center so it was quiet, yet close enough to walk to everything. There are great restaurants close by, markets, shops, a nice cinema, and the metro is short walk. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay in the centre of Porto easy to get to from porto airport too via metro enjoyed every moment staying here great for a couple or a single person holiday
Very well presented apartment that was very clean! Good location, with a 10 minute walk down to the river. Very helpful staff. The pool was also a great bonus!
Cristina's place is beautiful and perfectly situated  close to everything , walking and seeing everything is easy.   will stay again
The apartment is in a really nice area. The check-in was easy. And the apartment was also really clean. Cristina was always available for questions.
Really nice space. The communication was really clear and we got some nice tips and help for trips. The place is quite small, but very nice. We cooked our own meals and I just love the kitchen.

Great place to stay. If you don’t want to walk into the centre of Porto then the metro is just 3 minutes away. There is a lovely pastry shop below for breakfast and the owners speak English. Pedro de Fragoes is a wonderful restaurant for dinner and is only a 5 minute walk away.
This place is perfect for a weekend in Porto.

Couldn’t have been better. Apartment was beautiful, spotless and equipped with everything we needed!  Dina and Ines truly go above and beyond to make you feel welcome in their home with lots of lovely, delicious and local touches.  Rita their niece greeted us upon check-in and checkout and she was very kind and helpful making the process easy and very smooth.  The location was walking distance to many great restaurants, attractions and bars!

Staying at Dino & Ines’s Airbnb is highly recommended! We felt extremely welcomed and the home was very beautiful and cozy. We were welcomed with fresh bread, wine and baked caked! It was amazing. The area is phenomenal and we will definitely be coming back!!

Dino and Ines were outstanding hosts! Dino went over and above making us feel relaxed and comfortable. They gave us a lovely surprise when we first arrived making it the best Airbnb experience yet! The studio was clean, fully equipped with amenities and quiet. We could walk everywhere and there were grocery stores and restaurants not far from the apartment. Dino checked in with us and offered us excellent recommendations around things to see and do. We’d highly recommend them to others! Thanks for a wonderful Porto experience.
Lovely and modern place in a stately and luxurious building. Management staff are very helpful and location is excellent. Highly recommend.

Andre’ place is outstanding. My best Airbnb experience so far. Andre and his brother Patricio, we’re super available anytime I needed anything or had questions.
The tips for places to eat and visit were spot on.
The apartment is well-equipped, the bed and linens were super cozy, plenty of sheets and towels, everything you would need and more. Everything you would love to have in the kitchen.
Oh and the pocket Wi-Fi! I’ll never leave home without one of those things again, I don’t know what I would’ve done without it. Thank you

Great place for a couple. We managed to have 4 people, two adults and children 6 and 9. It is small but cozy and comfortable. Honestly you probably won't be inside much because Porto has so much fun to offer. If you have the time take the Douro Valley wine tour, spectacular landscape and wine! We arrived on a holiday and the next day the city was somewhat slow to wake up. Lovely beaches in the area too. Highly recommend this place in the heart of the city. There are over 50 steep stairs up, dont forget your mobile on your way out :)
The place was nice and quiet. The entrance with codes was very convenient. Although the kitchen could use more equipment, it was sufficient.
Very nice place in top location! Would definitely recommend! Only thing: could not sleep with open window. Street close by gets noisy during nights.
Beautiful apartment, excellent location, the only thing that I would add to this place it is a AC unit even in this season it was a hot  inside, they provided a fan but it was not enough

A brilliant studio in Cedofeita, well equipped and full of light.
The host is very supportive. Being in the town centre, a bit of noise was to be expected, however nothing too disruptive

Loved my stay! Great communication from local host. Very helpful with tips and recommendations. Great place, newly remodeled, perfect location. Walking distance to everything (cafe, shops, metro, etc). Location is central and was loud on the weekend so plan ahead with ear plugs if you plan on sleeping early.

Great apartment in a super location, everything you need is on your doorstep and it’s a great base to explore Porto. We had a super time. Host was very kind to allow us to drop our bags in early and gave us some lovely local tips. The only issue was that there was street noise at night and bells, but when you stay so centrally this is to be expected :) Thanks so much
Beautifully designed place that is centrally located. Close by to great restaurants and literally anything you could need, shopping, sightseeing and very close to Douro river. You cane all anywhere!
Amazing place. Very near to Porto. Perfect Portuguese home for anyone who wants to check out Porto.
The Ana's place was great :) We stayed there and the place was very nice, clean, cozy and perfect. Ana was very warm and responsive and generous :)

Ana’s home is absolutely beautiful and I’m so glad that she has chosen to share it with us! We had a wonderful time ,her place is spotless, spacious and close to Porto center. I would recommend her place to anyone and look forward to staying again in the future!

The apartment was cozy, clean and near the Sao Bento station, which was also near most of the tourist attractions. The room was equipped with everything we might use. The heater was well- functioned which saved us from the cold winter night in Porto.
Lovely stay team was really really helpful. The girl who greeted us (Chloe) gave us lots of information about the local tips. Besides she recommended a wonderful restaurant( Reibeira Square) where I had the most tasteful seafood rice in my whole journey. Undoubtedly it’s one of my best memories here.
The whole team was super kind and willing to reply any question I asked in a very short time.
Porto is a lovely and charming place. If there’s any chance to visit here again, I’ll definitely choose Ritsuko’s apartment as my first choice!
Thank you so much! We've really loved your place to stay. The apartment was so lovely and very clean. And the location is so central and perfect. We will definitely come back!

Thank you, Mané and Pedro for such a lovely stay. The apartment is absolutely beautiful. The decor and design touches made this one of nicest apartments we've strayed in.
The location also, was perfect for both walking around the town and easily being able to drive to the geopark.
And the communication from Mané and Pedro was also excellent. Very thoughtful and helpful.
Thank you also for the delicious cookies!

We had an amazing stay at Jorge’s! Check in was seamless and Jorge even went above and beyond and accommodated our need for an early check in. The apartment is in a beautiful building in a super convenient location for enjoying the city. Would definitely recommend!

The apartment was beautiful and spacious!
The advantage of being close to the inner city just had one downside, it was a bit noisy as it’s right on a corner with traffic lights and lot of traffic (loud motorcyclists and emergency horns wake us up more than wished).
Beside that, I recommend the lovely and special apartment from Jorge!
Easy to get to old town, along with good local pubs and cafes. Plenty of space in the pleasant apartment.

Very beautiful apartment and in the perfect location. We would definitely stay here again. I would highly recommend this stay. We did have an issue with the A/C and the host was very responsive, but we were unable to fix the issue. Other than that, it was perfect.

This is a great appartment in a great location, the only problem is that the nearby streets are all under construction and it makes it difficult to get to and from the appartment. Other than that the place is nice and comfortable.

Luis was an exceptional Superhost! His directions were precise allowing us to to transfer effortlessly to his apartment.  He gave us a tour of his apartment and highlights of the City of Porto. He asked us about our needs and then supplied us with a list of restaurant nearby.We felt totally cared for and welcome. Largely because of Luis we felt so comfortable in Porto and plan to visit again. Luis is kind, naturally warm, and an ambassador for his City. Can't wait to come back again :)

Luis was the perfect host and his place was an excellent choice. Located in a very walkable area, lots of restaurants  and shops nearby. The apartment itself was clean, well-decorated, and comfortable. Luis was able to give us a flexible check-in which was so helpful because of our early flight arrival time. Stay here, you will not regret it!
My second time staying at one of Luis's places. Lovely responsive host and apartment was exactly as described and in excellent condition.

We got a warm greeting and Alvaro got us great tips for our visit in Porto! The apartement had a nice view and exept some dogs it was a silent location. You can go to the citiy center by feet. We had everything and it was very clean also the decoration was cute.

The apartments are small, but neat, fully equipped and perfectly clean.  There is air conditioning and a balcony, which is important.  Alvaro is a very pleasant person to talk to.  And be sure to take Alvaro's advice and walk from the apartment along the river D'ouro to the Luis 1 bridge and the Cais de Gaia.

This place is located in a tranquil residential area. Inside the house was very clean and organised, with all the necessary homeware like washing machine and liquid, extra pillow and linen, a great range of kitchen utensils and equipment etc.  There are 4 of us and the place felt spacious. There is a balcony overlooking the Duoro and we particularly enjoyed the beautiful sunrise there. Alvaro was a great host. He gave us a very detailed tour of the house and gave us great recommendations around the city. We had a great stay at this place!
Great host, amazing apartment, very clean and cozy! The location is not bad either! Totally recommend to stay in Alvaro’s place!!

We had an absolutely great stay in this very spacious house. Although it is not in Porto itself, you have a very good access to public transports. It is 2 min by foot. With well thought out details both surprised us and we definetly will come back. It is a so quiet and peaceful and in particular clean!

This apartment was perfect for the two of us as we each had our own bedroom and bathroom! It was very walkable to a nearby metro stop and restaurants.
The host, Daniel was extremely responsive before and during our stay.
It was very quiet, extremely clean and the beds were very comfortable!
I highly recommend this home!

I stayed for a month and overall it was great. Lucas was absolutely incredible in getting back to me within minutes of any issues, which included heating (common issue here) and brought an extra heater by next day. The unit is small, definitely a little “worn,” but it’s incredibly cozy and provides every amenity needed. There’s also a grocery store just across the bridge (you can see it from the main window in the unit) and it’s only about a 25min walk to the main “downtown” area. I would 100% stay again.

The best place I have stayed in thus far. The apartment was beautiful and I felt so comfortable and right at home. The host was extremely helpful, provided recommendations in the area, and made sure I was happy with the apartment when providing the keys. Grocery store and train/bus stations are only 5 minute walk away. I felt so lucky to stay here. Thank you for the wonderful stay.

The apartment is beautiful and practical. We loved people watching from the balcony. Very cool apartment with art and cool interior design. Walking distance to great shopping and city views. Definitely recommend this apartment. I didn’t like the check in system, where I had to fill in a form outside of air bnb and that they used a messaging system outside of the air bnb app. But the host Pedro was amazing and the apartment was so lovely. So that made up for it.

Paulo’s place was great, check in was smooth as his daughter met me outside the home to show me inside and hand off the keys. Very nice area, walking distance to all the nice restaurants and stores that you would need. Would recommend to anyone.
Really clean, nice apartment. Easy check in and always fast answers. Definitely would recommend it. Also quite big and with huge windows.

The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The communication was perfect and anytime we had a question or needed something - the response was prompt. I can only recommend this place if you're staying in Porto. Very nice apartment and super friendly host!
Thank you for a wonderful stay at your lovely apartment. The apartment was perfect for us. Lovely and clean, and close to the city centre. Would highly recommend!
This place is super as a home base while exploring Porto! Amazing location, lots of character and lovely hosts.

Our stay at Mord's flat was amazing! The flat itself is in a lovely central location and a minute walk away you get a lovely view of Porto which most tourists treck up a bunch of stairs to reach. The Flat was perfectly clean and comfortable with a great view of the uniquely tiled buildings opposite the balcony and the beautiful church up the road. Communication was without fault and response times were quick. Couldn't recommend enough! And will defiantly be staying here if we're in the area again :)

This beautiful space is located in the very center of Porto, in a safe and quiet historical road from where you can reach everything by foot. The house is more beautiful and magic than the photos. The bed is comfortable and everything is very clean. I loved the buliding, too, the staircase and the small balcony.

Best Location in town !!! - Very clean and Cozy.
I would definitely come back next stay in Porto !!!
We had a nice trip to Porto, where we enjoyed this airbnb very much. Everything was as expected, and we had a good communication with the host.

The apartment is very well localized with good space. There are plenitud restaurants around. Very close of metro station.
The apartment odor was pretty bad, I guess due a toilet drainage issue.
Ana; the person that checked us in was very polite and gave us few tips about Porto

Very attentive host, the apartment was great, sparkling clean, excellent location!!
If you are ever in Porto I really recommend you stay at Joao’s place!!

Fantastic apartment, within walking distance to the top attractions in Porto.
The apartment was really comfortable for 4 people and absolutely clean. The automatic check-in and check-out was quite fun as well, honestly!
Lovely place, in a great location! Hosts were very helpful with any questions! Hopefully we will be back :)
We had a fantastic stay in Pedro's apartment - it was beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. The location was great - about a 10-15 minute walk to the main sights in Porto and the river.

Pedro is the best AirBNB host we have ever had! Very friendly and took time to show us around and give us plenty of local tips (the sandwiches are a must).
The apartment is spacious, clean and has a great location within close walking distance to everything but a little out of the touristy areas. Highly recommend visiting Porto and staying at this apartment!

This was the best air bnb we have ever stayed at! Pedro was the perfect host and incredibly helpful every step of the way. Every room was designed and upkept so well it made us feel very safe and at home. Everything was truely wonderful and was a complete highlight of our trip :) THANK YOU for making our stay so special Pedro!!

What a wonderful apartment and a very wonderful welcome from Pedro who truly is a super host! He showed us around his beautiful duplex apartment and then showed us around the local area. He gave some great tips for lunch and dinner options in the local area. The apartment has everything you need and is well located for exploring Porto and the surrounding area.
Pedro is by far the best host we’ve encountered and he made our trip very special!! Highly recommended!!

We truly enjoyed our stay and cannot recommend the apartment and Pedro as a host enough. The apartment was beautifully renovated, stylishly appointed, fully equipped with quality items (kitchen, linens and consumables, etc.), and was by far the cleanest Airbnb we've ever stayed in. The location is perfect with nearby restaurants, grocery, laundry, and easy walking distance to all of the major attractions. Pedro redefines the meaning of superhost with his timely and clear communication, easy and welcoming check-in, quick tour and information about the area, and sincere willingness to help in any situation. If you are looking for a place to stay in Porto, look no further than Pedro's place!

Pedro was a great host, he is kind and friendly and quick to respond (both before and during our stay), and was happy to help with recommendations for restaurants/places to visit and even let us store our bags before/after our stay. The apartment itself was perfect for us: easy to find, lots of space, comfortable large double bed, clean, and in a great location for exploring the city. We would highly recommend staying here ❤️ thanks for a great stay!

Pedro’s duplex is an amazing property and Pedro is an absolutely exceptional host. From the moment my husband and I booked our stay until the minute we left, Pedro went above and beyond to help us and make sure our stay was as enjoyable as possible. The duplex is spotless & located in a wonderful neighborhood with plenty of great restaurants & a small market nearby.  We loved returning to our apartment each night & really appreciated Pedro’s thoughtful extras and attention to details. We highly recommend a stay at Pedro’s historic downtown apartment!

Pedro was above and beyond… helpful, friendly, responsive, kind
And the apartment was pristine

If you want a slice of inner city action, this is the place! Easily walkable to everywhere, right near fab local bars and restaurants and just far enough from the tourist hoardes...
Apartment is gorgeous, everything you need (and properly everything, loads of loo roll, kitchen paper, tea towels, oil, condiments, nescafe pods for the machine etc - makes such a difference!)
Two balconies to watch the world go by below and enjoy the delicious port, provided by Pedro.
Pedro really is the host with the most! Feels like the old days of Airbnb when you actually got to meet real local people who can give you the inside track of the area... Charming and responsive, took us on a handy walking tour, pointing out all the local places to go, (and trust us, his recommendations are worth it!)
Thanks Pedro, hope to see you soon!
Great location very close to metro, train station and sites plus a good supermarket. Clean bright apartment ideal for a short break. However front apartments face onto quite a busy road.

We absolutely loved this gorgeous apartment! Stylish, clean and cozy equipped with everything you need for a perfect stay. Check in details couldn't have been more straight forward and the apartment itself greatly exceeded our expectations. Fantastic base to explore Porto. Great location with lots of restaurants, bars, local shops. We walked everywhere, but transport is also convenient should you need it. Carolina is a fantastic host and so helpful! Communication with her was really easy and quick. Can't wait to come back!

This location is amazing - it’s a short walk to all major attractions and bus lines, yet very quiet inside. The check in was very easy with the self-check lock box. Carolina made herself available for any questions we had. We loved it!!
It‘s a nice apartment. Really close to the Duoro and Sao Bento station. It‘s perfect for a couple. The bed and cushions are very comfy and everything was very clean.

Really enjoyed my stay at the apartment. The host was very communicative and made the checkin process very easy. Lovely apartment with balcony and view. Excellent location to use as a base to explore Porto. A++++

The apartments are located right in the city center, close to the famous promenade. Easy to get to any attractions. But keep in mind that this is quite a noisy street even in the evening, as there are many restaurants and tourists around. Even with a small child, the noise from the street did not bother us much. Karolina was always in touch, quickly answered and helped when something was needed. The place is clean and good-equipped. Overall we are satisfied with our short stay :)

Spacious and very clean and comfortable apartment in a great location. Carolina was a great host, very helpful and quick to respond. As per other reviewers, the only drawback to this spot is the rubbish collection point beneath which means a lot of loud noise at odd hours of the night. Apart from this we were extremely happy with our stay and would highly recommend.
Great stay in a beautiful apartment. Fantastic value, too. This is a full apartment on a main street in the city center. I'd book again next time I'm in Porto.
Brilliant location. Fairly basic amenities but has everything you need for a short city break.
Great apartment for a short stay in Porto, place was nice and clean and short walk to city centre.

I had an amazing stay at this place. The apartment was so clean and so nicely decorated.
The location was very good in the heart of the commercial area but so quiet. Cesar was an amazing host to reply to every my question very shortly. I wanted to stay more...
Thanks for everything!

This place was FANTASTIC! I was greeted by Cesar, who was super informative, responsive, and very kind. The apartment is small and cozy, and has everything you need - and was super clean and super peaceful and tranquil. It is on the 4th floor (no elevator!) of a historic building with beautiful wood floors and tastefully restored.
Great neighborhood that didn’t feel touristy. It is conveniently located just a couple of blocks away from a metro station and a major shopping district (with 2 huge, multi-level shopping centers, with grocery store and international food courts - but somehow magically hidden from street view behind traditional shops and such), but the apartment itself is on a very quiet side street.
Extra special touches included some lovely port wine to try and yummy treats. Wonderful apartment and excellent hosts. A+!

Carmen’s place is fantastic for a getaway to Porto - not only is the location pretty much perfect, walking distance to the main sights and dozens of amazing restaurants, the apartment was sparkling clean and the host offered many amazing local tips. Totally recommend this place!!

We really enjoyed staying in the apartment. It was clean and very well put together. César and his family put a lot of attention to details and you can see that. Everything was very well accommodated, I literally can’t think of anything that was missing!
Overall: very clean, put together and nicely designed apartment with a good location!

The apartment is well located, the announcement is accurate and it is very good value. Cesar is an attentive host, that makes sure that you are settled. There is even a brochure with recommendations of what to do and see around.

The apartment is very nice, tastefully decorated and close to one of the nicest streets in Porto.  Easy to reach by Metro from The Campanha train station and to move around town by foot or Metro.  Cesar was very responsive, met us at the door at the agreed time and answer our our questions promptly.  Highly recommend.

Cesar’s place is very nice, cosy, comfortable and quiet. Well-located in Porto, we really enjoyed our stay. Cesar and his co-hosts were very responsive and available to help. We will definitely come back!

Had a wonderful stay at this studio apartment for our first visit to Porto. The space is very well equipped with kitchen supplies, plenty of towels, and a binder FULL of information and recommendations about the city. Rui was so, so, so kind and helpful. He is very responsive and kept in touch about check in time. The location is just a 5 min walk to the shopping center and Balhao Market (and metro stop). Very easy to walk to other locations around the city while being out of the hustle and bustle! The street is actually very calm and quiet, even with being so close to attractions. I would recommend this stay!
5* Porto experience! Great new apartment with every amenity and perfect location. This apartment is a must when visiting Porto.

We were very pleased with everything. The location was perfect, it was in a rather quiet part of the city and everything was nearby. The apartment was bright, high standard and the host was super nice. She was available and helpful. There was not much of a view from the window and there was some noise from other guests.
Lovely apartment with a great host! We spent five nights with our 16 months old boy in Marílias house and enjoyed every day! Thank you very much!

The host is accomondation is highly recommended if you want it to be a little quieter and still want to be in the city quickly. Metro nearby and very good bakeries and supermarkets. Only to be recommended!!!
We very much enjoyed staying with Felipe. The place was very stylish and well located. We will be back next time we stay in Porto.

The apartement is very nice and clean.
5 Minutes walk to the metro station.
Supermarket and restaurants near by.
Belina was very kind and answered immediately to all of our requests.
I recommend it to everyone!
Very nice and confortable apartment. Belina is very nice and helpful, she goes the extra mile to help her guests. Thank you very much.

Very cozy, pretty and comfortable apartment near metro station Marquez. Walking distance to old town. Lots of shops near by, also walking distance to bus station. We really enjoyed our stay there. Definitely I recommend it. ;)
This place is just a block away from the "Marques" station. So getting around is pretty convenient. The studio is clean, modern and have everything you need to sleep well.

Great place to stay. Very clean and neat and was exactly what was advertised. Our host was great. He let us check in a little early and even helped us carry our bags upstairs which was so nice. The upstairs gets a little warm even with the AC on but there is a window that you can open and hopefully catch a breeze. We also loved how the closet was downstairs. It was convenient to not have to go up and down the stairs when we wanted to change. We would stay here again and recommend this place.
It’s soooo beautiful apartment,  very nearly in center and nearly so many restaurants.i love this apartment
Fantastic apartment, great location and incredibly comfortable. Hard to imagine a better place to stay in Porto!
The apartment was perfect and any issues or questions were quickly sorted. It’s a little noisy at night due to the street so bring earplugs! Everything else was great!
Good communication and very helpful and understanding staff.I would definitely recommend anyone who wants to visit Porto’s attractions to stay at this place. It’s clean and good for a short stay.

Great place. Host is so kind and helpful. Goes out of there way to make sure everything is perfect for your stay. Big apartment. We stayed on the third floor in the loft. Just a couple streets from the heart of the city. So easy to get to from the train station 7-10 minute walk or 10 minute walk from metro. Metro from airport £ 3.00

Great spot for a long weekend or a long stay, just wonderful!!! Clean, spacious and PERFECTLY decorated!
PS. Ruan was so much helpful! Totally recomendable!

Eduardo and his colleagues were extremely helpful and accommodating to our small group. I would highly recommend this beautiful apartment. It’s well located, has a very unique interior design and had all the necessary amenities. We had a lovely stay at this place.

It was a great stay, parking was of course tight as you’re right in the city of Porto, but the host greeted us with the garage door open. He was super helpful and gave great tips too. The building is beautiful and nice high ceilings. They worked hard to make it very nice and we were very impressed. Beds are big enough which is important!
Obrigado!

Overall very little love for details and low quality furniture. Quick and responsive host - for instance we had issues with the coffee machine which were fixed immediately so that was great!
However you can feel little genuine hospitality, you get the feeling the host wants to disappear as quickly as possible and the restaurants recommended were tourist traps. Also, the parking outside the apt. was not for free as indicated on the apartment profile.
Wifi was quick enough to work. So overall an OK stay if you're just looking for a place to crash, especially at the competitive price.

Wery good location.
Street parking and very close by a Metro station (4 stops into the center of Porto).
The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is perfect, near shops, bars, restaurants and tourist attractions. The host was very helpful and friendly, gave us very useful tips!

Staying at this location was absolutely great! The apartment is next to a very cool art district where you can find a lot of nice coffee places and street art. The location was super - we could easily walk everywhere! The apartment was clean and well decorated. Communication with the host was easy and fast. Definitely recommended!

Lovely studio, with just what’s needed for a great visit to the center of historic Porto.
We had a wonderful time. Thanks Margarida
It was amazing place to stay! Especially we like many kind of very thoughtful things here - towel heater, wine, bread, fruits. Thanks a lot!!!!

after a bad experience that we had in Como, Margarida's flat was a suprise for us, super clean with lots of details.
she is really quick in reply. even she has prepared a booklet which it was helpful.
100% recommend this place.

This apartment is stunning, clean, and perfectly located. It’s on a quieter, cute street that connects right to the main roads near the river, where there is so much to see and do. I was here during the power outage in Portugal, and the host left us a flashlight without us even having to ask :)

Great central location with loads of restaurants in the area.
Host very helpful and responded fast with any queries we had.

power went out. place was clean. beds were nice. noise form outside was very loud. communication was amazing. we were able to stay in apartment past check out time. amazing place other than minor issues

The apartment is located in a central area with plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby, which made it very convenient for exploring the city. The hosts were very welcoming and accommodating, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. Overall, I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Porto.

Great location. Paula is very kind.  The apartment is perfect for a group of six even if they have different interests.  we were family,young party people and a couple with a baby, the distribution of the rooms allows one go in and put without bother who wants stay in and rest.

The accommodation was very clean and nicely established. Marianna is a super host and she will sort every problem that occurs. I am thankfull for her hospitality and loved her place. It really is literally walking distance to town center.

We had a truly lovely stay at M's place!The apartment is located on a peaceful street close to Porto's main sights and you can also reach the southern part of the town and port wineries easily by walking. Everything worked well with the self check-in and the place was clean and cozy with beautiful artworks on the walls. We were also beyond happy to discover that there's an aircon to ensure good night's sleep after warm summer days. Thanks again M for a great accommodation!
Great location and an easy walk to lots of activities. Lovely apartment, air conditioner was a plus. Highly recommend
Very good location, near by train station, exactly a few steps from the beach, quite surroundings with sound of the sea. The room was under our expectations. We were satisfied.

We loved our stay in this lovely apartment. Easy check in. The host was super helpful, gave us lots of recommendations and answered all our questions! The area is lovely, just a short walk to the river and from there you can cross the bridge into Porto. Great breakfast! Highly recommend…
Great location and the breakfast was excellent. The stairs are a bit tricky, but we were just very careful. I would stay here again.

This is a great guest house. Everything was perfect. Antonio and Anabela are truly super hosts. I would give even 10 out of 10 on AirBnB :). They have a very friendly housekeeper called Paula who takes care of the place with love. I would definitely come back again.

Vert nice!
Matched the pictures, everything was clean and Antonio was very helpful and responsive.
While not inside the city center everything was within walking distance.
Excellent views, enough space for two, very close to restaurants and coffees. Will definitely come back.

Walking up four, narrow flights of stairs with luggage for a family of three was inconvenient, especially so since you cant drive up to the apartment and it’s located half way up a steep cobblestone street.  More inconvenient was booking this place with a hide a bed with the expectation it would be ready to use. Instead we had to pay 30 euros for bedding so our kid could have a place to sleep.  All that said, it was in a great location for São João and in a very central location to other sites. We watched the fireworks from the living room which was incredible.

I enjoyed my stay here. Very close to the action in Porto. I walked everywhere once I arrived from the train station. Be prepared for steps, but that’s typical in Porto. Besides, the view is well worth it. Highly recommend!
Bruno’s place was near the cathedral. So its location was pretty good and view in the house was awesome.

Perfect location, most of the atractions are on walking distance, superb view, quite and cosy.
Good raport for money.
Fabulous  location, amazing balcony views, great communication and check in meeting.  Cannot fault the apartment or the host, would love to return!
Great location! The views from the balcony is amazing! Very responsive hosts and great recommendations about local restaurants and business. Loved the stay!

Bruno and Paulo are great hosts of this airbnb, the communication was responsive and helpful. The view is incredible and the location is very central to lots of sights. We, a family of 4, enjoyed our stay and will definitely stay again when in Porto.
