Me and my husband came to visit Porto with another couple and Bruno's location is perfect! We pretty much walked to everywhere in Porto with lots of things we can do. Sao Bento metro/train station is within a short walkable distance. Porto is a hilly place so definitely be prepared to go up and down the hill everyday. Just make sure to bring a pair of comfortable shoes! The view by the balcony at this Airbnb is gorgeous!!!! worth every penny we spent!

We had a great stay! Bruno and Paulo were super helpful, very responsive and were extremely accommodating of our changing schedule. We would highly recommend this apartment for its location, cleanliness, amenities and most of all the super hosts!

We loved our stay at Bruno’s place, the view is amazing and the balcony is a perfect place to sit after a day sightseeing.  The street is very quaint and quiet at night and the apartment is in the perfect location as we were able to walk to all the sights of Porto.  We would definitely stay here again and recommend Bruno’s place without hesitation.  Thank you

WOW. Bruno’s place is a gem in Porto - tucked away in the old cobblestone streets. The view from the balcony is absolutely spectacular - the photos don’t do it justice! We wished we were staying here longer.
Bruno and Paolo were both very responsive and kind. Paolo met us at check in which made the process very easy. I also left something on accident and they were very accommodating and went out of their way to help return it to me. Would highly recommend staying here!

We had so much fun!  The location was close to many places, and within minutes we were drinking coffee and lots of restaurants to choose from.  There were many ways to get to the apartment from many points in the city.  We were on an adventure each day.  Very cozy place we had a nice time.

The views from this place are absolutely stunning! The accommodation was spotless and had everything I needed. The location was fantastic - so close to many attractions and restaurants within walking distance. Being on an upper floor meant a bit of a climb with luggage, but the provided water, snacks, coffee, and wine were a lovely touch. Loved my stay here!
Great location, needed a late check in so this place was perfect. Very clean and host always there if needed. Would definitely stay again.

Porto is a Fabulous City and this is a great apartment to stay in when visiting. The best thing is the location, seconds from the river front. At the same time the apartment is spacious, modern, very clean and safe. It has everything we needed and more. Also the communication from Brunna was first class, and we enjoyed flexibility on checking in which was great. A five star experience in a five star city.

Brunno E Nuno has an exceptional place. Starting with location, it's literally minutes from the Dom Luis Bridge, City of Gaia, and lovely cafes. The apartment is perfect for the solo traveler or couple - it's clean, the bed is big/comfortable and the bathroom hast to be my favorite about the place! It's big, sleek and modern. They also have a dual purpose washing machine (you may need your own detergent) and we all need to wash our belonging while exploring these amazing countries.
Lastly, the communication was top notch and even allowed me to stay an additional day due to some arrangements in my flight itinerary. Thanks for a wonderful stay! I will surely be back!

This location was unbeatable. You’re a block up from the ribeira, next to a great architecture tour, and a 5-10 minute walk from the train station. The apartment was small, but had everything my husband and I needed and was very clean. Brunna was wonderful and checkin was timely and brief. We would stay again.

We loved this place, the location & the very friendly hosts. Everything was absolutely smooth and we loved that we had the option of self-check in and we didn’t need a key. You can tell everything is done with love in this apartment and the Internet is very good so you can easily work from here. Any questions were answered within seconds. We will definitely come back!

The room was so nice and well decorated ! The swimming pool is such a plus and we loved it. It’s located in a quiet part of the city which is nice
We did the self check-in, that was easy and fast
The room was nice and in the middle of Porto. Pretty cool :) But it’s a hostel!

myself and my best fried Julita had a late flight into Porto so we paid for a taxi to accommodation,  the host was there to meet us and show us around the flat and explained how things worked, even provided us with some milk, bread and ham, cheese which he obtained from his sister Tina who lived upstairs, lovely friendly host.

This place is a gem. The description and comments are all true. It’s clean, big, beautiful, has parking and is in a great location of the city. Not only that, the hosts are outstanding. In advance of our visit we got a sample walking tour and list of restaurants which really helped us maximize our short time in Porto. While it was only two of us, this place is perfect for a family or friends traveling together. If we return, we will be sure to stay here again!
Cool apartment in fantastic central location. Wonderful and responsive hosts. Our only issue is that we only stayed 3 nights!!!

One of my favorite Airbnb experiences. Anita and Nuno’s place is the perfect place to enjoy Porto. Beautifully designed, full of sun, strong wifi, equipped kitchen, every detail thought of. Definitely plan on enjoying the sunset from the lovely deck. And Anita and Nuno are wonderful hosts!

Porto is amazing and this apartment is the prefect place to stay there. Close enough to walk everywhere, but on a safe and quiet street. The apartment gets a beautiful breeze, which makes sitting on the deck even better. Nuno was incredibly welcoming, and we wish we could have stayed longer.

We had the pleasure of staying at Nuno and Anita’s apartment, it was by far the best location we stayed at during our month long stay in Portugal.  Nuno and Anita were so thoughtful and made sure we had everything we needed when we arrived.  There even was a crib, high chair, and baby accessories available as we were travelling with an infant.  Communication was excellent, the apartment was extremely clean and well thought out.  We only stayed for 2 nights which was the biggest regret during the stay.  We will definitely stay here again when we visit Porto again.   Highly recommended!!!
Perfect apartment. Great space, excellent location and great hosts. Just as the pictures and would happily return.

Excellent place! Everything is thought through in this Airbnb. Nuno was very friendly and helpful with our questions. We were allowed to keep our car in the garage after checking out. Our family of 4 lived staying here!

We had a lovely time at Nuno and Anita’s place. I’ve never had  such a wonderful host who greeted us and gave us a lot of good information about what to do, restaurants, and getting around.  It was truly a comfortable place with so much beauty and great balconies to hang out on.  We really enjoyed hanging out in the kitchen with our coffee in the morning as really neat courtyard and view of the neighborhood.  The AC in each room was awesome and worked very well.   It was fully equipped with amenities of coffee that is super important to me. He had a nice selection of waters and other drinks for a small price.  He had also curated some bottles of wine for purchase that I would have loved to get into, but didn’t have the time!  It was an easy walk to most attractions from the apartment. The walk home is a lot of uphill so sometimes we took an Uber back.  Super hosts for sure!
Nuno’s apartment was fabulous! Spacious and clean in a very convenient location. So many thoughtful touches - including a local wine selection. We look forward to staying here again.

This place exceeded our expectations! The host went above and beyond making us feel comfortable. The house had everything we needed and more. I loved all the books on Portugal. The views from the house were great. This is by far the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in. Next time we are in Porto, we hope to stay here again.

Couldn't ask for more. Nuno gave us a comprehensive introduction to the apartment and Porto. Beautiful new building. Thoroughly enjoyed our 4 day visit and I can assure anyone considering the apartment that they will not be disappointed. Thanks Nuno

Wonderful place. Beautifully decorated, very clean and comfortable. Ines was was very helpful; she greeted us and showed us how everything worked in the house. She was helpful with parking instructions ( which can be a bit challenging in big cities) excellent experience.

We had everything we needed and they accommodated our luggage as we arrived earlier than expected.  Excellent recommendations for sightseeing and restaurants and provided a map. Beautiful patios and even supplied converter electrical plugs and had wine and beer available.  Coffee and port as a welcome and umbrellas for when it rained!  Literally couldn’t ask for more! Private porches off every living space too!

Nuno and Nia were absolutely amazing. Very kind and helpful. They had great recommendations of things to do while in Porto. The home itself was even better than I anticipated. Multiple terraces throughout to enjoy a nice drink after a long day exploring. Very convenient location close to many tourist attractions. I would love to come back to Porto again and I would definitely come back to Nuno’s property.
I really can recommend this apartment. The owners are very friendly and the apartment is in the center of Porto.

I had such a pleasant stay in Susanas and Pedros apartment.
The location is super convenient, just a few steps away from many restaurants.
And despite of being well located in the city centre, it is not noisy at night. I could sleep peacefully all the 4 nights Ive been there.
For the ones working remotely: the internet speed is really good; I was surprised by it.
I would recommend it and come back anytime I go back to Porto.
Muito obrigado!

We booked the apartment for a week and it was a pleasure to be there. The Check-in was easy and the communication with Susana (the Host) was very good and welcoming.
The kitchen has everything you need to cook, the bed is very comfortable and the view and location is stunning. And on top of that this was by far the most clean AirBnB I‘ve ever visited. You have everything you need there and you can explore Porto very easily on foot. Everything is close by. We will definitely come back and of course we recommend the apartment to everyone who wants to visit Porto
My boyfriend and I had the most magical time in Porto. Couldn't recommend the city or this apartment more. Prime location with nearby parking!

Perfect place to stay in Porto, beautifully styled with all the necessities you need for a comfortable stay right in the middle of the city. Sofia was a very responsive and friendly host. Couldn’t ask for me...

We love the place Sofia was given us. The location is amazingly close to everything and the area serves all your needs from restaurant to bars to pharmacy to normal grocery shops.
The apartment was clean and very cosy. We enjoyed our time being there and the communication with Sofia went fluent and uncomplicated.
Lovely apartment with a great location. Highly recommend to anyone staying in Porto for a few days. Sofia is a very wonderful and responsive host.

We had a beautiful stay. Very well kept along with being clean, great location and extremely relaxing. The hosts where amazing even helping with dinner reservations and dropping us extra coffee pods. It’s a must stay for Porto. Beautiful city and what amazing hosts. Thank you so much Sofia

Sofia was the absolute best! The home is perfectly situated on a bustling street but when the curtains are drawn it’s quiet and peaceful. You have everything you could need (fridge, coffee, iron, hairdryer) and a lovely apartment with cozy bed and chairs.
Sofia went above and beyond with local recommendations and accommodating every request. Stay here!! You won't regret it.

We had a great stay. The location is in the heart of the city . Plenty to do and see and easy to get to all the best the city has to offer!
Highly recommend the apartment!

Sofia’s flat was perfect for us. Centrally situated in the city close to everything. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, so we had no problems at all. Everything went smoothly, which is exactly what you need on a shorter city break. All the recommendations were great, the restaurants and taxis were just spot on.
I would highly recommend Sofia’s apartment and would definitely stay again. A very well deserved 5 stars.

I cannot recommend this place more highly! The hosts were very accommodating with early check in and were flexible when our arriving flight was delayed. The view is spectacular, the house clean and the beds comfy. What more could you ask for? Just be aware that it is up a hill so be prepared for some physical activity or to grab a cheap uber when heading back.

The view is amazing! The space has some small quirks but is overall comfortable and functional. The location is also fantastic, especially if you’re interested in exploring the port wine cellars in Gaia.

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view. It’s located in the beautiful district of Gaia, super walkable and close to many places. Communication with the hosts was pretty smooth. Really helpful and responsive. Would totally recommend.
great location! hosts are super organised and check in with the keypad was very easy. only thing is no doors on the bedrooms. other than that, highly recommend - really clean, swanky place!

Great place to stay. Excellent location- walking distance to Ribeiro and beyond yet quiet over night… if not for screaming seagulls. Nothing you can do about it except shut the windows. :)
Good communication and timely responses from the host. AC worked as needed. Thanks.

Great apartment close to the heart of Porto. The hosts were super nice, promptly answering our calls and solving our lack of hot water within a couple of hours. Beds are ok, showers are great. Nespresso, tea and traditional biscuits were a pleasant surprise.

Really nice apartment in the heart of Porto, next to Casa da Musica. The flat is big enough for two, quiet, clean and very well equiped. Nearby there is everything: metro station, bus stops, super markets etc. Next to Avenida da Boavista which leads to the ocean.
Will keep in mind next time we 'll be in Porto
Great place to stay for a very reasonable price. Was very clean and they were very helpful. Let us leave our baggage with them once we checked out. Couldn’t ask for more

Place is great. Bathroom is a bit small but this wasn’t a problem for us. Street parking around the area is hard to come by but there is a parking garage ($) around the corner.  The sofa bed wasn’t very comfortable but we managed. Host/cohost were very helpful! Overall great place. A bit of a walk from center but Uber is super affordable to and from center. The city is beautiful! Would definitely recommend.
The apartment is well situated with many amenities around and bus around the corner. It's very good for solo or couple travelers
everything is OK. Couch is not new with some small holes or smth like this. apartment is comfortable for 2 persons.
Beautiful apartment , all there at use, Maria very nice and proactive.We had a problem with the shower head and the day after she has replaced it ;)

Would highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto. The location is very central, and you can enjoy wonderful access to amazing pastel de nata, and the beautiful sights of the city. It’s even a short walk from the fernicula so you can get home quickly from the river. The space was just like the photos and super comfortable. Would also mention the shower was one of the best I’ve ever had while traveling!

Excellent location to explore Porto, the main attractions are within walking distance. The apartement was very clean. The kitchen is very well equipped with all kitchen tools you need to cook. The host also organised an airport shuttle, which we really appreciated. We would definitely stay here again!
The apartment was at a good area - it was close to attractions and restaurants. The apartment was very well equipped and impeccable.
Location was great! Close to the metro and in the middle of everything. At night the street itself could be a little suspect but aside from that it was great!

We had a great stay here. The airbnb was in a central location so we found it very easy to get to everything. The place was clean and easy to check in. The host was lovely and accommodated us checking in an hour earlier. Even though it was close to the center of everything, it was still really quiet and easy to sleep.

Thank you for a wonderful week in Porto! The apartment was very clean and cozy. The location is excellent—within walking distance of many sights, and the neighborhood itself is full of interesting things to do. Everything worked well, and the apartment had everything I needed. The only challenge was opening the front door, which took a bit of practice, as the locks here are quite different from those in my home country, Finland. I felt at home here and would be happy to stay again. 🌺

Exactly as described/pictured, perfect location, good noise insulation when everything is closed - great place
Shower basin near the plug hole feels a bit fragile and water leaks on the floor slightly
The apartment was beautiful and bigger than I thought. The location is perfect and the check-in is easy. I also forgot my keys inside and the owner of the apartment helped me really fast. Thanks!

We had such an amazing time. The location is perfect for walking and exploring. Maria was very quick to respond and handled an issue (that was not an issue of the Air BnB) with the electricity and the city and stayed in contacts with updates the whole time. It happened to be a HUGE championship Football gave between FC Porto and Italy so it was very active! Even with the festivities it was still quite with the shutters closed. Be aware, the space heater does not work but we were fine with the apartment heating unit. This is a fantastic find and I would stay here again.
Great apartment, very clean, had everything we needed. It is in a good location, just a bit noisy at night but to be expected for being in the heart of the city.
Great host. Organised a private transfer from the airport (Carlos) who was fantastic. Apartment was better than the photos. Lots of helpful tips inside!

We loved staying at Maria’s place. The checkin process was efficient and instructions clear. The location is located by many good restaurants and close to the Duro.
Maria was very responsive and accommodate an early checkin. When we come will stay here again.

We had a wonderful remote working and holiday stay at Maria’s place. It is in a fantastic location but there is a lot of construction and some noise also from other apartments and the street below. Not surprising probably when you’re so central. The space itself is beautiful - really cool and comfortable.
It does feel like there’s a little wear and tear - like some things being slightly broken or stiff and it’s more expensive than some others we saw, but still recommend for a beautiful space in central Porto.
We loved Maria's place from start to finish!  It is a beautiful place, a wonderful location, and felt right at home.  Highly recommend Maria's place when visiting Porto.

Maria’s place was the perfect location for our time in Porto! Extremely walkable in a quiet street. The place was comfortable and had everything we needed. We had a fabulous time! Definitely recommend.

We absolutely loved the apartment. It looks just like in the pictures and is perfectly located, right in the heart of everything and easily accessible from everywhere. For those who prefer a quieter place, staying outside the city might be a better choice.

This house is the absolute best! I would recommend it to everyone. Prior to our arrival we had contact. Our host Hugo responded very quickly wich makes life easy. Arriving at the house was easy and Hugo was there to welcome us. He gave a good tour of the house and was very precise in explaining everything.
The jaccuzi was great, the outdoor kitchen worked perfect, the rooms are spaceous and luxurious. Bathrooms are equiped wich rainshowers. Our stay at this house was absolutely perfect. The weather in februari was real good, unfortubatly a little too cold for the pool. But we'll try that next time!
Thanks again for having us and being a great host!

The villa is perfect for a relaxing break away with friends with a bbq, pool, and jacuzzi.
It was very convenient to have a nearby bakery, butchers, and a small supermarket (about 5mins walk away).
Hugo, our host, was friendly, pleasant, and helpful and was just a call away if we needed anything/had questions.
I would highly recommend going to the following restaurant and vineyard for amazing food and wine - Winebar Casa da Viuva and Quinta da Avelada (book in advance).
The villa is in a rural area so car transport is necessary. We relied on Andre, a local taxi driver recommended by the host who was excellent.

Absolutely amazing weekend at the place! Hugo was super professional and responsive. The house looks better in real life than at pictures.
Definitely worth its money.

Such an Amazing place! Swimming Pool and Hot tub absolutely Perfect.
We had a perfect Holiday and enjoyed everyday we stayed.
Hugo was so Help full with anything we needed, Cant wait to go back.

A large, light and airy space that is close to the centre. Prompt responses from the host.
Would stay again.

If you would like to explore Porto and the douro this is your place to be! Absolutely top location next to the centre. A wonderful view over the douro is also included. For a short break you can use the small but lovely garden in the backside of your house. Next to the location you‘ve got one of the best cafes in porto! Try it!

An airy and light place perfectly situated looking down at the Douro River and across at the monumental bridges and the monastery. Low key neighbourhood with the charm of local gatherings and the curious visitor.

We had such a great time in Porto. The location of the Airbnb was perfect and it was easy to walk to many great restaurants and sights. It was a great size for two couples and we spent a lot of time on the porch. Check-in was seamless and we were given the option to add in airport transfers which made our arrival and departure stress free. Will definitely stay here again if we get the chance to come back to Porto.
Wonderful space. Very spacious.  Great views. Easy walking distance to Porto's city center. The hosts were great communicators.
Very nice appartment, located from walking distance from city centre. Rooms are very spacious and there is a nice terrace to enjoy the evening 👍
Lovely apartment with great sized rooms. location was great for restaurants and some bars. Host was great with communication and very flexible with us checking in.

Marina is a very friendly Host, her flat is big and clean.
I highly recomment the flat to everyone who wants to enjoy the coast of portugal close to Porto and Espinho, which is a nice walk on a very idillic passway on the coast.
You find in Marinas flat everything for a confortable stay, Lidl and farmacy very close.
Thanks Marina✨
Florinda’s flat was perfect - spacious with a beautiful view and in an ideal location. Florinda was very attentive and helped us plan our time there. Thank you for everything!

We had a lovely stay at Florinda's adorable apartment with our two small children. There was plenty of space for everyone to be comfortable and the back patio was truly dreamy. The attentiveness, friendliness and hospitality of Florinda and Sergio was what really made our stay memorable!

We had a lovely time staying at Florindas place. She was extremely welcoming, helpful and friendly. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
The location is perfect. Lots of fantastic places on your doorstep.

This is a beautiful apartment!!! The location is unparalleled in Porto. It is in the middle of the most happening place in Porto, with superb restaurants and shopping. Make sure you make reservations for the best restaurants cause they fill up fast.
Derek was the perfect host! very responsive, the check in process was super efficient and convenient, and the description is pretty on point. It’s a historical palace newly renovated. So it has a lot of charm with all the modern features, designed very tastefully, and very comfortable for our group. This is a beautiful city and we feel like we got the best experience possible staying here. Thank you! We will always remember these memorable few days :)

Absolutely beautiful apartment -it was spotlessly clean and location is ideal for exploring Porto. Would definitely stay here again!! Also got lots of great recommendations from our host for restaurants and things to see in Porto.
Great central location.  Private. Nice balcony with a sunset view for a drink. But be aware there is major construction in the immediate area during the day.

Lovely spacious apartment right in the heart of the city and so close to everything. Gorgeous wood features. The double glazing is amazing as it cuts out any street noise when closed.
There is air conditioning in the main bedroom and fans are provided elsewhere.
We enjoyed staying here and would definitely come back again .
Really appreciated being able to leave our bags for a bit longer after check out.
Great communication too.

Maria is a great host. She is very warm, charming and cheerful person. The apartment is great located, clean and cosy.
It was a true pleasure to meet Maria and stay in her beautiful apartment!

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's! The apartment is well equipped and clean. she is very sympathetic and she spent a lot of time helping us to get to know the city. All in all we can totally recommend staying at her place
Great space and great host! Susanna was prompt to respond when we asked questions. We loved the location. No complaints!

Lovely host lovely place. Location not too far from the centre. But still, walkable. For those with walking difficulty, you might want to consider taking an uber/bolt as there is a very steep slope (typical of Porto) from the station to airbnb.  Nonetheless, we made it. Adriano was a five star host. He was really helpful and responsive. Even helped lugged our 20kg luggages to the room. Room would be perfect for 2 people. We were 3, a little crammed, but its defo compensated by the comfortable beds and convenient location.

The space created by João and Diana is amazing. The rooms are sparkling clean, the kitchen is equipped better than my own, the common space inspires meeting and getting to know travellers from across the world. The location is also very convenient: there are bus and tram stops 2 minutes away, and a supermarket across the street.
Had an amazing stay! It was last minute, very last minute and they accommodated us immediately and did everything to make us feel comfortable and welcome! Amazing stay! Clean and an oasis!
Place was nice and clean and felt luxury at times. Only thing lacking was the hot water in the shower.
Nice brand new hostel, very pretty old renovated house, only problem is the bathroom with no doors so you can not go to the toilet in privacy
Everything was great! Communication was spot on. My room was super clean! There’s a great gym nearby if you like to workout! And a great mall!
This house is very nice and comfortable for family trip. I want to recommend this place to my friend.
The space was very clean and a great location for getting around Porto. The host gave great tips and was quick to respond to any questions. Highly recommend.

Great location very close from General Tores metro station, Ponte Luis and board walk. Beautiful terasse, appartment is great with two bathrooms. A/C is 5/10 but great wind when windows are wide open. The building next door is under construction starting at 8am finishing at 6pm everyday… a bit noisy not for staying in bed ahaha. Great spot with a lot of local shops.
Cute apartment with a spacious bedroom and well equipped kitchen. Gustavo was friendly and very responsive. Recommend.

Overall it’s a great experience. Check-in was easy and the host super helpful. The house was exactly has advertised and very clean. The place is very central  and is near a lot of the best restaurants and places in town. Our fear was noise but the house is to the back of block so it’s very quiet as well. Highly recommended.
Lovely stay in Porto in the quieter neighbourhood of Bonfim. Short walk to the centre and the host was very helpful/quick to respond to any queries.

Nuno was very helpful and made checking in / out very easy. The place was very clean and tidy with a lovely terrace outside, perfect for a little porto getaway. It’s only a 30/40 minute walk to the port with a beautiful garden you can pass through on the way which we fully recommend. There is also a food market next to the apartment which isn’t all traditional Portuguese food but is worth checking out. Overall a great stay :)

Nuno was a very nice host, responsive and super flexible - and the apartment was super clean! We were a bit unlucky with the weather and couldn’t enjoy the beautiful terrace. The location is not very central and not much to do around, but everything is very walkable. Overall we liked our stay !

Mr. Nuno is very friendly. He was professional from check-in to check-out. I really enjoyed my stay; we stayed for nine days and everything was clean and tidy. The rooftop terrace is spacious, and the location is convenient. I highly recommend this place, it's a great choice for many people.
Thank you

Spacious apartment in a perfect location, just a few minutes from the river and from key sights, plus plenty of cafes and restaurants. Bottle of port was left for us on arrival - we had everything we needed, including a great view! Would highly recommend for a trip to Porto.

Lovely apartment in a great location. Hosts were very responsive and left lots of recommendations for the surrounding area.  Beware that all apartments are up stairs which didn’t worry us.but may others.
Luis's place was comfy, near the metro, just outside the tourist bustle, so in my books--perfect!

Porto stole our hearts! The place made it even better. Great hospitality and care. All went super smooth, the apartment is new, clean and communication was super. It will be our stay when we come back :)
Thanks again!

Communication was good.
Apartment was clean and the kitchen had all equipment I needed.
Apartment is located by a busy road, so noise is coming from there.

I liked living at Rodrigo’s apartments. Very clean at home and in the house, I found there all I needed, even radiator! Close to the Metro station, close to the centre. I was happy to stay there. Thank you!
This place is fantastic! We’ve been traveling around Europe for weeks and this has easily been the best place we’ve stayed!
This place was amazing! Loved the design of the apartment and it was so walkable to all the spots we wanted to see.

This is a beautiful flat, with amazing views. Great place to hang out during our rainy stay in Porto. Mariana was very helpful and the washing machine was an added bonus.
Two small caveats: two floor up means four sets of stairs so be prepared. And the kitchen was not easy, mainly because we couldn’t figure out how to turn on the stove!
I would highly recommend a stay here.

Silvia and Edu communicated, answering our queries. Edu checked us in. The apartment was lovely. There was a bit of a walk to get to the riverside but it was pleasant strolling through the neighbourhood .

João is such a great host and all the team at the hostel are super welcoming and helpful. The house is perfect to use as a remote working base whilst exploring Porto.
There is a lovely private garden that gets lots of sun, great aircon and the house is very well equipped and comfortable.
The location is ideal with only a couple of minutes walk to a main train/metro/bus station with fast links to the airport. Lots of nice cafes and local restaurants in the neighbourhood too. Just an amazing experience!

My husband and I stayed an entire month at João's house. We took our 2 cats with us, and they simply loved the backyard!
The house is charming and super well located, we had everything we needed within just some minutes walking. The place is well-equipped, and the internet is good and stable, which was perfect for us since we worked from home.
Joao and his team are nice and very helpful, they were always ready to help. I would recommend the place for anyone staying longer, like us.

The flat has a perfect location to discover Porto by feet or Metro. It is big enough for 10 adults. To our sorrow we found several defects, which we told the agent on the first day of our stay: one shower-rod and one toiletseat wasn't fixed. After 4(!) visits of the agent those two problems were fixed. One trashbin and one nightlamp was broken. Most difficult was that the sink-protection was missing which made it a challange to clean our dish. And there are no portwine-glasses and is no corkscrewer in the flat (remember: u r in Porto!) . All these missing parts werent delivered until we left after one week.
beautiful apartment but the walls are very thin, so you could hear the train station outside and noisy neighbours.

A very nice place away from the crowds but still a close drive to Porto and other coastal places such as Vila do Conde. Great to stay by the pool or take a trip around the area. Bakery and small supermarket in walking distance. Cristina is a great host, recommended!

The Airbnb is a really nice place especially for larger groups. The area is central and perfect for the stay. Communication is very friendly and easy! Kitchen and living room space was very nice
Thanks a lot

Joao and Gustavo were very friendly, the apartment is very comfortable, well equipped, and very clean! Besides,they answered my questions very fast and I was delayed for my check out and they could support me with no issues! Totally recommend!

The place is very clean and looks exactly like the pics. It’s very walkable to all the attractions. We only took Uber once. Other than that, we walked to all the places. There’s a supermarket a few min away from the apt. The apt is spacious for 4 people. The owner is very responsive to questions. The self Check in was very smooth. The only  cons: the beds are ok but not very comfortable and there’s only one set of towel for each guest. It would be great if we could get extra set. Anyway, we had a great stay!
The apartment was good 👍 the location is perfect and Marta was very helpful and answered at the time 😊

Marta was very responsive and the place was clean. Place was located near the center (walkable). There is no AC (as described in the listing), however we recommend  more than 1 fan in the apartment- especially during the summer months.

The apartment is lovely and has everything you might need. Paula was very responsive and very flexible for check in and out. Train service is very good and there is a lovely pizza restaurant right beside it. There is lovely walks along the beach and dunes. Can also rent scooters & bikes through Bird app. Only suggestion we would make is to have more local information and maybe a map of where the local restaurants, cafes and bakeries are. We only found some of them in the last day by chance.

a beautiful apartment located in the very center of the old town. the apartment has everything you need for living, and the view from the window is incredibly beautiful. the host is very communicative and answered all questions. thank you and we will definitely be back
Great place on the other side of the river, which is more touristy. Quiet, but still lots to do down the street.

We spent a few nice days at Diana's place. The apartment was comfortable and clean, the location was just great.
The balcony was especially charming. We had really great time in Porto

Great Place to stay, in the peaceful neighbourhood of Vila Nova de Gaia. Walking distance to the river and World of Wine. Diana was an excellent host, always available to address any issues/ answer our questions. Would definitely recommend!
This was such a great place to stay while visiting Porto! It is in a great location, with everything in walking distance. The balcony also provides great views of the city!!

Location is perfect! I’d stay again when I visit Porto. The only issue was the WiFi not working well as I do work remotely, and check in was pretty late in the day, But overall, the place was a great stay and very comfortable!

Very generously sized apartment in the center of the city, the location is brilliant! Lots of restaurants, bars, and things to see right at the doorstep.
The apartment is furnished very nicely, and extremely comfortable. I would be very happy to stay again!

It’s a great place to stay very near to
Trindade Station and São Bento as well.
The place is amazing safe and secure.
We had a pleasant stay at Marcia's apartment.  It is centrally located, small but quaint, clean, and communication with check in and check out was a breeze.  Thank you.
Perfectly located in the prettiest street of Porto! This apartment is very nice and comfortable. Autonomous entry was super simple.
Great location in Porto! On a main street right by restaurants and the train station. The place looked exactly like the pictures and was clean and comfortable for our short stay in Porto.

Lovely stay, great location and great communication…it would have been better to have a/c due to the heat. There were fans provided but unfortunately did little to cool down the apartment even with the windows open…It was a lovely apartment and I should’ve have been more attentive on weather or not it had a/c…my fault. Other than missing a/c it’s a perfect place to stay…thank you.

So beautiful home, easy self check in and check out. Full equipped kitchen. Amazing fireplace is a cherry on the top! We enjoyed this place, many thanks ☺️ I wanna add just one note that it might be not easy to take a taxi from there)

The house is quite big and perfect to hang out and chill with friends. The terrace with ice machine is perfect! The location is OK, the trains are slow to Porto but Ubers are well available and not too expensive.

Gorgeous and super clean apartment in the center of Porto. The building is newly renovated, next to really good shops and restaurants. I would definitely go back!
Great choice for a couple!!!

Such a clean and cute Airbnb! Amazing location, walking distance to so many restaurants, shops, cafe’s. We really enjoyed our stay here! Claudia is very responsive and provided us with some great recommendations!

We (group of 11) visited from the UK and stayed at the Migranja Beach House for 3 nights. The beach house was immaculately presented; had all the mod cons you could need (including a fab top floor bar area with an honesty box); and is within easy reach of local beaches and Porto. Rui was the perfect host, who gave us helpful information before and during our stay, including recommendations on cocktail places and restaurants. 10/10 and we would highly recommend this place to others. Thank you for an excellent stay!

We had a brilliant time, the air b&b was perfect for purpose of our visit ( group of 11 girls ). Lots of space & lovely bedrooms, the party room upstairs was perfect for our evenings. Very close to the beach and also easy and not too far from Porto city centre. We loved it. Rui & Val were very helpful & friendly, responsive & easy to communicate with :)

It was really nice stay - flat was clean and cozy! Really nice window view, small balcony, windows can be closed and protect our sleep from daylight. At night it was absolutely quiet, and bed is very comfortable, so we slept very well!
Thank you so much!
This apartment was perfect! It has everything within a short walks distance. The apartment was secure and very nice. Will definitely stay here again!
Great spot to stay for the price. The metro is nearby which is easily accessible to everything downtown but have the peace of being in a quite neighborhood.

Space very clean, organized and comfortable. Location is pretty good, and we can get anywhere at ease.
Will for sure be back again!!
The location was perfect and close to everything ! I felt comfortable during my stay and the facilities were perfect for what I needed. I would recommend it to anyone !

Great location and on the bottom floor with a window! Just one room with a fold out bed and bunk beds. Host was very responsive the only small fix would be the mold in the bathroom but otherwise very clean.
Flat was clean and in good condition. The location is ok but a bit north so you have to walk a few minutes to get to the city centre. Overall we had a nice stay
This was a great apartment! Right next to the Trindade station and an easy 10min walk to all the tourist zones. It was clean, very cool, and easy to check in to.

Overall it was a great location and good stay but the shower had an extremely small amount of hot water. If one person took a 10 min shower there was no hot water left for anyone else. This unit needs a bigger hot water tank as three people would not be able to all shower. The bed sheets had some staining. Overall it could have been cleaned a bit more but generally speaking I would still recommend for a quick stay in Porto.

Great place to stay with our 1 year old.  Lift was convenient, kitchen well equipped and baby could crawl in circles to get his energy out.  Sousa was really helpful and the location made it easy to get to the river.  We could even get around relatively easily with the small pram which was a pleasant surprise.  Small supermarkets and lots of eating options close by.  Ended up using Bolt (local Uber), though no baby car seat options with any car transport services.  Really lovely little spot with a great use of space and tidy design.  Feels like a tiny house as opposed to an apartment.
Very clean and good located apartment. Communication very fast and easy. Checking very friendly and uncomplicated. Thank you so much!

This apartment was amazing, we stayed at a sister location 3 years ago and loved it as well. This apartment is not only located centrally to almost everything but it is very spacious and perfect for a family with kids. It's kept very clean, maintained extremely well and has all the amenities needed to make a trip to porto just perfect.
Souza was an amazing host, always ready to help and super flexible. The venue is super cozy and is in an amazing location. Definitely recommend! 🙌

Our stay was absolutely perfect! ☺️The location couldn’t be better , everything is close by and there’s so much to do in the area. The apartment is exactly like the photos, beautifully clean and fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. The host was extremely kind, very responsive, and explained everything clearly and in great detail. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto!
It was exactly like the pictures. Perfect for a relaxing vacation in Porto. We would go again.

Amazing place, everything was clean and maintained well. The place was beautiful and matched the photos which is a plus. We noticed that the remote didn't have any batteries therefore we could not use the tv. I texted the host and he provided the batteries very fast and it was late at night. Totally worth the investment, strongly recommend. Thank you for the lovely reception!
Great stay! It was a very cozy and nice place. It was well located and we could walk everywhere! We would definitely recommend and come back.

The apartment is fantastic. The location is perfect for exploring the city, with great views out across the river. Enjoy watching the trams pass by while enjoying a coffee from the café just below. One of the best places we’ve ever stayed. Thank you Filipe for making our week in Porto unforgettable!

We stayed at Marta's place for 4 nights and it was very nice: the apartment is perfectly located in the very center of Porto, but in rather quiet part of it. It has everything needed to make one's stay as comfortable as possible. We enjoyed it a lot, so thank you!

Renata is a very kindly person and gave us clear instructions and recommendations about the city. The apartment was clean and cosy and also very good location to walk around the city. We recommend this place and will go back there for our next trip to Porto. Thank you, Renata!

Joana's apartment is truly great, and right at the heart of the city. From the bathrobes and slippers, to communication, to personal recommendations from the hosts, everything was perfect. Definitely will be the first place to check once we're back in Porto :)

What can I say, great little apartment in the best location with knowledgeable sweet host. Everything was perfect and all their recommendations were spot on. thanks guys ( oops am I still allowed to say that? 😂 Don’t forget to do Douro Valley with Timur

loved our stay. We felt immediately at home here. All the amenities were exactly as described. The street this is on is very busy in foot traffic - make sure you're aware of coming in by Taxi/Bolt. Very hard to get taxi/Bolt ON the street, had to walk a few streets away which was fine once we realized why the Bolts could never find us. Very centrally located. Would totally stay here again.

Great hosts, very thoughtful, communication was seamless.
The apartment is charming, exactly as described, and the location is perfect, very central.
I definitely recommend.
The apartment is very convenient, well located, super clean and spacious. Ana and João made our arrival easy and comfortable. The apartment is a bit darker than it looks but still very pretty

Great place, walking distance to many restaurants, markets, and places to visit during your stay. Place was well kept, and clean. Check in was easy and an elevator is available if you have luggage that you need to take up to 2nd floor.

What a neat place! The Airbnb was comfortable, clean, and really cool. It’s close enough to everything to be convenient, but far enough that’s it’s quiet and relaxed. I feel like I could live here. Would recommend to anyone!

Me and a friend stayed in the apartment over New Years and it was just perfect! It’s easily walkable to the city centre and really close to restaurants and bars along the river. The apartment is as advertised and has everything we needed.
Elio and Bruna were incredibly helpful and provided us with some excellent recommendations for New Years Eve and some general recommendations for things to do too. They were the perfect hosts!

Elio's place was perfect. You can just tell he's an experienced host that understands and makes his guests' experience in Porto exceptional.
Cozy apartment with everything you need and is so close to nearby attractions. We loved staying in the place and would recommend it to anybody travelling into Porto.
Really good apartments, communication was great and host was lovely and friendly and very accommodating. great central location in beautiful Porto.

This was an excellent place to stay -- the apartment matches the photos perfectly. The terrace is great, and the views from the apartment are beautiful. Lots of natural light. Easy access via elevator. Excellent location for exploring Porto!

This apartment is quite small (the bathroom sink is hilariously tiny), but it has everything you need and works fine for two people. That said, the outdoor terrace was amazing (the absolute highlight of the Airbnb) and the location was perfect. The apartment was very clean and we had no issues whatsoever with checking in.

The views from the balcony were absolutely stunning day and night. The apartment is a bit bijou but practical. A kettle would have been useful for the tea drinkers but we managed. The bathroom sink was small for my husband to shave. That said the views from this apartment and the great location  far outweigh the smaller details inside.
Amazing location and fantastic place! The communication was super smooth and check in was easy. We would definitely stay here again in the future.
Had a fabulous stay in this lovely apartment right next to the river with stunning views and location close to the Porthouses and the old town.
We love this place! Awesome location. Warm host . They are super responsive . This place is just wonderful . I would recommend to my friends and family for sure!

We loved this place!!! Although it was on the smaller side, it was perfectly outfitted, and the location could not have been better. The apartment was right on the water, walkable to everything and cleaner than clean. It's a beautiful place.
Better than the pictures this place was absolutely incredible and one of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in.
We really enjoyed this stay in Porto. The location was fantastic and the host was great. Would highly recommend this home for any visitors to the beautiful city of Porto.
It was a really nice stay at Paulo's apartment. The view and the location are just great!

Overall i had a pleasant stay for a few days.
The place was as advertised, a room at first floor after a narrow staircase; with small kitchenette, fridge, private bathroom and a nice view.
The room was quiet, clean and spacious and self check-in and out went flawlessly.
It is placed a few minutes from metro and Jardim do Morro and subsequent Luís Bridge, and there's a few minimarket nearby and a large Pingo Doce a 10 minutes walk away.
I didn't meet the host, but comunication and instructions were clear and extensive.
As other have mentioned, the mattress and pillows are quite stiff and someting to consider (it didn't bother me much).
The Appartement is very beautiful, it is near the center and well served by metro. We had a fantastic days in Porto. Thank you

This beautifully designed apartment is as beautiful as the pictures. Use it with care!  If the kitchen had been stocked with some more essential ingredients, it would have been more stellar and welcoming.

This apartment was perfect for our stay. It is just out of the center/near a central train station, which means it is easy to reach but also quiet at night. I would recommend it for a couple's or girls' trip.

The apartment is very nice. Very well appointed kitchen, comfortable beds, delightful views of the Duoro River, and once you get used to walking up and down the hill, very close to restaurants , shopping and the historic downtown area.
We had a great visit! The check-in was easy and apartment was exactly what we needed. Location is great as well, with quick access to the river.
Lisa was a fantastic host. The view from the terrace is breathtaking! Overall we really enjoyed our stay

Such a lovely Airbnb. Hosts had amazing advice and guides to Porto and made the stay really enjoyable. Flat is beautiful and looks exactly like the pictures, thank you so much for such a great trip to Portugal! Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay

All the attraction, restaurant and walking tour recommendations were great. We tried quite a few of them and found them all to be excellent choices. The apartment was well equipped & comfortable. The beds were comfortable. We came into town early and were able to drop off our bags which we appreciated.

The perfect apartment for a vacation. Spacious and comfortable with a spectacular view across the rooftops of the historical city and down to the Douro river. The sunny balcony at the front, and the garden at the back, provided ample private outdoor space and Tiago was immediately responsive to our questions about the area and requests for transport. We loved exploring Porto and found the apartment to be a relaxing place to recoup and relax in the evening or during the day (high ceilings, comfortable beds, and well-equipped kitchen, eating and sitting areas). This was one of the nicest Airbnb places we've stayed in. Perfect for a family with teenagers or for two couples visiting together.
Clean, tidy and in a central location. The balcony was very noisy because of a generator and did not have great views.
We had an absolutely lovely stay. There is so much to do with an adorable balcony, they let us check our luggage early so we didn’t have to carry it around. Perfect 5 stars

Great little apartment to stay in. Location is amazing and 15-20 minute maximum walk to anything in Porto. Loved going to the market each morning. A little noisy at times during the night but nothing sustained at all.

The Formosa apartment was a stress-free stay. The apartment is central, which makes it a perfect base to dip in and out of the many local attractions. Despite being central, the area was quiet at night, making for a good nights sleep. Definitely value for money.

The appartment was really beautiful with the old wooden floors and the high ceillings. We we're right in the center of Porto, everything was close by, the stores to do some shopping, a variety of restaurants and the market 2 minutes away by walk. I gladly recommend  this place!

Very nice and clean apartment located in the center of Lisbon. We really liked our stay there, the owners was very helpful and the apartment had everything you needed for a short stay. I recommend this accommodation for anyone going to Lisbon!
Great value for money. Clean, all basic amenities are there, central, and extremely helpful staff.

thank you for your hospitality. Our stay in the apartment was good and comfortable. I will recommend to friends
the accommodation is clean and comfortable, the view from the window is very beautiful :)

Great stay, only thing I could say about the flat is that the walls are really thin and I could hear a lot the flats around.
But Im use to sleep with sleepBuds so not that disturbing to me
Lovely space in a very central location! Nice view of the Torre des Clérigos. Clean and just as described. Would recommend.
Prime location, very close to the metro and the park with gorgeous view :) very fast communication with the host, overall I’d recommend
Not recommended at all.. the room was so tiny and not up to the mark as showing in the pictures and they charged you for unacceptable things 0 out of 10
This place is clean, perfectly located with amazing hosts that make you feel welcome and address any concerns. Highly recommend as your home when you stay in Porto! 5 stars all the way!
Really lovely apartment, very spacious and clean. Great location, just a short walk to lots of bars and restaurants, and only 5min walk to the river!

Overall the stay was pretty pleasant.
The listing was very clean, had all the necessary amenities. The host was responsive and all times.
I would definitely recommend :)

Great location handy for the river and up the hill to the sights.
Clean, simple flat. Easy to find and check in.
Would happily stay again.

Well located in historic area, very close to Sao Bento station.
Lovely views, great restaurants in close proximity & a cute wine bar downstairs.
Perfect size for myself & 2 friends.
When leaving the apartment, make sure you have the key on you, as the downstairs door is deadlocked & requires a key to exit.
The laneway does feel a little dodgy if you enter from the top end.

We had a great stay here. Only issue is that you can hear a lot of the street noise. It’s on a side street not a major road but there’s still a good amount of noise during the day. Otherwise no issues, would recommend.
The property was just as expected, and exactly like the photos. Location was perfect for walking to all main sights, restaurants and shops. No issues with check-in and check-out.

Everything about this accommodation is excellent! The location is perfect, the place is spacious and it has very cute terrace, as well as everything else you need during your stay - from towels to coffee machine. Communication with hosts is easy. Highly recomennded!
A cozy apartment with everything you need to visit Oporto. The location is perfect and the communication with Elena and Alexander so worm. 100% recomended!

Lovely studio,perfect for couples or solo travellers wanting to experience a few days in Porto. Comfortable bed and great shower. Excellent location but you need to be fit for all the walking and the steep hills! Had a great time here and would recommend.

Really good experience from start to finish Edwardo met us and went over everything and was there if we needed anything also at checkout offered to store our luggage for a couple of hours would highly recommend

Great location, reasonable size for the price, and very attentive host. My only issue was the musty smell which has probaby been caused by the visible damp in a couple of the rooms. Other than that would highly recommend.
Amazing central location in a quiet street, couldn't have asked for more. The accommodation was great, just like in the pictures. Me and my friends enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back.
Great location. Very clean. The construction noise was not a problem. They worked during normal daytime hours when we were not in the apartment anyway. The restaurant across the street was excellent.

The apartment was very well located in Porto and was clean and tidy.
A comment: I used to let a property (in the Algarve), and always left tea bags, coffee capsules, milk etc in the apartment for guests to use. There was nothing like that in this apartment, not even a bottle of water. I think this could/should be made more explicit on the information relating to bookings.
Apart from that, the apartment felt secure and was in a good neighbourhood.
Dr Mark D
Amazing apartment in the centre of town. The place had everything we needed. Had a great time and it was nice to have so much space. Communication was great both ahead of time and during the stay.

What an amazing location! the spacious apartment with 4 bathrooms made it easy to travel with 2 families.  The beds were very comfortable and he heat also worked well, perfect for chilly, rainy days. Having a washer and dryer was a bonus! It is 4 flights up so be prepared but the space is worth it

My friends and I (8 people total) had the pleasure of staying at N Apartments - Luís. It was perfect to accommodate us and was located central to everything in the city. Definitely walking distance to most if not all notable sites of interest. Very quiet apartment building. Will note that the elevator was not working during our stay; this wasn’t a problem for us but may be to some since it is 3-4 floors to climb. The apartment had tons of space for us to spread out, lots of light and a big kitchen. It was really nice getting to come home at the end of the day and all be able to sit at the dinning room table and couch. Overall, great stay. As described and pictured. Would stay here again.
Perfect for a large group, very big apartment. lots of bedrooms and bathrooms. Easy to co live together.
Really nice place - clean, great location close to the center, the only problem we had was the small window in the toilet which we had do cover somehow because everyone could see through.

The apartment was as described and photos are exact the same in reality. The location is just incredible, Ponte Luís 1 is just 1min walk from the apartment.
All that I needed in the kitchen was there so you can cook what ever you want and the WiFi quality and speed are remarquable

The location and the views from the unit was incredible. Able to enjoy the port as well as the city of Porto
Patricia was a great host, very accommodating

The pictures does not do this place justice. How can I capture in words how wonderful this place is?! The views were out of this world. It was easy access and walking distance to local attractions, restaurants and transportation. The place was cozy, clean and kid friendly. The host was super friendly, kind and full of life. It was such a pleasure to stay here. Snatch it up if you’re traveling into Porto. This place is a gem!

I had the most amazing stay in Porto thanks to this Airbnb! The location was absolutely perfect, so central to everything I wanted to do in the city and close to some great restaurants as well, and the apartment itself was gorgeous, stylish, and so clean. I especially loved the meticulous details throughout, such as the washing machine, dryer, and dishwasher tucked away in the kitchen (which was also well-stocked with dishes as well as some oil and seasonings for cooking) as well as the wall panels that unfolded to create window coverings. The views were also fantastic! Could not say enough great things about this place.

A great, clean, central, and comfortable stay! João was a responsive and proactive host. Made our Porto trip better than what we could have asked for.  Also appreciated the Nespresso, (we brought some pods), toaster,  and electric kettle which made mornings easier before setting out for the day.

We had a great time in Joao's apartment, which is in a perfect point to visit the city! The bed was very comfortable and the host was really kind and helpful: when I asked for one more towel, he immediately answered and provided one the day after! Just one little thing, be careful about taking long showers because hot water doesn't last too long. I would recommend this place to anyone and I already miss the beautiful Porto! Thank you Joao once again :)

Pedro and Maria are exceptional hosts and their apartment is lovely, a perfect place to enjoy Porto, and one that felt very much like being at home. I’m highly grateful for their hospitality and would prefer to stay here in future whenever I visit Porto. Highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay. It‘s a very nice and comfortable place in the middle of Porto with a great view from the balcony. Well located, you can reach a lot of touristic places by walking from there.

Great location and very clean and tidy. Host was very responsive and friendly. Check in was also simple and easy. Area was a little noisy but just like any city centre and location was definitely worth it. Windows and light were amazing, highly recommend this Airbnb.

The good: Great location, nice apartment, very clean and modern.
The reason it got 4 stars and not 5 was because the kitchen supplies were very lacking. When I book Airbnbs, I do it because I expect to be able to fully utilize the kitchen, otherwise I would just stay in a hotel. The only pan was the most scratched Teflon pan I have ever seen. It was missing some other basic things like spatulas, oven mitts etc.
Some other things to note: getting to the apartment is a bit confusing if you follow g**gle maps, but just read their instructions and you will see what street it is on. However, lots of people have had this complaint and they have not taken the effort to adjust their check-in instructions to be more clear. The place has a lot of potential, but its clear its a property management company that doesn't seem to be worried about the finer details.

Irene’s place was phenomenal. It was close to just about everything and arriving from the Sao Bento train station, the flat is just 2 min away walking which was easy for me given I had heavy luggage 😅. Irene was such a great host, even met me on arrival and checked throughout my stay to ensure I was comfortable. Would highly recommend and would stay here again!

This is a wonderful place to stay in Porto - it is clean, exactly like the photos, and it is a well kept apartment! Irene is an excellent host and she went above and beyond in her communication and preparation for the place. I would highly recommend you book this place for your stay.
We had a good stay, but it does get noisy outside at night, so it was hard to get some sleep during the weekend.

Excellent!!! Perfect location with lots of bars and restaurants near by. Also not far from anywhere.
Highly recommend if staying in Porto!!
We enjoyed our stay for 5 days, would consider selecting the place if we come back. Clean and good surroundings.
lovely place, hosts were responsive and helpful. I had a great time. A lot is walkable and the neighborhood was quiet.

We loved our stay at Patricia's apartment! It's very centrally located, so you can easily walk everywhere and you have lots of restaurants, shops and sights within walking distance. At the same time, it's located in a quiet street.  The apartment itself is great, it was super clean and very modern and stylish! Also well equipped with everything you need. We also worked from there and the internet was good for this too. Patricia was very friendly, always replied quickly to messages and gave us great recommendations for things to do around! 100% recommend :)
Great place to stay! Very handy location and clean. Good design and airy. I would come back. Perfect location as there's a subway station around the corner.
The apartment was in very good conditions, it is well located, with many good restaurants within walking distance. The communication with the host was very clear and straightforward.

Great appartment to stay in Porto for a few days. Very close to most of the main attractions in the city, everything is walkable. Communication with Pedro was really easy, quick replies, very friendly and good tips on what to do. Recommended!

Pedro was a fantastic host! Excellent communication; the apartment is spotless and close to where you want to be for a few days in Porto. Also very safe and secure. I very highly recommend this listing to everyone.

Great location - super close to the river and the bridge (lots of stairs though 😅) and walkable to most of the attractions and restaurants.
Pedro was a great host. He insisted to carry our luggages to the second floor. Sent us all helpful information before we even asked.
The place is very clean and well kept.
Thank you Pedro and we enjoyed Porto from your place the fullest!

The apartment itself was great, however, the communication was absolutely terrific. We didn't know how to check in until an hour before we arrived despite many attempts. When we were to check out, the office was closed.

Small cozy place, we did not spend a lot of time in the apartment, so it was fine. We did enjoy the small balcony. The location was perfect. Everything was within waking distance. The apartment is on the third floor so be ready to get your luggage upstairs. Good experience. I would rent there again.

The apartment is located very well if you want to see the center of Porto.
The apartment is super clean and well maintained. We especially enjoyed the cozy terrace.
The only thing you should be aware of, is the loudness. We could here out upstairs neighbors all the time.
Great location! Easy to get to many of the attractions. Really easy to communicate to the host. Thank you very much!

Good location, close to some nice neighborhood restaurants and a park as well as the metro station. Maria was very helpful with parking our van and suggestions for restaurants, both of which were very good.

Good apartment. Nicely renovated and functional.
Its a bit small but good windows that give you space feeling.
Near the sea and about 35 min drive to Porto.
I liked it.
Amazing location and lovely room! The hosts had fantastic recommendations and the area was central to many great restaurants/sites.

Maria was a wonderful host! Her and her team were helpful and provided local recommendations on places to eat and things to do. The location was perfect, so close to everything we did and made everything walkable!

The apartment was very nice and clean but it was very hard to sleep since the apartment didn’t have any air conditioning or fans and we went in the summer. The host was not as helpful as I’d have liked, we had some communication problems.
It is a very small apartment with very basic amenities. Bathroom is not very well designed and water was clogging. For family of four it is very small with only 2 blankets and no spare pillows.

We booked this stay for 1 night , it was a bit smaller than expected but did what it needed to do in terms of giving us a space to lay our heads. In a peaceful neighbourhood with a lot of seafood restaurants near by. 15 min drive from Porto. Good location if you want a change from the busy Porto
Lovely apartment, the host was proactive and always available. The position is perfect, very close to many activities.
Had such an amazing stay here, the location was more than perfect and we could walk to places very easily. The space was beautiful and I’d love to come back and visit.

Lovely stay in this host. Very modern and new, looks so beautiful. Only the neighborhood is a bit loud.
I would reccommend it!

The place is as described. Very clean and enough space. It's really in the centre of Porto, which means you can fully enjoy how life is in Porto ;-). Perfect place to stay for a couple of days to visit the city.

The place was just perfect. Really good area with lots of nice restaurants and easy to get around the city. The apartment is just like the pictures. The bed was good and everything was clean and new. Would recommend everyone to visit this apartment when in Porto.
It is truly a unique night in a boat. The marina is a cool place to hang out, and not that far from Porto, it was gorgeous on Sunsets !

We had the most amazing stay at Paulo’s place during our stay in Porto - it was the a wonderfully decorated, very practical apartment with everything we needed! Extremely clean and modern with a few lovely touches. Will definitely be back!

Rui was a fab host! Really responsive and an easy self check-in/out. He was very kind and let us check in early so we could drop off our bags and get exploring. The Airbnb is perfect, we stayed for a long weekend and it had everything you could need. It was close to everything too, we didn’t use any public transport whatsoever because everything was 15-20 mins walk away. Loved the Airbnb, loved Porto, and I’m very close to booking my next trip back! Thanks Rui!
we loved our stay, great location, comfortable, Rui gave lots of ideas for sightseeing and food, always quick to respond, laundromat across the street. would highly recommend
Rui was a great host. Always helpful and very responsive. We enjoyed our stay, very central to everything if you’re touring Porto. Highly recommend!
Great apartment. Close to the city centre and Rui was extremely helpful with restaurants and directions. I would stay there again. Loved Porto!

Our stay in Porto was fantastic thanks to Rui’s hospitality. The apartment was in a great location, had everything we needed, and Rui sent plenty of great recommendations to ensure our short trip was well spent. We would happily stay again!
Alina’s place was clean, as described, easy to checkin to, and right in the mix of everything!

There was a slight hiccup in my reservation but Mariana was quick to fix it.
Mariana and Faith are also very helpful in every way.
The house was very clean as well.

What an amazing apartament, close to everything highly recommended. The hosts are amazing and they reply to you very quick. From the check-in to the check-out everything was perfect. I can't wait to go back and stay there again. Thanks once again for everything

If you have a chance to stay at Alice's place take it. You will not regret it. It is elegant, charming, cozy, excellent separation between with 2 fully comfortable suites (I traveled with a colleague or if you have children. safe. private, in the gate parking space. Just amazing!!

Fabulous two bedroom - two bath suite with a southern exposure. There is a patio off the main entrance - the perfect place to enjoy a drink after touring Porto.  Alice is a terrific host who went above and beyond to make our week-long stay in Porto memorable. Recommended.

Beautiful Place just like the pictures. Close to metro although we walked everywhere. Very safe residential area with grocery store close by as well as a lot of restaurants a few blocks away. Very comfy bed, beautiful garden area, very quiet and peaceful.
Aesthetically lovely and very comfortable. The garden was the cherry on the cake! Alice was available for information and instruction and we appreciated her kindness. Highly recommend
Very nice and clean apartment close to all the main attractions in Porto.  Close located to the metro and train station which will allow you to visit also Braga and Guimares.

Great stay for the three of us- clean, spacious, and centrally located. We thought the space was really well designed and did not feel overcrowded. There was no noise from the street or neighbours, and so many great restaurants and bars nearby. The host, Monica, was extremely responsive and flexible, making our stay really relaxed. We would definitely recommend and will likely return ourselves!
Great place for a reasonable price, the hosts were very helpful and we were able to check in early! Decent accessible location.

Very spacious and clean accommodation over 3 floors. Good value for money.
Unfortunately not all windows/bedroom balcony doors had curtains/shutters so can’t keep light out in mornings. Also showers + baths don’t have any shower curtains.

We loved our stay at this apartment. The location was great and had many places to explore and dine within walking distance. The apartment was exactly as pictured and was very clean. Check in was very easy and having a provided parking spot was extremely helpful. We would stay again!

This is THE place to stay when visiting Porto. Ana greeted us at the apartment and we were blown away with this beautiful space in the best location. The home is decorated fabulously with so much style. There is AC in the living area but we were able to just open the big windows to let the light in and take in being in the center of it all. Despite the location, we also found that it was incredibly quiet when we shut the windows which is helpful with a 7-month old baby. Ana provided a high chair, baby bed, and baby bath too, which we really appreciated. You will be so happy you chose to stay at Ana and Joao's place on your visit to Porto.

This accommodation is very very perfect!!
The accommodation is in the main downtown area, so you can walk everywhere. The view is very nice and clean.
What's unfortunate is that it is difficult to use very warm water if you wash in both bathrooms at the same time. Wash it separately and it will be solved!
I want to stay here longer.

A good accommodation for a family of four.
My parents have some mobility issues so be mindful that the apartment is on multiple levels but they managed.
Really nice and comfy! Surrounded by green, woke up by sunshine, bird, rooster, and adorable cat in the morning <3

We loved this apartment and didn't want to leave! We could walk to everything and were right in the middle of everything but it was so quiet and peaceful.
We can't wait to return.
Note: If you have children, the apartment is on the 2nd floor and the steps are quite steep.

The balcony was amazing ! The bed was a little bit small for two.
Great location. The hosts were helpful and responsive!

The apartment 100% corresponds to the photos, sunny and cozy, not so far from the city center (40 minutes by walk). The owner helped me with all the questions I had and responded very quickly. I would highly recommend this place to stay.

Fabulous apartment. Almost new and extremely clean. Excellent beds, bathrooms, kitchen etc. Pedro was excellent. Two little points, don't leave a glass of water beside your bed because it will probably fall off! Heating is a little difficult to control. I would definitely return.

Pedro was a great host, super friendly and helpful.  We were able to do luggage drop off and park the car early, in order to explore while apartment was cleaned. We were able to check in early also. Pedro even carried our luggages to the unit. Beautiful quiet area but walkable to everything.  Apartment kept in shape and clean. Would stay here again
Brilliant spot in Porto, close to the river and vibey restaurants. The place was beautifully done, with everything you could ever need. Highly recommend!
Amazing place to stay, great apartment, location, would definitely come back. Might not be adequate for young kids due to the stairs.

This apartment was fantastic- everything was clean and comfortable, and the cool layout of the place makes it seem very roomy. And Pedro was an absolutely wonderful host- he was easy to reach, incredibly thoughtful, and lovely to meet! We would definitely stay there again and recommend it highly to friends.

I stayed for 8 nights, this apartment is perfect for exploring Porto, very easy to walk to everything. Our host met us and helped carry our bags to our 2nd floor apartment. Everything was explained. Apartment was immaculate and was cleaned 3 times during our stay, with fresh towels and bedding. There are stairs to the apartment but we managed these, even my 75 year old mother. Would highly recommend for a stay in Porto.

André is awesome. He is really a great host. He was very welcoming and also available for questions and suggestions. We had our private room and bathroom there. I don't know about the public transport except that the bus stop is nearby and the bus that stops there takes you to the centre (30min). I really recommend the place if you love dogs as I do 💖
Beautiful palce to stay! Miguel was a very friendly host and shared some great recommendations for Porto. Thanks for hosting us!
The Airbnb was perfect, very clean and complete. We really loved the location, very close to the shops and restaurant. We definitely recommend this to everyone!
The place was very clean and modern. Great location, only thing to say was it was very small and cramped, nowhere to put suitcases. Apart from that it was great
Nice, little, clean and cosy appartment with a well equipped kitchen. No noise from the street or from the other appartments in the building.

Ana was incredible. We were welcomed into the flat with some port wine and one of the best chocolate cakes that I have ever eaten.
Ana and her husband provided us with great information about what to do in Porto with our 4 year old. The apartment had a great location and was in great condition.

Ana was very accommodating during our stay by giving us a list of restaurants to visit in the area as well as things to do! She even baked us a chocolate cake which was very delicious :) The place was also very well located with an easy walk down to the historic centre as well as many public transport stops around the area. Can’t wait to come back!!
A great apartment that is far enough outside the city center to be away from the mobs of tourists, but close enough to be walkable.

We had a great stay in Joana’s apartment. Even though we arrived late due to lost luggage she stayed up late and gave us a great welcome and introduction and recommendations of the city. The apartment was also very nice and tidy, and just a short walk from the beach. Couldn’t have asked for more!

Everything went very well. Very friendly and quick communication with the host. The apartment was exactly as described. We can highly recommend the location of the apartment, with a sea view and close to the beach and the charming neighborhood streets in Foz, as everything is easily accessible from there.
Such an amazing stay and check in was so easy! Claudia was great and the apartment was in a great location!
