Fantastic stay in a beautiful house. Its a huge house with lots of spaces for relaxing and privacy. The house is exceptionally clean and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The bikes were a extra bonus.
One of the best air bnb we have stayed in. Modern apartment with all the necessities we needed for our stay. Highly recommend

We had an amazing stay in spite of the rainy weather. Porto has so much to offer and everything is within walking distance. We rented a car and drove from Lisbon but we later realized that a car is not needed. There is great transportation to get you around. We definitely recommend this place as it is very centrally located.
A really great location! Easy to walk to everything we wanted to do. The balcony was amazing to relax on after a long day!
It was quiet place, clean and secure. Not noisy, l liked the parking in the basement, the AC was good.

We stayed at Vasco's flat for 3 days and it was an excellent base for touring PORTO. The flat was immaculately clean,  nice touches on arrival and a very good responsive host. Communication was excellent,  great WiFi connection also.

This place is amazing!! So cute, so neatly and a perfect location! Cristina helped us more then we could ask for. With lots of information and even tried to help us book a massage and pedicure. Many thanks we will definitely come back!

Very lovely stay at Cristina’s place, our 6 year old daughter slept very well on the sofa bed despite the pouring rain! Kitchen easy to use and fully equipped. Very private & quiet. A few minutes walk to bus & tram so quickly in the city center or at the beach side.

Absolutely comfortable, stylish, and thoughtfully designed apartment — every detail has been considered. I stayed here during a workation and spent a lot of time at home, so I truly appreciated how well-equipped and cozy the space was.
Cristina is incredibly kind, responsive, and always quick to answer any questions.
The apartment is just a 3-minute walk from the Douro River and 5 minutes from the ocean. You’ll find parks, stylish cafés, and restaurants of all kinds nearby. The city center is about 15 minutes away by taxi.

This is a lovely quieter corner of Porto to stay in, a bit more lowkey but easy to get into town (we love to walk everywhere), or catch the metro which is ~10 mins walk. The building/accommodation seems quite new, and the courtyard was not accessible yet, which was a shame because we had seen some photos and were really excited! Check in relies on someone meeting you there, and given you cannot always be sure of your arrival time this can be a bit tricky/stressful, but the team were really responsive and it worked out.
All in all it was a little less homely / artisinal than we maybe expected but comfortable, clean, modern and we had a great stay.
Very nice stay. Quiet apartment in a calm area. Very good and quick communication with the host company. Would definitely return here another time.

Well equipped apartment. It is well located in a nice neighborhood with restaurant and close to city center.
All communications done with a renting agency and not directly with the owner of the apartment, be prepared to receive several messages per day for all types of communication related to the appartement (arrival, stay, visits, departure).

The flat and surroundings were perfect to visit the city! Very clean and quiet flat. More than enough space to stay with 3 (2 adults and a 15-yr old teenager). The little terrace is nice to have a relaxed coffee or aperitif. Coffee bar at the corner serves very good pastries as breakfast and the Japanese restaurant Kintsugi (Kintsugiporto) blending Japanese with Portoguese food was amazing, next to the various other nice restaurants close by. Do not hesitate to book the flat, you will not regret and will enjoy a wonderful stay in Porto!
Thanks, Hailey!

Amazing stay and host. The apartment is centric and you can walk anywhere from there. The apartment was cozy, clean and beautiful and the host was very responsive. If we come back, we would definitely chose this airbnb again.
This was my favorite place that I stayed in Portugual. Very spacious and the location was excellently. Everything was super clean. Would definitely return

Lovely clean apartment with all amenities you could need. Great location with easy access to main tourist spots, yet nice and quiet at night.
Very easy check in and check out process.

Wonderful accommodation! It was extremely clean, and everything felt new and fresh. The hosts even left a bottle of welcome wine, which was such a lovely touch. We were also able to check in early, which made our stay even more convenient. The location was perfect, just a few minutes’ walk to the city center. Highly recommend!

Everything about the place is great, clean, easy to use and exactly as described. It’s a fantastic location with close walking distance to the old town and surrounding restaurants and sights. Thanks Alexandre for a great stay!

This airbnb made the holiday in Porto even better. The hosts are very welcoming and ready to help at any request. The location is very central and the flat has everything you need and it’s just like you see it in the pictures: beautiful, modern and clean. If you’re staying in Porto, I would definitely recommend you book this airbnb.

We had a great time here. The apartment was spacious and modern design with beautiful furniture. The neighbourhood is lively and cool. There're so many nice restaurants and bars around there. We wish we could stay longer here.

Don’t look further!
Best airBnB we’ve ever stayed in, by a mile! Beautiful place, tastefully furnished, clean, and everything we needed and more. Location is perfect as well, we easily walked every where, and there are lots of lovely restaurants and terraces very near by. The 5* is well-deserved.
We absolutely loved the food, drinks and people at Coupage 51, just around the corner.

I really liked the apartment, location and condition of the apartment. Clean, cozy, has everything you need, luxurious location. What else do you need for a good vacation?)) Nice attentive owner of the apartment, quick answers to questions. The overall impression is wonderful, I want to come back more than once to this wonderful city! Thank you, Alex!
Easy to find, central location. The space is beautiful! We really appreciated all the extra amenities in the kitchen- made cooking our own meals super easy. Would definitely recommend this place!
Great location and enjoyed the rooftop view! Easy to walk down to the promenade. Easy to check in and Filipe was a very kind and responsive host. Highly recommend.

The location is very central, walking distance to the ribiera, cathedral , restaurants and other local attractions. The building is clean and very well maintained (or newly renovated ?). The appartment is as shown on pictures, very clean and has everything inside (Shampoo, shower gel..  Convenient for backpack travellers 😊). Filipe is very available to respond to any questions. Thanks !! We had a very great stay !!
Great location and very clean, well-kept space. There were some minor issues with the amenities, but the host was responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend this place to stay.

Beautiful apartment and easy walking to everything, uphill of course. Clean and spacious and exactly as described. Filipe was very proactive with communication from original booking to start of our stay. Would highly recommend.
We enjoyed our stay in Porto- this place has an excellent location and is very clean and comfortable.
exactly like the pictures!! super modern and clean. Filipe was very helpful answering my questions. The beds were comfortable. perfect location. easily walk everywhere
Wonderful place to stay in Porto.  Close to good food, shopping and dinks.  It was  a great time.  Lots of hills in Porto, so bring comfortable walking shoes.

The apartment is beautiful and  located perfectly in walking distance to shops and restaurants. The streets in front of the apartment can get very noisy even in the middle of the night but the bed is hidden away behind thick glass doors which help a lot and make it possible to sleep.

Location was perfect; right at the centre of everything! We walked everywhere.
Pictures of the place are accurate so expect the same! Clean and cozy space!

Daniel was very nice, responsive. And helpful with suggestions for restaurants and parking. We loved our stay in Porto! Location was superb! We could not have asked for a better location. Felt very fortunate to find this place!

this place is special. centrally located, but the moment you walk in feel completely removed from the noise of the city.
impeccably decorated in good taste, the backyard/garden feels like a slice of paradise, and the bedroom (with central AC that actually works!) is both beautiful and perfect for sleep.
highly recommended.

Good location just 5 minutes to Santa Catarina nd Bilboa metro station, walkable to many attractions in center of Porto, many many restaurants near by, super markets. Very well decorated, comfortable bed and squeaky clean bedding.

This was one of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed at. Ricardo couldn’t do more for us, from early check in to mid stay cleaning.
Lots of room for our group.
Highly recommend.

Our stay at Ricardo’s apartment in Porto was wonderful! This is a prime location, beautiful apartment, and walking distance to everything. Perfect for large families or groups looking to take in the best of what Porto has to offer!
Lovely, secure place to relax after a day of exploring. Easy access to great restaurants and bars.

We had a fantastic stay at Isabel and Igor’s apartment in Porto. The place is beautiful, better than the pictures. Location is great, you can walk to all the important landmarks. And Isabel was available at all time which made our stay so much easier. We look back to being in Porto again and would definitely stay here again

fantastic stay at this Airbnb. It exceeded our expectations as I dont think the photos do it justice. We were blown away by the gorgeous architecture of the building and design of the apartment. Very spacious for our weekend getaway. The balcony overlooked a quiet market and location was spot on to visit the river, old town and walk all around to explore wonderful Porto. Highly recommend.

Excellent property in a prime location. Easy access to all major sites within walking distance, and a very convenient parking lot right next door.
We have stayed in several different apartments in Porto, but this one felt like a much more authentic experience and not a cookie cutter remodel like many other listings.
Highly recommend this stay for anyone visiting Porto.

It’s ok. It’s central and convenient. The apartment is big, and holds a family quite comfortably. The living room decoration is nice. 2 rooms are on the smaller side, but it makes sense as this option enable the house to have one more bedroom. The general feeling of the apartment refurbishment is that it could have more quality, especially taking into consideration the asking price for a night. There are definitely some sub par material and building quality options (I’m not referring to the old/historic nature of the apartment, but specifically to the new fittings. If you can live with that for a few nights, it’s an ok place.
Excellent home in a great area of Porto.  Clean, modern and very comfortable.  Alexandra was a great host.

What a fabulous stay!  Alexandra helped arrange transportation from the airport from a super nice driver and Mario helped us get oriented, gave us lots of great recommendations and was super helpful.  The apartment is modern but still warm because of the great decorating and the location is great too.  Great stay. Hope some day we’ll be back.

Alexandra’s place was pristinely clean and matched the photos. A perfect spot for 6 guests to live comfortably. Enjoyed the views from the kitchen and the furniture was comfortable. Alexandra was also a very attentive and responsive host. Would recommend to anyone visiting Porto!
We enjoyed our short stay in Porto! This place was very comfortable and we loved the views. We liked being close to restaurants, shops and historic sites. Thank you for sharing your home with us!

I think this is the nicest airbnb for the price I’ve ever stayed in. My cousin and I felt right at home the moment we entered. Extremely clean and beautifully decorated. Hope to stay here again in the future!

a nice place. what was not apparent is that it's one studio in a house with several other studios and a common area. we still had privacy in the unit, but it did not feel like a separate place but rather a set of larger remodelled rooms that were all Airbnb rentals.

Great location, maybe the best in Porto.
Flat is really cute, new and perfect for a couple.
However the entire house and the flat has a smell from the sewage pipes coming and going.
A wonderful accommodation - very close to all the key sights/transport links and kept in pristine condition. Easy check in and out and a perfect stay, thanks!
Great little self contained apartment in a fantastic location. Has everything you need for a short stay. Would happily recommend.

Good place for the price you pay, organised, clean and easy to self check in.  Walkable distance to the centrum of Porto with many bakeries, shops and supermarkets in the surroundings. The communication with the host was also smooth. Very much recommended.
I liked my stay at Andre’s place very much and can only recommend it to everyone. Andre himself is a very nice host. I just arrived in Porto and he was very helpful with any problems etc I had.
Had a great stay & would definitely stay here again! The apartment was clean, close to the area I needed to be & they gave me lots of useful information before I arrived. Thank.
Great experience with great, communicative hosts. Check in was in person and professional. Host was availible all the time via phone :) Great metro connection. Wheelchair was not a problem at all :)

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The communication before arrival was very helpful and clear. A bonus was meeting Neo at the building and being guided to the parking and the apartment. The parking garage is tight as are all in Europe, but easy to access and full in and out privileges
The apartment is as it looks on the site and has many fun decorative touches. It’s a very comfortable and warm place with very good amenities and a nice outdoor deck.
The location is great. Almost anything you might want to go to is within walking distance and we did that a lot. Remember though that Porto is literally built on the side of a hill and any walk means many changes in elevation including some very steep ones.
We would without a doubt stay here again if we returned to Porto and unhesitatingly recommend it to any couple that wants a comfortable, clean and well located place to stay.
We had a great stay in Porto and it was in a great location. It was good having a car park. We would recommend staying in this apartment.
this place was very cute and greatly located. we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. the garage was convenient and we went able to park and not worry about anything

This Porto studio was a gem! The view was absolutely incredible. The location was perfect, allowing easy access to all the main attractions and great restaurants. Our host was very nice, always responsive and helpful with local recommendations. The studio itself was comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto!
Well located, beautifully appointed apartment, full of amenities, right near the old town. We loved our stay here.

We loved staying at Daniel's place in Porto.  It is not far from the iconic Luis bridge and within walking distance to most of Porto's main attractions.  It has a wonderful, peaceful balcony which one can see the Torre dos Clérigos.  A lovely place indeed.

Lovely little spot for a short stay in Porto. Host was very communicative and helpful. Place was clean and tidy. In a great location being close to centre but just within residential zone so nice and quiet. Overall a good stay.

Joaquim was a very communicative host, and the apartment was very well located in Gaia. Everything in the apartment worked and it was very clean and well maintained. The only note would be that if you are three or four people you may run out of hot water as the shower did go cold a few times for us. There were also quite minimal provisions provided in terms of cleaning supplies such as dish soap, toilet roll, laundry liquid, dishwasher tablets, tea towel etc and so if staying more than a few days you will have to buy most of these things. Nevertheless, we really enjoyed our stay at Joaquim’s place in Vila Nova de Gaia and would highly recommend!

A great place, though noisy throughout the night as its on a busy road from down town. it would have been good to have a couple of absorbent cloths and some cleaning spray in the kitchen, but otherwise a great place.
Great place with very cozy apartment. We went to beach several times which only few minutes walk. Very quiet neighborhood and we love to come back again.

Claudio’s place was nice and clean. Comfortable bed. Very responsive to are need. Really appreciated of all the food like snacks, water, milk, coffee and tea we had once we arrived. That was very much appreciated.
Diane

The Airbnb is amazing, even better than the pictures ! The small garden is really cute and nice to enjoy the sun. The location is great but a little far from the center (which is not bad because de neighboor is very calm). Everything was convenient and clean. I totally recommend !

We had a wonderful stay at Alexandra’s apartment!  She was the perfect host and her place was just what we were hoping for.  Great location in a quiet neighborhood and close to all major attractions in Porto.  The apartment is thoroughly updated and super clean.  We loved our stay and hope to come back soon!
Great host, with a great place. You can walk to all the tourist spots and food within 30 min. The location made the stay very comfortable.

The place was amazing. The apartment was very easy to find, it was clean and there were many restaurants nearby. They also gave us a wine as a gift which made our stay even more perfect.
Overall, definitely worth staying at! :)

This place was very good. It provided anything you could need, in a good neighborhood, walkable from the center of the city. There was a problem with the windows, theere was a lot of noise coming from the street and cold. Also the bathroom door didn't close very wall, so there was a privacy issue there.

Nuno and his wife are SO friendly! It's a great location, next to the beautiful Parque Serralves. It's  walkable with easy access to restaurants and bus stops. I felt quite at home during my whole stay!
Very nice place. With garage. Really convenient if you have a car. Beautiful apartment. Calm area, with really great view.
It was a great stay at the residence. The residence was really cool, nice, peaceful and it met my expectation. Luis is really kind, supportive, proactive and highly responsive.

Very comfortable, quiet, and clean space. It's small, but very cozy, modern, and the view from the balcony is great. There's tons of great restaurants and grocery stores nearby within a short walk. If you like coffee, visit Fabrica coffee which is an easy walk away. The surroundings are much quieter than further towards the river, but it's still very easy to walk down and cheap to Uber back up. Overall, highly recommend this place.

Tons of room in the flat in the middle of Porto. The city market is literally across the street and you are one block from the metro station. Porto is an amazing city as well and it's all at your doorstep.
Overall it was a great stay. We were 8people total and this place accommodated perfectly.

Best airbnb ever. it was WOW. Delicious decour, HUGE apartment, banging location, we all LOVED it.
Thank you, Orla x

My family of 4 LOVED our stay in Porto at this wonderful apartment.  The location was absolutely perfect and walkable to all that we wanted to do in Porto.  It was lovely that there was coffee and wine left for us to enjoy and having the available amenities (shampoo/conditioner) in the bathroom was a very nice touch as well.  I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto!

I had a lovely stay at Francisco's place! It had everything I needed for my one night in Porto. And, Francisco & his co-host were super responsive and helpful. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a nice, comfortable stay in Porto!!!
All ok, only the neighbors had a loud party next to us and the apartment is quite noisy.
great place and walking distance to a lot of resteraunts. only complaint is, you can hear everything inside and outside. walls are very thin and neighbors are very loud.

Maria is excellent host. fast response.
location is excellent. peaceful and close to metro station and a lot bakeries and restaurants nearby. also supermarket is closely.

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb.
The only thing that bothered us was the limited kitchen equipment. For example, there was only one cutting knife (which was a bit dull), and we couldn’t find a cutting board.
Nevertheless, we had a good night in the Airbnb and really enjoyed our time in Porto.

"Maria Angela was such a wonderful host! She always responded quickly to our questions and made us feel very welcome. The place itself is super accessible, spotless, and very safe. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily come back!"

Excellent host(s)! Very kind and extremely accommodating (I changed my check in several times, thanks again!).
The apartment is comfortable, cosy in a convenient yet quiet neighborhood. On that note, Gonçalo recomrecommended a local authentic Portuguese restaurant, "Aliença", it was perfect!

We really liked our stay ! Cute garden and very friendly host . I would recommend this place to anyone who is visiting Portugal but wants to have more of an authentic not so touristy experience . They are many great cofee places and shops near by.

This place is very nice, very large, and very well located.  As advertised, parking would work for a smaller car but our rental was too large -- there is a paid lot across the street that worked for us.  Really can't recommend this place highly enough!

Fantastic Villa, very spacious (we were a group of 6) and modern, with very good outside space and pool. Good location, close to restaurants and beach and transport links to other places.
Host was excellent, friendly, helpful and accommodating.
We would recommend and stay here again.

Apartment was absolutely gorgeous!! The decor and furnishings were beautiful.
Easy to find.
30 minute walk to the main part.
Great value for Money. Super friendly Host that rund the Show Shop downstairs. Lovely Sunny courtyard with a big cat Family.

Very good area to stay in Porto. Very central to everything but still very quiet inside the apartment. Couldn’t hear any traffic noise. It was very clean and tidy and comfortable to stay in. Would recommend and will stay here again

Thank you Ilan, Ana and Joao,
Your lovely home was the perfect respite after walking the Camino. We love the location to places of interest, shopping, dining and of course, an easy walk to the river.
We will definitely recommend your home to others that are planning a trip to Port!
Cheers,
Mary Petrie
Everything was amazing the airbnb was a perfect location! Very easy to walk around. The apartment was very clean and felt super nice. Would definitely recommend this airbnb!! Thank you!
Beautiful, very clean minimalist apartment with all the required amenities , great location, responsive and friendly host. I would stay here again when next I visit Porto.

If I could give this place and this host more than 5 stars I would. The apartment was not only beautiful, but in a great location which was very walkable and easy to get to via taxi/uber. The host even took time to welcome us and provide a map of the city and his favorite locations which were perfect for our stay. We absolutely loved it!

Fernando’s place is in a great location. We were able to walk most places. We only got an Uber or Bolt if we were going somewhere that had a lot of hills on the way. Fernando was helpful and proactive during communication. I would highly recommend staying at this place when in Porto.

The place is really great, 100% matched the photos. Check in and check out were easy thanks to clear instructions of the host. The apartment has everything you need for short and medium term stay, tastefully furnished, has a big balcony and all the amenities listed. The host was friendly giving immediate response whenever needed. We will definitely come back! Thank you for arranging an unforgettable stay!
Cozy and clean flat, plus you get one time free complimentary cleaning service, which was really nice. The place felt also safe and communication was great.
Had a really great time here. The accommodation has all the amenities one might need, and the weekly cleaning service was a pleasant surprise. I'd love to stay here again someday!
Very confortable staying. Lucia was extremely kind in any moment! I had a wonderfull time in oporto

The accomodation is near the city centre and direct metro line to the airport. Comfortable bed with very sparkling white bed linens. Both the room and ensuite bathroom were very clean. I didn't use the kitchen, but it was available. I did arrive late at night, but self check-in was very easy. It takes 5 mins to get to the city centre using Uber which is not expensive in Porto. Next to the house there is a little cafe to get morning coffee. Overall I do recommend.

One of the best places we´ve stayed so far!
The location is top, few minutes on foot from Carolina Michaelis metro station and not so far from the city center.
The apartment is brand new and the kitchen is fully equipped for those who want to make some meals at home.
Excellent for 3 persons, big and confortable 2 beds and 1 sofa-bed.
Everything was clean and organised.
The apartment is warm and modern.
Try the healthy meals in the LM cafe, in the downstairs, amazing dishes!
Luis and Maria are top hosts, they are always there for you and guide you in the places to visit!
You will feel home, we absolutely recommend!
We had a great stay at Hosty’s place. Very clean and tidy apartment with everything provided. Would definitely recommend!

Warm welcome and very responsive host (before and during the stay)!
Newly refurbished flat and furniture, comfortable and clean.
Comfortable, firm mattresses in bedroom with blackout shutters for a restful sleep.
Easy access to Porto's attractions and amenities while still enjoying quiet surroundings.
Would definitely try to stay there again when we next visit Porto!

We had a nice cozy stay there. We had no problem staying there except for the weather.^^
Thanks for everything.

Teresa was a great host. Right when I booked, she messaged me and asked me for anything we needed. Anytime I had a question regarding the stay, she was responsive within the same day. It helped me to be able to pack accurately and the recommendations on the booklet she provided were helpful as well!

Absolutely loved the place: the room is clean and has everything you might need. Complimentary bottle of water and cookies are a nice touch. 😊It’s easy to get to the sights by public transportation as the metro is about 5 -minute walk and the bus stop is very close. The neighborhood is quiet. Will stay again when in Porto. Highly recommend. 👍🏻

Everything is great, just like it in the photo, it’s clean, bright and quiet.
It makes us feel even more relaxed than at home.
Beautiful apartment with an incredible view. Carolina was kind, quick to respond, and very helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

We had the best stay here. The home is a magical space with the most romantic beautiful panoramic views! We loved the pool, balcony and terrace. The house had everything we needed and was extremely comfortable. The surrounding area was exactly what we wanted to explore the old town, parks etc. It was a peaceful, quiet and relaxing stay. The host was super helpful responding quickly and giving local recommendations. I hope I can stay here again, it was super special!

Maria was really helpful with her suggestions, quick reply and always said yes for our requests. the house is very nice and spotless clean :) definitely will stay again.
thank you so much

The apartment was just as beautiful as the pictures suggested. The location could not be any better. We did not use any form of transport except our feet for the entire duration of our stay. The neighbourhood is lively and there are exceptional restaurants and cool stores just around the corner. The entire experience was very smooth. Would return anytime.

Great stay, perfect apartment, clean and well equipped. True to the description.
The host is responsive and professional.
Have a good stay!
We had a fantastic time - the location was perfect and the apartment was modern and clean. Couldn't have asked for a better space.
The apartment is exactly like the pictures and has everything you need. The place is close to all attractions within walking distance. Thanks again Elson.

The location was fantastic! Close to everything! I would definitely recommend staying here and I’d love to come back and stay again. Very communicative host and a great value for the price! Two thumbs up.

Great location, 15 minute walk to beach which was enjoyable. Close to cafes and restaurants. (Be mindful on weekends not as much availability as some closed)
Easy to reach from the metro which was 6 minutes walk away.
We were able to enjoy the jazz festival close by in July.
Would recommend the area for families. The beach was great and we were able to do some surfing. Beach towels aren't provided by property.

Manuel was very kind, hospitable and accommodating. Keep in mind Maia is not close to city centre, but I managed to get out by taking a bus and train. I enjoyed my stay and got everything I needed. Space I stayed  had lots of room and a modern TV so that was a huge plus. Thankyou again Manuel! Would definitely come back!

This flat is lovely and ideally situated for exploring Porto. It's conveniently located near coffee shops, supermarkets, and restaurants. Communication with GuestReady was a pleasure; they were quick to respond and resolve any issues. We highly recommend this flat!✨️✨️

co-host Rita was amazing.  She gave us a recommendation for a restaurant that was delicious and on the river.  She also arranged taxi service for us.  If we ever come back to Porto just the two of us we would definitely stay again.  If other people come with us we can't because it only sleeps 2. 😍🌞

Our stay was great! The accommodation was perfect, very clean and comfortable. The location was really good, everything was easily accessible. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay!
Really nice place to stay in Porto. Some issues with the WiFi which was not the fault of the owner. Fast communication.

We stayed 4 days, and the place was cleaned and restock with toiletries on the 3rd day which was great.  We paid $10.00/night for private parking right next to the unit.  Everywhere we went was walkable so no need to buy tram tickets.  Porto has a lot of up and down cobblestone, so it was a good exercise.  We used the recommendations for restaurants through Pedro and Guruwalk guide.  We ate where the locals eat which is better food and less expensive for sure.  We spent 4 days in Lisbon and we used tram tickets there but not too expensive.  Overall, we will stay here again.  Thank you Pedro.

The flat was beautiful, spotless and thoughtfully provisioned with everything we needed for our break, including slippers and cotton pads in the bathroom. Pedro was so helpful and welcoming too. A great host, lovely location near all the sights and gorgeous place to stay.
Good recommendation for this appartment 👍🏻👍🏻. Nice location, near to the famous bridge, good restaurants, riverside. everything was perfect 👍🏻👍🏻

The apartment and Pedro were both fantastic. The apartment was great, everything you need and in a convenient location. Pedro was one of the best hosts we’ve experienced, always responsive and happy to help. We recommend the e-bikes for a cycle down the coast!
Exceptional location, and very nice flat. A good size for Porto, plenty of space and the terrace was a real pleasure to have.

Such a good experience. It was my first time in Portugal/Porto and Isabel&Felipe couldn't have been better hosts.
I was welcomed with warmth, given recommendations about the city, what to do and how to get around. They also gave me a free ride to the airport🥰
The place is worth all of the money. It's exactly as in the pictures and has everything you need. It's peaceful and gives you the feel of a little getaway in the Portuguese heaven.
Location is also close to the bus station and LIDL.
I will definitely stay again when I'm back.
Thank you for your hospitality Isabel&Felipe and congratulations for giving visitors such a great experience😊

Great location. Private and secure but welcoming. Super close to shopping and restaurants. Great hosts. Very helpful and organised. We were late arriving and it was no trouble and they were on hand to sort us out. Great place. Would stay again. And dog friendly which is always great.

I had a wonderful stay! The location was very walkable, which made exploring super easy. Raquel was such a lovely host, always friendly and helpful. The apartment itself was ideal — clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The balcony was definitely a plus, perfect for relaxing after a day out. Highly recommend!

The location of the house is amazing, you just cross the road and you’re on the beach and there’s plenty of space. The water is cold and the waves are strong, but you can always move along the beach and look for better spot to swim. The city is close by car but we also walked along the beach and it took us less than 1 hour with 3 kids. Farol restaurant was ace! The host, Maria, is very responsive and always helpful. The one thing that the description of the house didn’t mention is that your accommodation has certain communal features, like washing machine, BBQ and ironing. You also have to pass through the owner’s garage to access the apartments. Some might find it not fully private and might need to know it before booking. However, we had a great time as a family and we would recommend the property and the host to other visitors.
